source: 官方 Steam Patch Notes / 公告（2023-2026）＋kb/04 武器与装备平衡调整历史整理

weapon_rows.label: 狙击枪类（通用）
weapon_rows.changes: 2024-10-02 栓动基础伤害上调、爆头 1.5→1.4，VSS 衰减 80→70；2026-01-14 栓动重做、移除高射速子类、VSSK 130→233、Gauss 180→247 但移除 30% 穿甲；2026-01-28 三把栓动四肢 1→0.9；2026-03-04 再次统一栓动拔枪 0.3→0.4；2026-07-22 PTRD-M/PzB 38 移除无视护甲板；2026-09-02 半自动/自动狙击与 VSS/VSK 全面加伤害。

patches.title: Patch Notes [28.10.2026]
bullets: **机枪**：DSA RPD 39.3→39.8；M60 51→51.2；PKP Pecheneg 45.3→45.5；Worn PKP 39.8→40；RPL-20 44→44.5。官方称小幅加强 PvP 表现较弱的机枪。
**狙击枪**：OTL-03 Karbach 爆头伤害 1.5→1.54；Cheytac M300 爆头伤害 1.15→1.18；FN Scar SSR 伤害与最低伤害 71.5→72。

**冲锋枪**：Scorpion EVO III 30.6→30.5；TDI Kriss Vector 34.8→34.6、最低伤害 19.3→19.1；SR-3M 33.1→32.8、后坐 0.51°→0.59°、最大伤害距离 16→15；SR-3 Vikhr 29→28.9、后坐 0.45°→0.56°、最大伤害距离 16→15；SIG MPX 最低伤害 21.3→21.5；PPK-20、Vityaz-SN、PP-19-01 Vityaz 射速 750→760。SR-3M 与 Vector 是击杀数和击杀效率最高的两把，继续被削。
**手枪**：SIG Sauer P320 伤害 75→74；Magpul FMG-9 后坐 0.3°→0.25°、水平后坐 0.26°→0.25°。
**霰弹枪**：AEK-965 开火后的后坐/停止作用略微降低，开火后几乎立即进入低停止作用状态。
**配件**：ASh-12 扩容弹匣换弹 3→3.25 秒、战术换弹 2.4→2.6 秒；新增后坐 -5%、水平后坐 -5%、后坐累积 -10%，以补偿人机劣势。
**护甲**：Aurora Jumpsuit 子弹防护 39→42、新增移速 1%、负重 5→7 kg、流血防护 35%→25%；Seekers/Morgues Exoskeleton 移除耐力 -15%、子弹防护 158→151、现在兼容任意容器；Arc Jumpsuit 体型修正 small→medium。
**经济/其他**：事件最终奖励改为“100% 基础奖励 + 概率额外加成”，不再出现复杂事件奖励过低；Arsen 的 Detector Components 出售上限 165→170。这两项不是战斗数值，但属于本补丁的经济调整。

patches.title: Patch Notes [30.09.2026]
bullets: **近战武器**：移除近战伤害浮动，所有近战伤害改为固定值。官方给出的最终值包括：Hunter's Knife 35/38/82、Crowbar 57/75/84、Gerber Downrange Tomahawk 77/79/113、Razor 47/63/136、Frost Razor 52/69/149、Military Stalkers' Cleaver 38/57/151（依次为快速/普通/重击）。
**护甲/机制**：新增护甲 `Size` 参数，只显示命中体积，机制和实际 hitbox 未改；`Containers and infections` 的感染显示改为 -10 基准、数值乘 20，属于显示层改动。
**枪械/弹药/配件**：本补丁没有枪械、弹药或配件的数值改动。武器界面新增 `Type` 槽位参数，并重做完整属性面板与 Codex 对比。
这是截至 2026-10-22 最新一份完整补丁。

patches.title: Patch Notes [16.09.2026]
bullets: 无武器/护甲数值改动。内容为 Electrostorm 延期至 9-30、音量系统重做、Depot/Warehouse 决斗图翻新、Zen 出售列表更新。Zen 列表新增 Pancor Jackhammer 和若干近战外观，不涉及数值。

patches.title: Patch Notes [09.09.2026]
bullets: 无武器/护甲数值改动。Electrostorm 修正中涉及神器掉落：Forge-11 每次喷发后的神器数量减少 28%；Snares、Mug 的掉率调整为与 Larva、Black Hole、Timber 相同；Lightning Rod 生成神器的稀有度概率下调，但总数量增加。属于神器产出经济，不是战斗数值。

patches.title: Patch Notes [02.09.2026]
bullets: **手雷**：Stinky 不再被动持续输出 stopping power，改为 `Stability: -200%`，即站在烟里会显著放大来袭射击的停止作用。
**弹药**：所有鹿弹和 12 Caliber Birdshot 的额外扩散加成减半（200%→100%，100%→50%）；12 Caliber Hunting Round 对变异体伤害 +25%；Barricade 对结构伤害 x2→x2.5。

**配件**：Weight Tactical Grip 重量 90→200 g，移除 `Ergonomics -10%` 和 `Sway -16%`，垂直后坐 -10.5%→-15%，新增瞄准移动速度 -5%，移动速度惩罚 -2%→-1.5%；Skyline MBC 扩散 -5%→-7.5%、后坐累积 -25%→-10%、垂直后坐 -30%→-20.25%、水平后坐 25%→6.75%；Roll Flash Hider 扩散 -5%→-7.5%、后坐累积 -25%→-10%、垂直后坐 15%→6.75%、水平后坐 -30%→-20.25%。
**异常模块**：Decompressor 新增后坐累积 -2.727%~-10.906%；Aggressor 新增 stopping power +5.998%~+23.994%；Blighter 新增扩散/腰射扩散 -2.045%~-8.18%。

**神器**：Tiny Key 后坐 -4.4%→-6.5%、晃动 -6.1%→-9.1%（附加属性 -2.1%→-3.1%）；Bismuth 新增晃动 -13%、后坐 -4.4%→-4.6%，移除再生 0.7%、新增治疗效率 9.1%；Static 后坐 -3.7%→-5.5%；Loop 后坐 -2.6%→-3.8%；Rubik 附加后坐 -2.1%→-3.1%；Tallow 新增移动速度 0.3%；Larva 新增辐射 -0.3；Cone 新增移动速度 0.6%、治疗效率 5.1%；Link 新增移动速度 0.4%。

**护甲**：Rigel Jumpsuit 稳定性 20%→25%；RAPS AH-6/AH-5 移动速度 -3%→-2%，AH-4 -2%→-1%，AH-3/AH-2 -1%→0；Bear 子弹防护 197→199；SBA TANK 272→275；Apostle/Reiter/Chieftain/Granite 超重甲 282→286；Centurion 250→247；Antares 移动速度 -7%→-6%；Peresvet 209→211、负重 13→15；Orion 192→195；Arc 203→206；Navigator 198→200。
**全武器通用**：无侧轨/顶轨武器的 `LD` 补偿扩展到 Stalker 及以上全部武器，腰射扩散降低幅度按等级：Stalker -10%，Veteran -15% 或 -20%，Master/Legend -25%。
**霰弹枪**：AEK-965 降低开火后的射手减速；Cobray Terminator 缩短射击后开始换弹的延迟；Ripper 等级显示由 Veteran 修正为 Stalker。
**手枪**：FN Five-seveN 新增默认瞄具；OTs-33 Pernach 最低伤害 26.8→29；RSh-12、CR-72 拔枪 0.4→0.5 秒。

**冲锋枪**：IMI Micro Uzi 拔枪 0.6→0.5 秒；SR-3M 33.5→33.1；SR-3 Vikhr 29.4→29；Scorpion EVO III 30.8→30.6；TDI KRISS Vector 35→34.8；PPK-20 最低伤害 25→25.5；Vityaz-SN 21.9→22.3；PP-19-01 Vityaz 17.9→18.6；AEK-919K Kashtan 12.7→13。
**机枪**：PKP Pecheneg 45→45.3；Worn PKP 39.6→39.8；M60 50.7→51；RPL-20 43.8→44；Hystrix's/Firebrand's RPD 最低伤害 24.1→26.5。

patches.title: Patch Notes [12.08.2026]
bullets: 无武器/护甲/神器数值改动。Coliseum 排位赛季开始，新增评级、联赛奖励、Coliseum 商店和 PT-9 Psychoscopic Terminal。排位环境变化不等于武器数值变化。

patches.title: Patch Notes [05.08.2026]
bullets: 无武器/护甲数值改动。内容为 Triumphs/Faction Race 结算、Coliseum 奖励逻辑、Sea of Exclusion 计时 17–21–25 改为 20–24–28 分钟、赛季包。唯一与装备沾边的是 Bale 容器正式开放，属于容器获取，不是战斗调整。

patches.title: Patch Notes [29.07.2026]
bullets: **Coliseum 专属**：Specialist 的 Tranquilizer 弹数 3→2，充能 8→10 秒；命中后额外给敌人 1 秒扫描标记。Psionic Mine 伤害 200→125，爆炸半径 3→4 米，同时可布置的雷数 3→2。
**Coliseum 机制**：全队被清空的扣分从 10% 提高到 15%；爆炸桶伤害 310→250、爆炸半径 3→1 米；反重力桶现在也让子弹加速 50%。这些只作用于 Coliseum，不影响开放世界。

patches.title: Patch Notes [22.07.2026]
bullets: **神器**：Polyhedron 触发所需伤害 90→100。官方理由是 90 点阈值会被部分高单发 AR/MG（尤其配高级异常模块）触发，误伤自动武器；对狙击的防护不变。
**反器材步枪**：PTRD-M 和 PTRD-M (A) 屏息体力消耗 x1→x2，按目标缺失生命加伤 1%→0.75%，**移除无视护甲板**，并略微增加开火后减速；PzB 38 四肢 1→0.9、同样屏息 x2、加伤 1%→0.75%、移除无视护甲板。官方明确说以后身体命中会被护甲板正常吸收，不再“无视 99%”。
**护甲**：新手甲整体上调，Jacket 子弹防护 5→10、撕裂防护 20→30、移动速度 0→3%、流血防护 5→25；Stalker Coat 18→19；Mole Suit 20→21，但元素抗性 11→0、移动速度 1→0、负重 5→10；Reinforced Jacket 30→29，爆炸防护 40→50，稳定性 0→10。
**配件**：Apogee 光学瞄具扩大可安装武器范围。

patches.title: Patch Notes [15.07.2026]
bullets: 无武器/护甲数值改动。新增拍照模式、平滑相机、K2/K2C1 进入交换树、Advanced case 内容更新。

patches.title: Patch Notes [08.07.2026]
bullets: 无武器数值改动，但有一条影响对枪的机制修正：**射速优先级**。同条件同时开火时，射速更高的武器现在正确获胜；射速相同则先开火者获胜，即使两发落在同一 tick。此前可能由连接更早的玩家获胜。
Ratel 是 Honey Badger 的暗色数码涂装，属于外观奖励，不是新数值武器。

patches.title: Patch Notes [01.07.2026]
bullets: **突击步枪**：AK-15 46.8→47（官方理由是 20 米内仍略弱于同类）；QBZ-191 Thunderbird 37.3→37.5；HK XM8S 后坐 0.58→0.55、后坐累积 4%→3%；XM8 (A) 0.55→0.52、累积 3.5%→2.6%；HK XM8 0.58→0.55、累积 4%→3%；ASh-12 完全移除向左的水平后坐，使弹道更可预测；M60E4 50→50.5；RPL-20 43.5→43.8。

patches.title: Patch Notes [24.06.2026]
bullets: 无开放世界武器数值改动。6-24 至 7-01 的 **Spartak's Calibers** 临时 Session 模式用于测试弹药类型（Armor-piercing、Explosive、Expanding、High Stopping power 等）对预设装备的影响；这是测试模式，不能当作正式服数值。

patches.title: Patch Notes [17.06.2026]
bullets: 无武器/护甲数值改动。影响 PvP 的机制：Session Battles 的复活无敌不再对 Session 模式生效；Glass Deathmatch 的玩家属性改为与 GOST-17 Deathmatch 一致；Subdivision Battles 的 EU/NA 最大人数降到 25。未改枪械数值。

patches.title: Patch Notes [03.06.2026]
bullets: **SIG MPX 升级**：等级 Veteran→Master，伤害 34.4→39.3、最低伤害 18.9→21.3；基础配置移除弹鼓，弹鼓改为用 X-5 弹鼓交换；MPX 作为 HK MP5 的后续进入交换树。
**全武器稳定性**：所有配件和武器内置的 `Stabilization` 数值**减半**；异常模块提供的稳定性不受影响。这是 2026 年控枪体系最大的一次系统性削弱。

**异常模块**：大量正向属性区间放大约 1.5 倍（如舒适人机 2.908–11.633%→4.362–17.45%，垂直后坐 -2.181–8.725%→-3.272–13.087%）；Regulator 的后坐累积削弱从 -58.166–232.665% 改为 -16.359–65.437%，官方理由是它几乎能完全消除后坐、成为多数武器的唯一选择；Aggressor 改为 15 秒再生效果，不再依赖治疗效率。

**护甲**：Beastslayer 系稳定性 +5/+15/+25/+25/+40%（Trapper/Vorsa/Osh/Jaeger/Beast Slayer）；Prometheus、Ronin、Templar、Vanguard 战斗服 +15% 稳定性；超重甲统一：SBA TANK 子弹防护 285→272、移动速度 -10%→-8%，Bear 207→197，Apostle/Reiter/Chieftain/Granite 310→282、移动速度 -15%→-10%，ZIVCAS M2-T 347→317；Yorsh 177→190、Spanner 161→183；Rigel 稳定性 20%、移动速度 -5%→-4%；Antares 移动速度 -8%→-7%、稳定性 10%→35%；AH-6/AH-5 -4%→-3%，AH-4 -2.5%→-2%；Blizzard Walker 移动速度 -5%→-2%、子弹防护 187→194。
这一补丁的核心不是单纯 buff，而是把“有效射程”统一拉长、把移动速度惩罚统一降低，同时用稳定性减半抑制中远距离全自动。

patches.title: Patch Notes [20.05.2026]
bullets: 仅 **Assault on the Reichstag** 活动模式：红军占领区域后的复活数 125→150；Explosive Parcel 半径 13→11 米。开放世界无改动。

patches.title: Patch note [13.05.2026]
bullets: 仍为 **Assault on the Reichstag** 活动平衡：PTRD 扩散 0.5→0.05；PPSh 弹鼓腰射 2.27→2.52；MP-40 腰射 2.3→2.10；FG-42 38.5→42、远距 28.88→31.5、弹匣 15→20；AVT-40 45.8→48、远距 34.35→36、弹匣 10→15；DP/MG-34/MG-42/Bren 普遍降低扩散和垂直后坐，例如 MG-34 垂直后坐 4.5→2.7；活动内所有坦克加强生命、伤害、射速。不能用于回答开放世界。

patches.title: Patch Notes [08.05.2026]（Steam 发布 05-07）
bullets: 仅 **Assault on the Reichstag** 活动平衡：SVT-40 后坐 2.1→2.5、水平 0.3→0.45、晃动 0.65→2、瞄准 0.3→0.4 秒；PPSh 弹鼓移动速度 -1.1%→-2.5%；G43 腰射 3.9→4、后坐 1.5→1.9、水平 0.3→0.4、瞄准 0.3→0.4、晃动 0.65→2；FG-42 远距伤害 38.5→28.88、衰减起点 40→30；AVT-40 远距 45.8→34.35、起点 40→30；Mosin 卡宾瞄准移动速度 -25→-20、瞄准 0.3→0.25；Mauser 98k 衰减起点 33→37、终点 40→44、瞄准 0.3→0.35；带瞄具的栓动狙只能在中小远距离一枪；破片手雷 151→120、最低 80→60、引信 3.5→2.5 秒；所有坦克耐久 x2、破片半径 +1/3。

patches.title: Patch Notes [06.05.2026]
bullets: **Mauser 98k**：等级 Newbie→Stalker，耐久与修理费提高，伤害和最低伤害 70→91。
**DP**：等级 Newbie→Stalker，耐久与修理费提高，伤害 24.6→31.5、最低伤害 18.3→25。
这两把是本期最明确的“低等级武器抬到中等级”调整，配合等级提升同步加成本。

patches.title: Patch Notes [22.04.2026]
bullets: **削弱**：HK MP7A2 最低伤害 19.6→19.1；Scorpion EVO III 31.3→30.8；OTs-14M Surge 38.8→38.3；Saiga-12 92.5→90.5、垂直后坐 2.25→2.5；Gauss rifle 腰射 5→6、瞄准移动速度 -50%→-60%；CR-380 腰射 4→5、瞄准移动速度 -30%→-40%、收枪 0.3→0.5 秒；PTRD-M 腰射 5→6。
这一轮是“7.62 步枪整体抬伤害、SMG 高使用率型号继续小削”的组合。

patches.title: Patch Notes [15.04.2026]
bullets: 无武器/护甲数值改动。Inside Out 活动调整：Transmuter 第五阶段掉落神器数量增加、喷发后神器稀有度提高。属于掉落经济。

patches.title: Patch Notes [08.04.2026]
bullets: 无玩家武器数值改动，但 PvE 战斗环境变化：Wild North 所有 NPC 改用穿甲弹而非普通弹，所有 NPC 生命 -8%。玩家武器数据未动。

patches.title: Patch Notes [01.04.2026]
bullets: 无平衡数值改动。愚人节 Petard Server、临时任务奖励 Automatic Gauss Rifle、DOTSAT 新增 1x–1.5x 变焦；后者是瞄具功能，不是伤害调整。

patches.title: Patch Notes [18.03.2026]
bullets: **双管霰弹回调**：TOZ-34 175→181、Gramps TOZ 190.5→198、TOZ-55 207→215、TOZ-57 246→255、TOZ-84 280→290；TOZ-34 短管 118→119、最低 52.2→53.6。官方说上一轮削弱叠加其他改动后双管太弱，因此恢复伤害。
**Saiga-12**：最低伤害 40→39；从第 4 发开始新增 3% 后坐增长。
**KS-23/AEK-965**：降低开火后的射手减速。
**手雷**：Sickness 优先级 10→8，Frost/Burning 各 -1→-2；Frost/Snowstorm 优先级 10→9；Napalm/Hot Jack 的 Frost 1.25→-3；Molotov 新增 Frost -3。
同日另有一条短公告指向本帖，不重复计算。

patches.title: Patch Notes [11.03.2026]
bullets: **23×75 Buckshot**：移除伤害惩罚，移除对护甲板耐久的额外伤害。
**其他霰弹**：BM-16、TOZ-34、Gramps TOZ、TOZ-55、TOZ-57、TOZ-84、Chiappa Triple Crown 射速 150→100（Chiappa 240→200）；Cryolator 200→100，伤害 175→181；TOZ 系伤害小幅下调。
这是 3 月 4 日 KS-23 重做后的紧急回调，说明“远距离两枪身体”方案没有保留。

patches.title: Patch notes [04.03.2026]
bullets: **爆头/四肢/基础伤害重标定**：多数 AR、SMG、手枪的爆头倍率 1.25→1.4，四肢 0.7→0.8（7.62 系 0.75→0.85）；栓动狙的爆头倍率按型号差异化。官方示例：基础伤害系数 100%→89.29%，爆头绝对伤害维持 125%，四肢基础系数 70%→71.4%。也就是说，**身体伤害下降、爆头收益提高、四肢收益提高**，不是简单的一刀切削弱。
**其他**：所有霰弹枪四肢倍率基础规则 1→0.9（KS-23、AEK-965 另为 1→0.875）；AA-12 最低伤害 38.5→40；Hasty Silencer 腰射 -12%→-10%；异常手雷改为按优先级生效，空爆会完全中和效果。

patches.title: Patch Notes [18.02.2026]

In-game chat reporting system

Good hunting in the Zone!
EXBO team

historical_patches.title: Spring updates for the international branch
historical_patches.text:
Content-hungry denizens of the Zone!
Back in our New Year's Eve article on plans for the year, we warned of a lull in January in terms of updates, as all processes had to be put in place to organize the regular release of patches to new regions. As is often the case in game development, a lot of unforeseen issues came up in the process that delayed development, and we ended up finishing only now 😅.
Various minor changes will be added to the EU, NA and SEA servers tomorrow, and the first major content update has moved to early March - but we promise not to drag it out!
March
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6984d9c5cbc1d5080b06ea082482f5ec2aeea9aa.png
The first thing we are expecting is the opening of the paths to the abandoned city of Limansk. This is a location with hardcore and dynamic gameplay, where you need to invigorate all your accumulated skills and experience to survive. New quests, some of which will be a real test of strength, and new equipment in the barter will become available to you.
In addition, the English-speaking servers will finally get the updated Swamps and small changes to the Cordon, which should improve the situation with the campers (leaving the safezone will change servers). Also, more intuitive updated Emissions, and new Anomalous Serum contracts will be added.
April
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f493473b7f3ee0afc9a998e51ee2c49146ebb248.png
In April, players of English-speaking regions will be able to experience our traditional spring event - "Anomalous Blizzard" for the first time. This is a very large-scale in-game event, with unique gameplay and a bunch of themed rewards! Usually the event lasts for three weeks, and leaves the participants not only a lot of yummy loot, but also great memories.
We are also preparing the introductory tutorial changes for this month.
May
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0170031b5426b4cb1c72b99d97168dbbf27624a2.jpg
After the end of the Event, the inhabitants of the Zone should expect a large-scale rebalance of all equipment, which is designed to fix the current problems of balance in Stalcraft. We've been preparing it since the summer - a very useful and important update.
After fiddling with the rebalance, we will roll out the operation "Dead Time" to the new regions. This is a well-proven competitive mode, where two teams of players infiltrate the secret Soviet laboratory. You will have to fight not only the mutants and NPCs, but also interfere with each other!
The Epilogue
In addition to the aforementioned content, various minor updates may get released, which can't be predicted in advance. By the end of spring we'll definitely inform you about our plans for the summer season - most likely it will be entirely devoted to clan activities!
Thank yall for your faith in us and for following our news. Two months is indeed a huge delay, and we will try our best to avoid such pauses in the future.
Always yours,
EXBO Team.

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [08.03.23]
historical_patches.text:
Limansk
Limansk is a mysterious ghost town whose streets are teeming with all kinds of mutants, fanatics, and other dangers. Seasoned explorers do not advise newbies to go there, because the entire city is one solid spatial anomaly, which deceptively easily lets in anyone who wants to, only to slam the doors behind them. Getting into the city is easy, but getting out is quite a challenge.
That's why traders are ready to offer valuable and truly unique offers to those skilled enough to get out of the city and take souvenirs from there. 
How to get to the location 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4ef67cec95e8cc117e6f676b25dad244282c4497.png
Getting to Limansk is possible only through spatial anomalies called Space Bubbles - their locations can be seen on the map in the PDA. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4c009bf5218f60b4eab72e3c5e87f7401a08ed2d.png
Some are available all the time, and some appear only in certain hours. To get to the ghost town - just pass through Space Bubbles.
How to get out of the town
In order to exit the location alive and retrieve valuable loot, you must complete one of four extraction events. Extraction events are marked with a gold icon and are visible to all players on the map.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8827b527f7378bf8975862e8fcbe3724797914b6.png
For completing the event the player will receive an artifact called "ID" - a one-time pass that allows you to exit Limansk.
After receiving the "ID", the player must find one of the spatial bubbles to exit the location.
Special features of the location 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/114bd80de1c7060699774a7d577ee7359f71b99d.png
Form squads in safe zones. In Limansk you won’t be able to add a squad member to your copy of the location if he is already on another copy of the location or if you added him after getting to the location. So make sure you carefully assemble your squad for the Limansk trip!
You can't take lost backpacks out of Limansk. In order to take resources from the location, you need to survive and extract on your own, there is no other way!
Limansk doesn't have a player counter. You must always be vigilant - there may be an enemy lurking around every corner.
New Quests
The discovery of Limansk was an event that changed the lives of many inhabitants of the Zone. Perhaps it can change your life as well…
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cf7d90c18efbdf8d724aac25303ae5bdbe57402d.png
After you reach the maximum level of reputation in the Bar, you will get access to the Limansk quests. Find a man named Arkanov in the Bar and talk to him. After the first dialog with Arkanov, you'll get access to the Limansk questlines.
 Be warned! Some of the Limansk quests are hidden, you'll have to try hard to find them... 
In some Limansk quest lines there are "chains of challenges" - a series of several quests that need to be completed one after another with special conditions. For example, you must complete all of the quests in the "chain" without leaving the location or dying. If you fail one stage or another, the "chain of challenges" will start all over again. You can easily tell if you are in a "chain" by the names of the quests.
Example of chain names:
• Liquidation: Part 1
• Liquidation: Part 2
• Liquidation: Part 3
Updated Emission
Stages
Before the update, Emission started instantly and created unexpected noise and shaking of the screen. All effects were triggered immediately, leaving no time for a meaningful search for shelter due to panic.
Now the Emission starts gradually and is divided into 4 stages:
Weather changes – with the first notification, the sky turns gray.
Precursors of Emission – the typical sounds of Emission appear, in a minute the sky turns red from zero to the maximum "red". By the end of this stage, the ground starts shaking.
Emission – the surrounding space is red and shaking. You start to receive damage, at first it is low and there is still time to get to the shelter.
Deadly phase – damage reaches its peak. Even the best artifact builds will not help you survive in this phase.
 During the beginning of each phase, the player receives a unique sound and visual notification for each stage. 
Emission shelters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ea72d91bbc357fd909f0ffbb4f18a29c5b249958.png
When the Emission starts, safe shelters are shown on the map. Icons for them are displayed within a radius of 300 meters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cab3184abb3045b6f999ed0f9967ef24a08da079.png
Once you are safe, the task will change from finding shelter to "Wait out the Emission". 
Updates to locations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b42a955f8c67ab395b1791c8bcfab1b70c671003.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/1f2fcc255818ccaacf85d0d3fe36da9957f9eb7e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/813ff678d59d6452f07fc0a2be6cf1da347cd85e.png
The last Emission has greatly transformed the Swamps - not only the landscape has changed, but also the safe zones. The paths of stalkers and bandits have changed, in a more comfortable way.
Also the old side quests were removed, and instead new side story quest lines have been added - so far, one for bandits and stalkers. In the near future you should expect to see more new quests added to the Swamps.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fff4468005cc4e78dc2d9ff2971604bace69e40c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/28ad5deb0b0c239b846b2b08745fed806d538e5f.png
Stalkers and bandits in the Swamps and Cordon finally, after many years, were able to build walls at their bases and put normal doors. This should slightly improve the situation with campers in the southern locations, since the server changes when you leave the save zone.
The Mercenary base has been rebuilt. Players in the main base building now also no longer receive damage for Emission.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c8ca99684c84932985ae981ff487d20b5e3ebe27.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/1aa6bb0436dcc650f91c4710a0f673f2bb9605d5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c8ca99684c84932985ae981ff487d20b5e3ebe27.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/469670c6b56eda19f4460270f73f1f7efed72e38.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/93343af21a1f6ce836687d31b7ae803f65892e76.png
Quests of northern factions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3ec22d99083fdd4416d729cb75ac9fd2d5388a7a.png
Daily quests for the northern factions have been added. You gain access to these tasks upon reaching the 4th reputation level in the save zone of the northern faction.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fe12a708048edc8f9772d6bfc442ecb031d5ca5d.png
After reaching reputation level 4, when you enter the save zone next time, the quest "Talk to the faction leader" will be given out. After that, the player will be given a daily assignment every day.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/36cfe249c95f36a4dbb5b13c0d36eae74bf5f1d2.png
The assignments consist of 3 tasks. A small reward is sent to the courier for completing each of the tasks. For completing all 3 tasks, 1 Anomalous serum is given.
 Anomalous serum is a barter resource needed to get the best equipment in the bar "100 Rads" and the bases of the Northern factions. 
These quests reset every day at:
• PM 10:00 (CET)
• PM 4:00 (EST)
• AM 5:00 (GMT+8)
Weekly quests 
The weekly quests of the 100 Rads Bar have been reworked. Previously there were three linear branches of quests, now there is one branch with a random set of quests.
If a weekly quest was accepted before the update, it will be automatically completed and a reward will be sent to your mail. New weekly quests can be accepted at the next weekly reset.
Merchants
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cc5ebf440bbb4fc0ee8bcf56e8c70ccd0a1f2795.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a8f215c4b93949ee5cd402d743241c1adfa67c7e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/795c72a6a9ed26a012e0544ae93f68a6e5baabf7.png
Many gear items from merchants of the northern factions in the "100 Rads" bar received alternative barter offers - for resources from Limansk.
The assortment of gear from merchants of the northern factions and in the "100 Rads" bar has been updated.
Level 4:
— Container "Forager" (only for the resources of Limansk);
— Worn PKP "Pecheneg";
— AEK-971;
— HK G36C;
— FN F2000;
— TDI KRISS Vector.
Level 5:
— ASh-12 (only for Limansk resources);
— MTs-558 (only for the resources of Limansk);
— RSh-12 (only for the resources of Limansk).
— G3/M1A drum magazine;
— Container "Bear’s Den-6";
— Container "Hive".
— Extended magazine for MTs-558 (only for Limansk resources);
— Silencer for ASs-12/MTs-558 (only for Limansk resources);
— Silencer for MTs-558 (only for the resources of Limansk).
— Gun paint job "Lim" (only for the resources of Limansk).
Animations and sounds
Updated animations and interaction sounds of SVU and Saiga-12K. 
Other changes
• The issue of ammo in session battles and duels has been changed – now the optimal amount of ammo for equipped weapons is issued instead of a fixed number of magazines.
• The damage multiplier to the head of the worn VSS "Vintorez" has been reduced from x1.5 to x1.35
• Updated models of 20-rnd, 30-rnd and 40-rnd 5.56 STANAG magazines.
• Added the ability to apply paint jobs to Desert Eagle Mark XIX and Colt Python.
• Adjusted the draw time and ADS of Colt Python.
• A preview of possible paint jobs for gear in demo mode has been returned.
If you have any problems with the game, please contact our support center.
Support center Create a ticket Guide on how to create a ticket
Thank you for tuning in,
and best of luck on your hunts in the Zone!

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [22.03.2023]
historical_patches.text:
Death Screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a5185253a03608c115875404a9d7da8582848cc5.png
The death screen has been completely redesigned, allowing the deceased player to get a complete overview of the enemy and learn more effectively from his own mistakes.
The update has touched both the visual part as well as the functional part - several blocks of information about death, about the killer and his assistants have been added, including, but not limited to:
• Number of hits to various body parts.
• Damage and other characteristics of each hit.
• Active buffs applied to the killer.
Main screen
Displays basic information about the entity or player that dealt the decisive damage, a list of contributors, the direction of the attack, and the number of hits.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c8649be5b1454e22a7dfd341bc529a3b75cd91e7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8bdf1181fa411c5af926c0d6c5a218396d87ed06.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/321a847261f083980f19a327f4c964e2bc89c4b0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/29ca913654ac3d20f0a71f8306e1c83eb5fb8754.png
Each entity has a different set of information that is given to the player.
Mutants
• Health
• Total damage
• Amount of hits
NPC
• Health
• Equipment
• Total damage
• Amount of hits
• Plate efficiency
Players
• Faction and subfaction
• Health
• Active buffs
• Equipment
• Total damage
• Amount of hits (in details)
• Plate efficiency
Battle Details
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/bbd08d6450f59c2d97aaf3717bf1824b7b6b9beb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/455c57328ba939d0e957df26392f441c2b784bf7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6ef17fcfef6ccd7d1ad8df44823447f03839a8dd.png
The "Battle Details" tab allows you to find out in detail who or what contributed to your death.
In the case of death at the hands of a player, you can find detailed statistics of hits, up to the indication of the type of ammunition used.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/963726b207ef22c085323b9f247647c2e52f7cd4.png
Each information block has pop-up tooltips to explain their meaning.
Prohibited software report
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b09c2deac6e9d114bc6ad2fd78d24a75fcaf6708.png
Added the option to report the killer, if you suspected him of cheating.
Each report is reviewed manually, so it is recommended to use this function only if it is absolutely certain that the player has violated the license agreement and/or game rules.
New animations and sounds
Added new animations for PP-2000, SKS and sounds of interaction with PP-2000, SKS and TT.
Other changes
• Increased the number of issued ammo in the "Standoff"
• Now grenades for underbarrel grenade launchers are issued in duels.
• Fixed the loss of the "Data Block" when being severely wounded.
• Fixed some minor bugs in the game files.
• Removed signals from the mercenary base.
Thank you for tuning in, 
and best of luck on your hunts in the Zone!

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [17.05.23]
historical_patches.text:
Global Rebalance
https://sun9-33.userapi.com/impg/5Qq1Ybit8RkKFLflKXuHfNLJNiZ-X47RGCVbLQ/LKpV61XOYR4.jpg?size=2560x1440&quality=96&sign=ba5ba70462bad6ca0bcee47ce962dcd0&type=album
A global rebalance has been made! The characteristics of almost all equipment have been affected, from weapons/armor to upgrading and artifact builds.
When you first enter the game it is strongly recommended to remove the containers with artifacts! Because of the changed characteristics there is a possibility of taking damage from the accumulation of infections.
 For convenience, we put the information about rebalance in a separate article, including artifact compensation until June 17: Learn more about rebalance.
Dead Time
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/388ddc3e888245bc8870d725baa513ec0b2b84a0.jpg
Before the whole catastrophe story, there was a scientific laboratory under the authority of the Soviet military located under the ground on the territory of the present-day Exclusion Zone, where new weapons were being developed based on the research of quantum states of matter. Experiments were conducted with particle gas pedals, plasma stabilization, and other interesting things that were in the frontier zone of human knowledge.
After the explosion at the 4th power plant, communication with this laboratory was lost, all existing entrances to the area disappeared, and no one ever saw the people who worked there again.
However, after the usual emission, PDA's of the inhabitants of the Zone began to periodically pick up some uncharacteristic interference and strange signals…
Operation "Dead Time"
 Briefly: Dead Time - PvPvE 5x5 dungeon. 
Under the guidance of a scientific team, players in a research team of five must infiltrate the Laboratory and activate special energy cells. The situation is complicated by the presence of enemy mercenaries and the security systems of the Lab itself.
Access to the location is available every day
CET
• from 10:00 to 12:00
• from 14:00 to 16:00
• from 19:00 to 21:00
EST
• from 04:00 to 06:00
• from 08:00 to 10:00
• from 13:00 to 15:00
GMT+8
• from 16:00 to 18:00
• from 20:00 to 22:00
• from 01:00 to 03:00
Energy Cells
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/506d429cf724ef8f112d8fe85f924ce8635df069.png
Special devices that were developed by the staff of the scientific complex. They maintain the stability of the temporal field, which allows the Laboratory to exist in our time.
At a sufficiently close distance, the players' PDAs interact with the energy cell and start its recalibration. Explorers must wait for the cycle to end and connect the energy cell to the general network using the console.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d0cf4ae7ab15a283940c89854438bc43cf838cde.png
Numerous mutants that are attracted to the cell recalibration process are a serious problem. Be careful! The faster the cell is charged, the more aggressive these critters become!
Sometimes it's worth sacrificing speed to save your own life.
Temporal field
https://sun9-70.userapi.com/impg/VNoS_iQhFMRNAcAhmrwtMP6hreu85fjjEblSYA/DLuoyH7OKQs.jpg?size=807x454&quality=96&sign=26576b8f5b453fd981b78d87695c4851&type=album
https://sun9-35.userapi.com/impg/SZ51XQpLmhwlJvGpHFXx08EMzy1Wm3VooR4jNA/sesGOjLEnDY.jpg?size=807x454&quality=96&sign=46e0de8c869071e340a442164e39e41d&type=album
The entire complex is divided into two parts: the perimeter of the laboratory and the central part.
The perimeter is a bunch of old abandoned rooms, which were not spared by time and looters. The central part is a laboratory, sheltered by a temporal field. Different times. There was no Chernobyl explosion yet. Scientists there are still inventing the wonders of science and technology.
Neither the scientists nor the Soviet soldiers guarding them will be happy to see men with guns come out of nowhere. Be careful.
Access to the central part is possible only through the outline of the temporal field in several parts of the map.
Outpost
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7746f078a0bd25afd9e5895bf9a3bd5b4add81e9.png
The former guard room, hastily converted to an outpost near the first open temporal field. Players can seize control and gain an additional revival point on their path to explore the lab. Be warned: enemy mercenaries may interfere with you, thereby depriving you of a strategic advantage!
Capturing an outpost by any team is one-time and permanent. Re-capture is impossible. The number of revivals, as well as the capture rate, depends on the number of activated energy cells per team.
Score and Summary
https://sun9-13.userapi.com/impg/p1i-bX5VACjyc1RZXXQUZzdN764Y9Cay7B44Yw/calSN6x83KQ.jpg?size=257x124&quality=96&sign=00c739de3d2f7bff0923f4b14e69e99c&type=album
All actions of the players on the map are awarded with the points, which go into the overall team score.
"+" points to the team for:
• killing mutants
• killing players of the enemy team
• activating energy cells
The team with the most points at the end of the operation wins.
Sounds
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans//41581512/64354e1da73ac08555082179220ff1d0dbb77d10.png
The mechanism of processing gunshot sounds has been fixed.
 | The sound of the weapons has become more "weighty". 
Locations
https://sun9-3.userapi.com/impg/By-WMUKk6On-eMwrWjTsrDG4jTS_oY4Isp74Fg/u2pGYVigRFI.jpg?size=807x424&quality=96&sign=303ee0a1d9b769e69eb469c79379934b&type=album
https://sun9-80.userapi.com/impg/9SNG70PFzQ6dLXA18DnoqWjJJnFJfdlh3FNQxw/fDfQZBitTns.jpg?size=807x424&quality=96&sign=720063c34c22f38d13cb557fceb2c9de&type=album
https://sun9-32.userapi.com/impg/DuqoKaCn7cDrx09rFgl913BLJay6n9Uc0dUWqA/1FxUJ8Iybu8.jpg?size=807x384&quality=96&sign=c10372c129344a43f566d8b8c7900ca3&type=album
• Slightly expanded the passage between "Cordon" and "Junkyard".
• Added the ability to sit on most of the objects designed for this purpose in all of the safe-zones.
Compensations
We noticed that the barter had incorrect prices for MISs (all) and for M40s (only bandits), so we issued compensation for the difference in resources.
MIS line
https://sun9-58.userapi.com/impg/42ZKtodRZqmzhHu-0Tu717UW5Wp8rhKWICOOLg/jyJIQ54xROA.jpg?size=807x454&quality=96&sign=f9d0c1702c6a7f403c5a868b18540f4a&type=album
Players who obtained MIS-113 "Iolite", MIS-116 "Emerald", MIS-105 "Topaz" through barter before May 17 will receive compensation in the form of barter resources, depending on the barter offer:
Bartered ONLY for resources
• Remains of scientific equipment: 320 units
• Zonshroom: 330 units
• Beta Data Fragment: 118 units
• Chlorinex: 370 units
Bartered with Malachit MIS-99M
• Remains of scientific equipment: 327 units
• Zonshroom: 331 units
• Data fragment "Beta" - 120 units
• Chlorinex- 378 units
M40A5
https://sun9-58.userapi.com/impg/azFKw-veH58wdNy6s4FAsZC1ggrgFiiBDzE_2g/rE3oFnewy-A.jpg?size=807x354&quality=96&sign=cb43f3112208e2bde3e8e36d4eca9a70&type=album
All bandits who received an M40A5 through barter before May 17 will be compensated with in-game currency of 79,850₽.
Quests
The achievement "Treasure Seeker" for finding three caches on the Orderlies' base was granted. Previously, due to an error, not everyone could get it.
Achievement will appear upon revival at the base.
Bandits are now given the Oracle's "Worm" in the storyline quests. Those who previously received the Oracle's "Beryl" can exchange it for the bandit version in the barter, on the first level of the Photon base.
Changed the reward for the "Ghost" quest from the Limansk storyline. The player now receives special components to raise the equipment level to +9, previously to +5. Players who have already completed the quest will receive new special components to their personal storage.
Gear upgrade
The maximum level of gear upgrade has been increased from level 5 to level 10.
Other
https://sun9-77.userapi.com/impg/QiNIxGm0RFwHstU3ttRXEbQi3i-L9UXrJaROOw/7rb6OOnsdRc.jpg?size=807x454&quality=96&sign=2befd3a00387425a456d0b30841fc24d&type=album
The thematic merchant has left all the safe zones.
Thank you for your attention,
And good hunting in the Zone!

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [14.06.23]
historical_patches.text:
All inhabitants of the Zone – get ready! After completion of technical work, the assortment of merchants will be replenished with even more advanced equipment, and the Northern factions will open the possibility of forming their own subdivisions!
Factions and subfactions
Recruitment into Northern factions can now be targeted to specific categories of players - previously recruitment was either open or closed to all.
 | Added the ability to create a subdivision in the PDA. 
In the future, subdivision mechanics will include multi-stage team battles for various rewards, including possession of bases in the open world. This mechanic has a floating release date. The initial release date is August, however, we may move the release date to reflect the number of tier 2 and higher subdivisions in each faction. The sooner a strong backbone of subdivisions is formed, the sooner we will release the update, or if there is a shortage, the release date can be moved to late August or September.
Merchants
The assortment of northern faction merchants has also been updated in the 100 Rads bar:

• Vanguard Armored Suit – Duty

These suits can be worn as part of the specified factions and their respective factions in the south (bandits for Covenant and Mercenaries, stalkers for Duty and Freedom).
Balance
Shotguns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8be9b78788cca97c2b288c8be40a9bceadfb67c7.png
Fixed a bug that caused stopping power to be overestimated when using slug and buckshot.
Fixed a bug in calculating PvE efficiency of shotguns, therefore their characteristics have been changed:

Stashes

The stashes from Limansk will not be returned to the Personal Storage.
General

historical_patches.text:
| Maintenance work has been finished, we apologize for the inconvenience. 
Crow Arena game mode
Max Crow invites brave gladiators from all over the Zone to participate in Arena battles! Venturers are waiting for an explosive mixture of PvE and PvP, sprinkled on top with random modifiers. This crazy spectacle takes place in amazing scenery inspired by the legends of the Zone ... "Blue Sphere" and "Monolith", teams of "Orderlies" and "Blesseds" - Max Crow promises not just fights, but real theatrical action!
Detailed information about the new game mode is provided in this article.
 | Don't forget to watch the tutorial video before entering the Arena! 
The Max Crow Storyline
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ca96102be60361c6ccf7dfac7f0812edf978bacd.png
There are rumors that a veteran stalker named Max Crow has returned to the Zone. He organized an Arena at the Bar where members of all factions can fight for the title of Arena Champion! Will you be able to win this title?
Battle Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d54f1c35d72f4f87991b61bf64d2fdedd4e6543a.png
Fighting in the Arena will earn you Battle Pass points. The points received are equal for the whole team and depend on the percentage of creatures killed in each wave. The more monsters your team kills, the more points you get. And if you win, the number of points will be increased by 1.5 times.
Bonus points
We have also introduced a bonus points system. Every day, for the first few games, you will receive bonus BP points from your reserve. Bonus points are awarded at the end of the match and added to the points earned in the match.
• Points will be awarded until the player has used up the entire reserve. The reserve is updated at midnight server time.
• Battle Pass can be purchased, as before, in both personal and non-personal forms.
• Unused Battle Passes will automatically disappear after 30 days from the date of purchase in the in-game store.
Crow Arena Styles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/16bac02c6e1e42aefd0ac5967f002847dff9d72e.png
The case with thematic styles is back! In this delivery, you will find unique styles: Gladiator Lot for A-545, Crowd Favorite for Saturn, Crow Beak for knife and much more.

• Updated the sounds of sniper rifle shots from the 1st person view (with and without a silencer).
• Increased the volume of steps.
Subdivisions
Special Delivery
Special delivery suppliers have appeared on the bases of the Northern factions. And now they are available for members of subdivisions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/110fcd01bced283c73da7b20b926b02510bca1d3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/551084e1c276f75dd9286047d86fbd584ec30707.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/61e34a9af7ca34e781d1e11c83345bebb2f8e7ee.png
The mechanics are similar to delivery contracts, but there is a number of differences:
• Only members of subdivision with the rank of "Officer", "Colonel" and "Leader" can interact with the Special Delivery supplier.
• The deposit for delivery is taken from the treasury of the subdivision. For successful delivery, the unit receives a reward in the treasury and influence points.
• The delivery carrier cannot run.
Special deliveries are available for subdivisions starting from the 1st level and include 3 delivery contracts. With the increasing level of the subdivision, more complex and profitable deliveries will be opened.
Increasing level of the subdivision
The tasks for the increasing level of the subdivision from 1 to 2 and from 2 to 3 have been changed. Previously, with each level increase, it was necessary to find and hand over the Regalia to the quartermaster, now the composition of the tasks is as follows:
Increasing level of the subdivision 1 → 2
• Have 30 out of 30 members in the subdivision.
• Successfully completed 10 special deliveries.
Increasing level of the subdivision 2 → 3
• Win 6 stages on tournament captures for bases of level 1 and higher.
• To hand over to the quartermaster items in the amount of 2.500.000.
Quartermaster prices changed

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [08/16/23]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a07413feac0ba292c395603c089b182bfb1c45be.png
Clan conquests that are based on the tournament grid have been added to the game. The schedule of conquests is as follows:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4962422d387198ee95901f60e86374c5c897767d.png
The exact schedule and locations of the bases can be viewed by opening the "Base Conquest" tab in PDA.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e786782f6859560ad015d12e4f4aec6cec09d521.png
Registration for conquest
 | Subdivisions from level 2 and upwards may participate in tournament conquest. 
Subdivision members with the rank of Officer and higher can register their subdivision to participate in the conquest. To do this, select the base of interest on the map in the PDA and double-click on it to open the registration window. During registration the participation fee will be deducted from the subdivision treasury. You will be able to see the list of all participants of the conquest and the formed tournament grid after the end of registration.
 | Be aware! Once registered, you will not be able to register for a fight for another base until the current one has passed. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cc96785649a0534e5d28d434179dbffce9664b30.png
Preparation for conquest
After the registration is completed, a tournament grid is formed, which will divide all participating subdivisions into groups. There can be from 2 to 5 subdivisions in a group. Depending on the number of participating subdivisions, the tournament may last from 1 to 3 stages.
By default there is a truce between subdivisions of the same faction, but it is possible to declare a standoff against a friendly subdivision, which will allow you to fight it as part of a tournament conquest. The standoff is declared through the tournament grid GUI.
Conducting a conquest
Each stage lasts 35 minutes. 5 minutes are allocated for preparation: all participants enter the conquest location, purchase equipment and discuss tactics, the remaining 30 minutes is the battle itself to determine the winner of the group. Only subdivision members with the rank Private and above can participate in the conquest. To get to the conquest location you need to go to the "Conquests" tab in Session Battles and click on "Join".
In order to win, subdivisions need to capture and hold locations on the map while gaining points. The winner of the group is the subdivision with the most points.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/1a5907ea92f3070c10f483efdca3f0450a8a8c61.png
 | Example of a map and captured points 
Auxiliary structures
Playing conquests, fighters will often die and it will take a long time to run back to the points, and every second counts. Special structures will help to solve this problem.
Mobile camp
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7e782c95634c3a73cdc180b88a1a7f64362f0580.png
Purchased at the subdivision's main base by players with the rank of "Officer" or higher. The camp can be placed on the map to select it as a place of revival after death, as well as to purchase consumables there at the expense of the subdivision treasury. A suit capable of carrying heavy backpacks will be required to carry the camp. Only 1 mobile camp can be placed on the map at a time. 
• Purchase limit per capture: 3
Outpost
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6474624d0bd3ee86140697bb69aed2e0d25b7acf.png
Purchased at the subdivision's main base by players with the rank of "Sergeant" or higher. Carried in inventory. Allows the owner's squad to revive on it once every 40 seconds. You can't buy supplies there, but when reviving, players automatically receive a minimum set of necessary consumables. You can place 6 outposts on the map at a time, but no more than 2 per squad. 
• Purchase limit per capture: 6
Barricade
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ee5b019d0b9ad6025a9a9161bebd33f0bfb6eb3c.png
Can be purchased either at the subdivision's main base or at a mobile camp. Allows you to cover a vulnerable to attack camp, outpost or install a fortified firing point. You can place up to 10 barricades on the map at a time.
Auxiliary supplies
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a5bb1a5b19271cd07f758331cb1d7065dca6b522.png
In the mobile camp, players with the rank of Sergeant and above will be able to purchase such consumables as: HG-1 Rapture, KG-1 Toadstool and smoke grenades. HG-1 Rapture and KG-1 Toadstool grenades have a purchase limit of 15 per capture. Smoke grenades are limited to 30 pieces per conquest.
Rewards
For each successfully completed stage of the tournament, subdivision members will be sent a courier reward, and the subdivision will receive a rating, influence points, and money to their treasury.
Once the tournament is over, the base is under the control of the faction that the winning subdivision is a part of.
Details of the rewards can be found in the table below:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4085e2d4360671edbb18ab7d7cea69d741c8a132.png
*Bonus rating is awarded to a subdivision if it wins a tournament capture for a base in its "native" northern location. For the Covenant and Mercenaries, these are bases located in the "Red Forest" location, and for the Duty and Freedom, bases located in the "Yanov" location.
In a faction-controlled base, all faction members can use the safe zone storage, as well as NPC services.
Note that it is not possible to save on safe base zones, and the contents of the storage will be inaccessible if the faction ceases to own it.
Treasury Cashback
If a subdivision achieves a certain result but does not leave the group, it will be refunded a portion of the money in the treasury spent during the battle. The percentage of returned money depends on the stage of the tournament and the place in the group:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e49a26ad957ecb5d603f2399394df6b4984cffdc.png
If a subdivision came in 3rd place during the 2nd stage of the tournament and spent 300,000 from the treasury, it will be returned to its balance after conquest like this: 300,000 * 0.5 = 150,000 treasury
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/eafa6da60075214a850fda612477fc5edfcfeb2d.png

Extended magazine for OTs-14 Groza

Extended magazine for VSS/Val

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [10/11/23]
historical_patches.text:
Defense of bases
Deadly zones have been added around the main safe zones to prevent enemy players from getting too close to the bases. The restricted zone is divided into two parts, yellow and red.
Yellow zone
When entering the yellow area, the player is shown a recommendation to leave the borders of the enemy base.
If the player does not respond to the warnings, they take damage every 3 seconds.
Red Zone
If the player continues walking towards the enemy base and hits the red area, he dies instantly.
Updated Kill log
Now each nickname in the kill log has a different color depending on the player's relationship to you.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5a7e9fe28dfca204e7aade7f7878615e4041deb0.png
Gray – representatives of your faction and friendly northern factions.
Red – enemies.
Blue – members of your subdivision.
Green – members of your squad.
In addition, added faction icons and death marks for PvE.
Session battles
New session mode "King of the Hill"
All small-sized maps are now being played in "King of the Hill" mode. One capture point appears on each map. Each team's task is to capture and hold the point for 5 minutes.
 | On the "Prison" map for 10 minutes. 
If the point is lost, the timer is not reset.
Early Defeat
An "early defeat" feature has been added to medium-sized maps. If the losing team loses all points, a timer appears, after which the match will end with defeat. In order to reset the timer, the losing team must win at least one point.
New rules for capturing points
On the maps "Wormhole" and "Streets of Pripyat", points can only be captured in a given sequence.
 | A→B→C→D→E and vice versa for the opposite side. 
Combat Set Points Rework
Previously:
 | Participation points earned in session battles were directly converted to Combat Set points.
Now:
 | Each map has a Combat Set point fund that is distributed to all players who complete the match. 
At the end of the match, each player receives a percentage of the total point pool equal to the proportion of the session points earned.
By earning 10% of your participation points from the sum of all points in a session, you will receive 10% of your Combat Set points from the general fund.
Personal Fund
Each map has a pool of points, which the player needs to accumulate. After collecting some part of it, the player will get exactly the same part of points from the personal fund.
 | But if the player collects more than that, he will not get more points than there are in the personal fund. 
New rewards
Combat Set
The set, which is given out for 10,000 points, is no longer personalized. Its contents have also been revised:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7e08e0cbe1e024ff64f9550bdb0151210492bd88.png
Rewards for winning places

On small maps – 2 places.
On medium maps – 5 places.

historical_patches.title: "Dead man's marathon" [10/25/23]
historical_patches.text:
Every Halloween in STALCRAFT we celebrate with a big bang - this time you'll find a new game mode and a lot of festive content! The event will take place from October 25 to November 15 - don't miss it!
"Dead Man's Marathon" is the name of a TV show hosted by a team led by a certain Coach. The show is as simple as an early morning scavenger hunt:
• You land on Boral Island with a squad of three runners;
• Search for crates with equipment and various wunderwaffles;
• Fulfill the quests given by The Coach;
• Evacuate by a comfortable helicopter.
The unique atmosphere of the dead resort is additionally overshadowed by the squads of rival runners and a trio of "The Converted": especially creepy zombies armed with samurai swords. Rumor has it that The Coach also picks the "Converted" among the participants...
But it all doesn't matter, because you can easily blow them all away with cool modified guns with a huge variation of modules. And all of this under the thundering quips of a famous commentator, who narrates about your deeds to the entire Zone!
 | Be sure to read more about the game mode 
The Coach's storyline
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cd30dd14b27e8e96c5cb733d35dfdada8c1b98a7.png
The host of "Dead Man's Marathon", The Coach, offers you a series of challenging tests to conquer the popularity on his show...
Become a star of "Dead Man's Marathon" in an exciting storyline! To start the new quests, find The Coach in the Bar.
"Battle Pass"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f89de2007e58298e80284b5e243fb7d503d37a91.png
For any actions on the "Dead Man's Marathon" you will constantly receive "views" - they are the local currency. After the end of the race, all earned (including spent and lost) views are converted into "Battle Pass" points, in the format of 10 to 1.
 | If a participant is eliminated from the mode early, they are left with no Battle Pass points at all! 
Views earned on the run can be greatly multiplied by the following actions:
• Fulfillment of the squad's primary tasks;
• Successful evacuation.
For the first few games of the day, you will receive a daily bonus of Battle Pass points. Points are awarded for completing a match and are added to the main points earned. Bonus points will be awarded until the entire reserve is used up.
The "Battle Pass" can be purchased in a personalized or transferable form.
Unused "Battle Passes" will automatically disappear after 30 days from the date of purchase in the in-game store.
Barter coupons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/670934b485113ad94f8b6252ba13e531a641dd49.png
You can find a new addition to the free Battle Pass - Barter Coupons! They give a discount for bartering an item of the appropriate rank and type.
Coupons are divided according to the following criteria:
By rank:
• Stalker;
• Veteran;
• Master.
By type of equipment:
• For weapons and attachments;
• For armour.
By amount of discount:
• 30%;
• 20%;
• 10%.
Coupons have a limited validity period! They are valid until December 15, 2023.
Barter coupons are applied in the barter window. They affect the amount of resources required, but not the amount of cash value!
Quick marks for the squad
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/42bd84833cf14cfd12afe015e56ac8f57363a434.png
Quick squad marks have been added to the game. They can be placed at a distance of up to 200 meters.
If you hover over a mark, you can find out the distance to it.
A quick mark can be placed by pointing to the desired location and pressing the spot key "Tab". If another player hovers over the mark and presses "Tab", he will be able to draw the attention of his teammates to it - a notification will appear in the squad chat and a sound signal will be made.
To remove the mark, you need to press "Tab" on it again.
"Dead Man's Marathon" styles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/43043d6409f7499c1c21d35a35b71f684b33cb36.png
The new themed case features unique looks for weapons like the FN F2000 Tactical, the Shinobigatana and more. Available until November 15!
Permanent offer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/289b20d57f7f161fa0de92c34c5dc588981bffe8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ef7ade2f614f4ecfbc8beaa107df80045feae0ea.png
Starting this Halloween, we will be adding some of the styles to the permanent sale to commemorate the past holiday event. We are starting this wonderful tradition with the "Contender" (on Centurion) and "Peashooter" (on RSh-12).
 | Within 30 days you can buy these looks in special sets and get 3 "Armour Connoiseur" crates and premium for 14 days as a gift! 
Rework of the Backwater
Today, a particularly strong "Emission" has reshaped and expanded the landscape of “Backwater”. 
Monoliths soldiers have also become more active - convoys with psi-field antennas have been spotted, as well as new fanatics of special rank. But there is a silver lining! In “Backwater” you can now get new 
Master-tier equipment.
Rework and visual improvements 
The level design of "Backwater" and the appearance of its points of interest have been updated, additionally new territories in the south and east have been added. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/880e7a2e0c361c0864b5345b001b9ea426ef8548.png

The color correction and fog on the location have been changed.
Gameplay changes
• The value of rewards for completing activities in "Backwater" has been increased compared to the 
• locations "Red Forest" and "Yanov Outskirts";
• Digamma data fragments are now guaranteed to drop from signal stashes in “Backwater”;
• When you exit the game in “Backwater”, your character remains in the game. The character will die if you do not return to the game within 30 minutes;
• Lootable objects can now contain coins that can be sold to a fence;
• The base radius of visibility of events has been reduced from 300 meters to 120 meters;
• Placement of all activities on the location has been changed.
Entrance and exit from the location 
Hidden teleporters to “Backwater” have been added to “Red Forest” and “Yanov Outskirts”. They are not 
marked on the map and a teleporter disappears after one player uses it. It reappears after 5 minutes.
 | The are entry points that are suited for combat armor as well as for scientific armor. 
Changed the drop off zones in "Backwater ". Now drop-off takes place in a specially created "antechamber" in the southern part of the location.
There are 2 ways to leave the location:
• By clearing the group extraction event "Monolith Outpost", you can leave the location with a squad of up to five people.
• Leaving the location alone through one of the three "wandering teleport bubbles". The bubbles change their location immediately after use or after 2 minutes of inactivity.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/dda02f1e54dee37a92d8c356f253079abf6e917f.png

New enemies 
Sniper
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/90a74d3261170bcc22cdbb80e87b9b6e0ba80d54.png
 | Can be encountered as a part of “Monolith base” event or as a lone “hunter” in the port. 
You will notice the scope glare if you become sniper's target. The worse your agility, the easier it is for the sniper to hit the target.
Grenadier
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8dd098ba017e48c203fdaf12ba50d3fd95c9cbf2.png
 | Can be encountered in patrols, as well as in the events "Monolith Antenna", "Monolith Base", "Monolith Outpost". 
He has a supply of F-1 grenades and eagerly uses them to smoke enemies out of their cover.
Assault Trooper
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/278d4bc54c1a8cf2c1a7248e12e0b24b75ff7f8a.png
 | Can be encountered in the "Monolith Base” and “Monolith Outpost” events. 
Quickly closes the distance and deals a lot of damage with his shotgun. Also has several flash bang grenades in his arsenal.
Machinegunner
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2a31689a4ec7e531553b144e8ef1b1dcb371912e.png
 | Can be encountered in the "Monolith Base" and "Monolith Outpost" events. 
Fires long suppressive bursts at the last enemy cover.
New Events
"Monolith Antenna"
In "Backwater" from time to time appear groups of Monolith soldiers, who set up their strange installations. "Antenna" goes through two phases : startup and active operation. During the startup phase, it poses no threat except for its guards. During the active phase, the "Monolith Antenna" emits level 4 Psy contamination throughout the area.
 | The event has a visibility radius of 400 meters. 
The installation can only be broken if you shoot at it within range. This area is shown on the map. For 
destroying the "Monolith Antenna" you will receive "Psy-trackers" as a reward, as well as items to sell to the fence. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ce830bc58b150fab11ee268e662654a13e35b15f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fce29066865da43a5b31dace898855d9f88828c2.png
"Monolith Base".
The objective of the event is to clear an area occupied by 20 Monolith soldiers, some of whom have their own special traits. The event is designed to be cleared by a group of players, so it has a bigger reward of resources and reputation.
 | The event has a visibility radius of 300 meters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/73b0b4f0d2a1977f7b71ee29752d1469459ccc92.png
"Protoelectro Cluster."
An event that is familiar to players from previous stages of the game. The completion time of this event has been reduced compared to its "southern" variants. For successfully completing the event objective, you will receive Digamma data fragments and items to sell to the fence.
 | The event has a visibility radius of 80 meters.

A fence of trading packs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7e9c4b87e81d83887b5c6c04a8a3925ae40f9dc3.png
A merchant has settled in one of the shelters on the location, who will be interested in buying trading packs lost by other players.
Airdrop changes
Along with the changes to “Backwater”, the mechanics of airdrops have also changed.
• Tools for equipment improvement and component packs for the recovery of max durability have been put into a separate "guaranteed reward" category for the event.
• In the airdrops at the locations "Red Forest" and "Yanov outskirts", master-tier component packs (20% 
• max durability recovery) have been replaced with master-tier components (5% max durability recovery)
• Veteran-tier component packs were removed from “Backwater” airdrops and master-tier components were added.
• Clan airdrops have been reclassified as "sugar" airdrops and are displayed on the map in the appropriate blue color.
• "Glowing Sugar" is no longer considered a barter item and will drop on death until it is delivered to a safe zone.
"Glowing Sugar" obtained by players prior to the update will remain bound to them.
“Golden Airdrop"
Every 3 hours from 10 to 22 server time (EU: UTC+1, NA: UTC-5, SEA: UTC+8) there is an airdrop. It contains various tools, spare parts, 
"Combat Peas", food crates, consumables and a "Weapon Case". The latter contains parts of new weapons 
and master-tier attachments.
 | The mechanics of hacking airdrops on the "Backwater" have been changed. 
The "defense" stage of an airdrop has been removed, and part of the time allotted for defense has been 
transferred to the "drop" stage. In order to get the contents of an airdrop, you must continuously breach it for:
• 5 seconds - regular airdrop;
• 10 seconds - "sugar" airdrop;
• 20 seconds - "golden" airdrop.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5a53c4f9e2da09ccd8190310dafb530e94cf784d.png
 | After breaching, the contents of the container will be available to all players! 
This is not a complete rework of airdrops, but only one part of it.
New weapons and attachments
New Master Weapons:
• AM-17 (temporarily uses the AK-12 model);
• Scorpion EVO III;
• SIG Sauer P320.
New Master attachments:
• Viking Tactics UVG tactical grip;
• Lantac BMD flash hider for 5.45 and 5.56 calibers;
• Lantac Dragon flash hider for 7.62 caliber;
• P320 extended magazine for 24 rounds;
• Scorpion drum magazine for 50 rounds.
New items can be obtained by collecting all the necessary parts from the "Weapon Case". You can assemble the parts into one item through bartering at the bases of the northern factions of the 7th level or in the bar "100 Rads".
Parts of the items cannot be exchanged for each other, but you can sell unneeded ones for Crimson Casings.
Balance changes
Karbach OTL-03
• Damage now increases with distance;
• Damage at distance 95 → 105;
• Damage reduction start distance 20 → damage increase start distance 50;
• Damage reduction end distance 60 → damage increase end distance 100.
Models, animations, sounds
• Updated interaction animations and sounds for MP-153, Protecta
• Updated F2000 sprint animation (now similar to other bullpup weapons)
Other changes and fixes
• Removed chaotic movement of the character when moving on slopes with the "cling" key pressed. In addition, when ctrl+q is pressed, the player will not go to the lying position after climbing on any surface;
• Visually updated paint patterns for FN F2000, FN F2000 Tactical, A-545 and AS Val;
• Added guitar melodies in honor of the autumn event;
• Reward markers are now also hidden when the "Event waypoints in the world" setting is turned off;
• Stash markers can now also be turned off;
• Roulette animation added to the interface of opening cases;
• Fixed incorrect silencer position on SR-1 "Gyurza";
• Fixed incorrect display of modules on FN P90;
• Fixed incorrect animations of Karbach OTL-03 and updated interaction sounds;
• Updated NATO drum magazine model.
Thanks for your attention,
And have a good hunt at the Marathon!

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [11/22/23]
historical_patches.text:
Barter changes
For all barter recipes, the amount of Anomalous Serum required has been reduced by ~30%
Sessional battles
Prohibition of certain ammunition
In session battles there is now a mechanic that prohibits certain items from being carried through personal storage.
When an item from this list is added to the player's inventory, an information window will appear and the item will disappear. After the player leaves session battles, the item will return to his inventory.
At the moment, all available explosives, including flash-bang grenades have been banned. Now you can only use this ammunition if you purchase it from a merchant inside a session battle.
Automatic loading of purchased ammunition
When a player is revived, his weapon will be loaded with the ammo he purchased or unpacked.
If there are several types of suitable ammunition, the ones closest to the beginning of the inventory will be loaded.
Merchants on points
An ammo crate has appeared at each capture point in session battles, from which you can buy ammunition.
Other changes
• he safe zone on the "Glass" map no longer blocks the staircase on the third floor.
• The safe zone on the map "Hospital" now does not extend into the corridor of the second floor.
• The reward for a prize place has been changed: players will now receive 250 parts instead of the Pouch of Army First-Aid Kits.
• The player will no longer receive an additional grenade in the inventory.
• Increased the reward for assaulting and defending a point in King of the Hill mode 25 → 100
• Fixed the ability to shoot from a safe zone on all maps.
• All grenade launchers are now given 1 charge each.
• Removed invulnerability when entering session mode.
• Purchased consumables are no longer lost after warming up.

Balance

Backwater
Airdrop rewards have been adjusted:
Weapon case

Other changes
• Fixed areas with level 4 infections on Backwater. The areas have been expanded and fitted closely together.
• The science drop zone on Backwater is now completely covered in level 4 radiation.
• The invincibility when entering Zaton via "scientific" paths has been reduced 10 → 7 seconds.
• The burned farmstead is now completely under level 3 thermal infection.
• The number of human and mutant events in the level 4 infection zone at Backwater has been reduced.
• The number of bloodsuckers in Backwater events has been reduced 5 → 4
• From the group of center bubbles, 2 bubbles that were outside of the level 4 infection area have been removed. In their place, a bubble in the archianomaly behind the Gas Station has been added. The central group of bubbles is now considered "scientific" and ejects players to Red Forest and Yanov Outskirts in level 4 infection areas.
• Added new exit points to the Red Forest and Yanov Outskirts from Backwater via the "Monolith Outpost" event.

Models, animations, sounds
Updated the model of super-heavy armored suit "Granite":

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [12/06/23]
historical_patches.text:
🆕 Server maintenance has been extended for 1 hour. We apologize for the inconvenience.
New graphics engine
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/15a6314f532fea0b6e735ed9b05e85a850a5bb50.png
During the year our development team has been working hard to create a new foundation for the graphical component of the game. The old technologies were completely scrapped and the whole approach to graphics rendering was reimagined. Today we are releasing the new Stalcraft graphics engine!
 | As in the case of Artificial Intelligence, now we have created only the technical base and tools for further improvement of the graphical component of the game. We will have a significant amount of work to optimize and eliminate any incompatibilities and flaws.
The release of a new graphics engine inevitably involves a lot of bugs and flaws. Developers physically cannot have all the necessary PC configurations to cover everything with internal tests.
At the end of the OTS we didn't find any critical bugs, and we lacked enough participants to get a complete picture of the problems. Since the snow at the New Year's event is already made on the new engine - we decided to speed up the detection of bugs and release the graphics engine as soon as possible to have time to fix everything! 
At this point, the entire color correction has been changed, which has noticeably brightened the game, bringing the gray point to more comfortable values. The fog effects have also been updated, which can't help but please many players!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b770c624db42705d82c83d166bbe6830bd3f3c64.png
We will try to keep further plans for updating the graphics a secret, as we don't want to spoil the surprise and we are going to surprise you!
Backwater
The zombies that appear after the player dies near the Monolith antennas have stopped using improperly functioning weapons.
Auto-balance in session battles
A new system of automatic player balancing has been implemented in session battles. The experimental system seeks to equalize both teams in terms of player strength and number of players.
The system will be improved as statistics and feedback are collected.
