historical_patches.title: New Year's event [12/20/23]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5844974817ac76f5ec51905d6320b1ef3f84a28e.png
New Year metamorphosis has finally reached the harsh Zone, which will stay with us for the next 3 weeks! Snow covered the entire 30-kilometer area, in honor of which the locals ran to dress up the holiday tree and receive daily gifts under it.
Snowy weather
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5094f3d66352f044d008168c99b1e566760d5337.png
All locations are covered with snow, experienced travelers are already advising to update the camouflage on the suits. The inhabitants of safe zones were immediately inspired by the weather, and worked on their New Year's decorations.
In locations south the Red Forest and Yanov, a truce is active within the main faction (mercenaries and covenant, duty and freedom)
In anomalies, along with regular artifacts, icy ones will sometimes appear (they don't form on their own).
Christmas tree
On the bases players get their own Christmas tree, which can be decorated with Christmas toys. Each toy will bring a certain number of points to the Christmas tree, thus increasing the level of the tree itself.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/009f9fd7bc1694b030f9cde1329a730541664129.png
All Christmas tree decorations are organized into groups - the stricter you stick to a certain theme while decorating your Christmas tree, the higher the level becomes. It is also affected by the rarity of the ornaments themselves.
 | For every set of ornaments you collect, except for the story set, you'll get a themed paint and keychain reward! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0800de867226c1ae6bd2e55f6e4a85443b319112.png
Interacting with the Christmas tree is done through an interface where you can change toys, track your Christmas tree level, and look at your friends' Christmas trees.
The level of the Christmas tree affects the daily rewards under the Christmas tree - the higher the level, the better the rewards. Rewards are updated at полночь по московскому времени.
In all safe zones, where there is a Christmas tree, you can find a merchant with a simple nickname "Exchanger" - you can sell unwanted ornaments to him for event currency, as well as buy themed crates, gifts with toys for the tree and fireworks!
Christmas tree ornaments
Christmas tree ornaments can be found or obtained from the following activities::
• Gifts scattered throughout the locations, as well as crates and barrels;
• Human and mutant camps (with some chance from normal events);
• New Year's location bosses;
• New Year's Airdrops.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/72ca6242e86a5585edb916a0f83771ec888ed4d7.png
 | The farther north you climb - the more valuable the gifts will be! 
Also, gifts can be obtained in the session modes.
Gifts and Christmas tree ornaments will be removed from the game after the event is over!
Combining ornaments
Don't be in a hurry to throw away duplicate Christmas tree ornaments! If you combine them together, you will get an improved toy, which gives a little more points. To get an outstanding Christmas tree, you will have to improve all the toys several times.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/11400399e5a0d8ec77e8cea2488a5d83136632d3.png
Leaderboard
Upon reaching the 7th level of the Christmas Tree, you will be able to take part in the competition for the most beautiful Christmas Tree.
 | The results of all players will be displayed in the general leaderboard, which will allow you to track your current position, and the necessary number of points to win. 
At the end of the event will take place summarization, where each participant will receive an award, depending on the place taken in the leaderboard.
New open-world events
The bosses
More than a dozen themed bosses have appeared on the locations. They pose a serious threat, so stock up on ammo and reliable friends!
Frost protoanomalies
Frost protoanomalies are now appearing in random places in the Zone. These are mysterious icicles falling on stalkers' heads straight from the sky!
Random mutants
You can find roaming ice mutants all over the Zone. They are a bit stronger than their kin, but for killing them you will get Pine, for which you can buy themed loot from the merchant.
Dangerous mutants
Sometimes you will come across areas with dangerous mutants. They can be comparable to bosses in terms of strength, but they also give you more Pine for them. 
New Year's Airdrops
Instead of regular airdrops, holiday airdrops are now being dropped! You can get some gifts and Battle Pass points from them.
Battle Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ec89b927866d8183b85ccad1c363e56a06f46dec.png
The main part of the Battle Pass is traditionally 90 levels. There are several ways to improve this pass:
Challenges
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7793492d1dcfaa0a35e35e11063fda12f4dad3ef.png
 | First level 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/edd09a0071c30a4fcb81609bd607277391320eb5.png
 | Second level 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f13a8a0202042c01f82ceecd71f32ed9873d8e48.png
 | Third level 
Essentially, challenges are a themed set of achievements that will earn you Battle Pass points for completing. You will receive notifications when you complete the challenge
There are currently 30 challenges available, and more will be added each week.
New Year's errands
Once a day you can complete one New Year's errand. As a reward, you will receive several levels of Battle Pass, valuable barter and various consumables.
The errands on The Swamp base can be received from the second level. On other bases they can be received at the entrance to the safezone.
Also, battle pass points can be earned for completing various open world events.
A mini-raid on the Frost Giant
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/54436cf4b9a75fcb2520e7405a7fd116f9d5dcb4.png
 | Meet Rudolph! 
Every several hours you can start a battle with the Frost Giant. This is a very strong boss, for the battle with which several dozens of players will gather.
You can start searching for a raid using the "Queue" button in the Battle Pass window.
For defeating the Giant, you will receive gifts and Battle Pass points.
New Year's storyline
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a5c363ff966ea9e38cdfe556279631fe83c3a7af.png
The Zone is in danger again! Team up with Snegurochka, save the world from interfacing with the Noosphere and send the girl home!
This time, the entire storyline is available starting from the first week of the event. To get the first mission, visit any safezone starting from Cordon.
In-game store
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8383c8a57fbadea27b9047b550c9263519cef20a.png
Christmas tree sets, new equipment sets and crates with unique styles, as well as New Year's discounts will be available in the in-game store until January 10!
The styles of "Anomalous Winter"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/22765fde5652f8269142d9758e7b066289a525b0.png
The new themed crate features unique styles for weapons: the VSS-M, Ice Axe and more. Available until January 10!
Permanent offer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/106f743c0532b3ae404f2a76f8f1c11bccb46a31.png
Continuing the tradition of Dead Man's Marathon, we continue to add some styles to the permanent sale, in honor of the holiday event.
"Anomalous Winter" offers you 2 new styles: "Winter Soldier" on AH-6 and "Taiga Wind" on A-545.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/bffee53ce213086c93694d03d4913f2aa1a18069.png
 | "Winter Soldier" on AH-6 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/790c1f119c13de5df86ad731700ed8296593653a.png
 | "Taiga Wind" on A-545 
For 30 days you can purchase these styles in special bundles and get 3 Connoisseur Cases and premium for 14 days as a gift!
Christmas tree bundles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c2bdceffab7d2afb8cc41d5be2ccf00b9cb10021.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3fdfdf8be43d61e2e8097977efd54de6eab29348.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/35f69fcf4750a353ad4819f56127f605323e4336.png
Airdrops
Airdrops in Limansk have been switched to a reward system similar to that of airdrops in the North:
• Equipment Improvement Tools and Durability Restoration Kits have been moved to a separate "guaranteed reward" category per event.
• Pack of master components (20% max durability recovery) have been replaced by master components (5% max durability recovery).
Schedule of Tournament Captures
Sunday base captures were removed for the New Year's holiday. We wish you a good time with your family and friends!
Merging barter resource belts
The development team has long noticed that most players leave the game when they reach the locations of Dump or Rostok Factory, where the difficulty of barter resources gathering increases. On this basis, it was decided to exclude special resources located in these locations and make farming easier.
To keep you motivated to farm resources in the central locations (Dump and Rostok), they will drop significantly more resources from events than the side locations.
Removed resources
Pieces of Aluminum Cable, Seeds, Blue Yeast, Piece of Infernal Coal, Chlorinex, Zoneshroom, Digamma Data Fragment, Remains of Scientific Equipment, Rusty Mold, Digamma Group Tracker.
All removed resources will be completely replaced with resources at a 1:1 ratio.
With the removal of the resources of the "Digamma" group the following resources are converted:
• Fragments and data blocks, as well as trackers of the "Gamma" group, to resources of the "Beta" group;
• Fragments and data blocks, as well as trackers of the "Digamma" group, to resources of the "Gamma" group.
Among other things, all barter offers that include deleted resources will be updated. However, the time to farm resources for these offers will remain unchanged.
New distribution of barter resources across locations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/740b5dce30c2299259969111974aefb3d41b34f3.png
New offers
Dealer has new offers that allow you to trade old unused resources for their counterparts used to barter gear.
Chronorifts
A new event, chronorifts, has been added to Backwater.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0a8c6d56c6fa264e54c624d7d51eaed5069e818f.png
The chronorift begins to nucleate 30 minutes after the end of the emission. In order to start the event, you need to find its signal using SAK-1.
To initiate a chronorift, you must buy a chronoinstallation from the subdivision intendant for treasury currency; however, it can only be purchased by members with a rank of at least "Officer" who are in a second or third level subdivision.
The number of chronoinstallations purchased per day is limited and depends on the level of the unit:
• Second level subdivision - 5 pieces per day;
• Third level subdivision - 10 pieces per day.
Keep in mind that the chronoinstallation will drop when you die!
Once a player has placed a chronoinstallation near a chronorift, a notification is sent to all players on the location.
The operation of the chronoinstallation is divided into two stages:
• The startup stage, during which the installation starts up;
• The extraction stage, during which resources from the rift gradually appear in the chronoinstallation.
The time of the stages is displayed on the player's screen.
When the chronoinstallation finishes, the main part of the reward appears.
The resources are not divided among the participants of the event, they can be taken by any player at once.
During the chronoinstallation operation it can be destroyed by any player!
New unique resources can be farmed from the chronorift, which can be:
• Sell them to a merchant in exchange for rubles;
• Give them to a unit intendant for the unit treasury;
• Split into energy by a scientist;
• Exchange them for items at the Dealer (more on this below).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b6b5652a6a2112291737bcfa5bb3c73a874ac6c9.png
Also, at the end of the rift operation you are always guaranteed to get a chronosphere, for which many traders of the Zone are ready to give a considerable amount of money!
With the addition of new resources, the following offers have been added to the Dealer:
• Anomalous Serum;
• Reset Essence;
• Changing Serum.
All items except "Anomalous Serum" can be auctioned or transferred to another player.
"Anomalous Serum" has a limit of 10 items per week.
Seasonal ranking rewards for subdivisions
The game now has seasons, at the end of which the units that manage to gain the most ranking points for participating in tournament battles receive various rewards.
The rewards are categorized into:
• Subdivision bonuses;
• Personal rewards for subdivision members.
You can see what rewards are available for the top positions of the season on the subfaction's main page on the right side of the PDA.
Subdivision bonuses
If a subdivision ranks in the top 10 at the end of the season, it is rewarded with bonuses valid until the end of the next season. Subdivision bonuses apply to all its members and are also summed up with subfaction and premium bonuses.
The received bonuses can be viewed in the new "Bonuses" tab.
Personal rewards for a subdivision member
At the end of the season, personal rewards are sent by courier to subdivision players who finished in the top 10 at the end of the season.
To receive a personal reward, a participant must meet the following criteria:
• Have a rank of Private or higher;
• Participate in at least half of the capture stages in which the subdivision participated.
If a player fails to meet at least one of the criteria, he will not receive a personal reward.
Criteria do not affect subdivision bonuses.
Sledgehammer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/abde082580b6e51c59a103ab4636b1eae4a06013.png
A new melee weapon of legendary rank, the Sledgehammer, has been added to the game.
Sledgehammer has a unique damage modifier that allows it to deal increased damage to structures and all destructible objects - barricades, enemy tents, etc.
Destroying the Monolith Antenna with a sledgehammer.
To barter a sledgehammer, you must collect 4 of its parts, and have a 7th level reputation of the subfaction base.
Subdivision Crates
Crates can be obtained as a personal reward at the end of the ranking season, or can be bought for Crimson Casings from the Dealer.
The contents of the crates depend on the subdivision.
To buy a subdivision crate, a player must be in a subdivision of that subfaction and have base reputation level 7.
Contents of the crates:
• Parts of master weapons, attachments, and sledgehammer;
• New camouflages for weapons and armor;
• Subdivision knives, character skins and keychains;
• New consumable - Champion's Breakfast;
• Spare Parts.
Some of the unwanted items can be turned in to the Dealer for Crimson Casings.
Season "December 2023"
The first season of tournament captures will start on December 1st will last until December 31st, 2023.
Once the season ends, subdivision bonuses will be in effect from 00:00:00 on January 1st until 00:00:00 on February 1st, 2024.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6d9a99357600c603f330ac793d41409650d2e19b.png

historical_patches.title: How compensation is arranged
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c3eb765a4d0dae800e0fbbc660cab5c039134be3.png
In this short article, we want to shed a little more light on how our compensation decisions are made and who does it. Those who read it carefully will be theoretically armed for future economic and balance changes!
Compensation Department
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9b68fa2803c2c9f06035abfcf59a04374793642e.png
STALCRAFT is a constantly evolving and changing game, and any changes always leave someone dissatisfied. To mitigate this, we came up with a compensation mechanism, which proved itself well and didn't initially seem like a daunting task.
However, the further into the woods we got, the more it became clear that there was no single regulation for all possible situations, and we needed to actively apply an individual approach to each of them, especially when it came to rebalances, barter changes and other sensitive areas for players.
Quite quickly we came to the conclusion that we need to form a separate team of "elite fighters", consisting of experienced specialists who together can think of the most elegant and compromising compensations possible!
 | The Compensation Department is a group of responsible people consisting of employees from the analytics, game design, programmers and security departments. 
The department has an idea of all the upcoming changes in advance, decides on the need for compensation for one or another update, as well as determines their composition and deals with the direct implementation.
At first glance it sounds simple, but in reality the department constantly has to balance between various "spiky" and other unpleasant chairs to find the solution that will sufficiently satisfy the players, will not damage the economy, and will maintain confidence in our decisions.
Types of compensations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/23cafdc68b3b45727bd6e5960dec0731132eb327.png
We haven't told much about how our compensations are organized, so it's a completely dark forest for players, from which for unknown reasons a promo code will fly out, or a handful of exchange coins in the inventory, or suddenly a free upgraded gun will be given.
There's nothing much to tell about the simplest compensations, like promo codes for unscheduled maintenance or other malfunctions - everything is in our posts in plain sight. Another thing is in-game bugs and changes. And this is where we will try to dispel the darkness!
So, at the moment we can distinguish three main types of compensation for in-game bugs or changes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6e77abc1bdb3e4dec801610f045a35c0159594d7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a660519da91f1fb30da31657ecae669f020f03da.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/435603d49a633ab3e52d9ba34a5159e80842da0a.png
 | Important clarification - when calculating large compensations, we take into account player activity over the last year from the release date of the changes. 
Usually, the "generosity" of compensation is strongly influenced by the number of people who will receive it. And if you constantly strive to serve absolutely the entire player base of "Stalcraft", it will be nearly impossible to offer anything of value in compensation.
Therefore, we have worked out for ourselves the optimal rule - to consider as affected those players who participated in the activity during the year. For example, farmed during the year for barter, which was later greatly simplified.
Feedback from players: what does it affect?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/feece558339aa4077d1922b223b8740fed53b82c.png
We, of course, listen very carefully to players on all resources and centrally collect and analyze their feedback through tech support, speakers and moderators.
Sometimes there are cases when somewhere there is an oversight, undersight, omission. And players always pay attention to it successfully - we don't remember that anything like that has ever escaped their omnipresent eye!
However, close work with feedback and frequent response to players' requests had an unexpected opposite effect - some people started to think that by actively complaining and making a big deal out of it they could get a better compensation and influence the developers' decisions.
Here we would like to note separately that such behavior only harms the audience - it creates background noise, behind which the real problems may not be seen. Just like in the fairy tale with the boy and the wolves!
That is why it is important to deny selfish thoughts and write only honest feedback from the heart!
That's all for now! We hope that we have more or less managed to familiarize you with the work of the Compensation Department and shed at least a little light on the existing processes. You will remember us again next month!
With love,
EXBO Compensation Department

historical_patches.text:

It hasn't been a couple of days since we fixed everything and rolled out our global update, so hold on! After all, it's time to take out a bunch of equipment, add the upgrade guarantees, overhauled barter and spice up the whole thing with a whole MOUNTAIN of COMPENSATION!
Change of equipment upgrade system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b2e6ad98bd41da8cfd4dc47a40e8041e0ceaa8bc.png
We've significantly overhauled the gear upgrade system to make it more predictable and player-friendly. Most importantly, we added a guaranteed upgrade after a certain number of attempts.
Spare parts have been renamed "Parts", which have been graded: cheap, standard, and advanced. Parts and tools can now be obtained through open world activities!
 | Parts are also a requirement for gear upgrades. 
We found the whole upgrade level lowering thing too "toxic", so we just added an ability to get spares (get used to it, that's what we call spare parts now) in-game and made them mandatory!
Guaranteed upgrade of equipment
Guaranteed equipment upgrade has been added to the game. It is activated after a certain number of attempts.
 | If the upgrade is successful before the guarantee is triggered, the guarantee counter resets to zero. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3d227ec8822a29c8c2d53605decc3d0a834f2260.png
Changes to parts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ee6afd73b12315f32ca3eb4ef56259feaff43abb.png

The equipment maintenance window has been refined. This was done to harmonize with the new design of the upgrade window.
 | Also, the function of disassembling equipment into components was removed - this decision is due to the fact that the function was more harmful and hemorrhoidal than useful. 
Changes to tools
The functionality of cheap tools has been changed - now they allow you to modify equipment only up to level 5! The gradation of tools will remain the same: cheap, standard and advanced. Similar to parts, they can now also be obtained by completing events in the open world.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/36a8153d0b58e12b704426c22a5fea1a516cf1c2.png
Compensation for changes to the upgrade system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cbe3e42712c7aaae5ed8fc1bfba5ba5e9294aef5.png
All spare parts that are currently in the game are exchanged for "Advanced Parts" at a 1:1 ratio.
We have also been careful to compensate active players for the difference between the old and new systems. To find out what the compensation for your gear is, click on the item in your inventory and select «Compensation» from the gear context menu.
 | You can learn more about compensation in a special article. 
Barter rework
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/535116f3f00315b19dfd50d390b84e05a176f499.png

Many branches have received their endings in the form of high-tier guns at level 6 of the base. In addition, prices for various equipment were partially revised and new barter branches were created.
The work on the rebalancing of modules has been going on for a very long time and several times came to a dead end. We made the willful decision to remove handguards and buttstocks as separate attachments in order to finally have a working system.
 | Now the further a gun is down the barter branch, the cooler its modularity!

• Machine guns;
• Pistols;
• Melee Weapons;
• Muzzles;

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [21.02.24]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f9317cd1edaa0bac3b8bc5cc1ddd30c7e5c24885.png
Netcode
The server stops processing player movement if incoming traffic is delayed for more than 3 second. That is, if your internet goes down for 5 seconds, you will find that your character remains where it was 5 seconds ago. In addition, any shots fired during that time will not be registered.
The ammo counter is now correctly synchronized if the server has not registered a shot. Also, this counter is now instantly updated when changing the active weapon.
Reduced the speed of processing movement for players experiencing minor connection stability issues. Previously, a "lagging" player would move jerkily at a speed up to x2 of normal, now - up to x1.5.
 | Unfortunately, this solution is a compromise - it means that it will now take twice as long to restore stable game performance after a brief network instability. 
During shooting, the character's movement and rate of fire can no longer be accelerated to compensate for unstable connectivity.
The principle of speedhack protection has been changed. Now, if the server thinks your game is running too slow or too fast, you will no longer be disconnected from the server. Instead, the same thing will happen as with connection problems: you will be slightly teleported back and synchronization will be restored.
Fixed the possibility to get infinite stamina with forbidden modifications of the game.
Parts
Tripled the chance of getting cheap parts and doubled the chances of getting standard and advanced parts for open world events.
 | The change in the chance of getting parts was made based on analytics data. We continue to monitor the number of parts and tools received further. 
Thank you for your attention,
and good hunting in the Zone!

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [01.03.24]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e2d81fb1d4dc0287e286fff4ad20af109a16e57a.png
"When the earth suddenly awoke from its winter sleep in spring, the wise old man sat by the roadside and watched the awakening laborers with his gaze. "'Battle pass will not plow itself,' he said softly to a passing young man, reminding him that behind every miracle of scarlet equipment there is hard work and faith in the future crops."
©️ Yevgeny, son of Belly
What's going on?
Quarterly Events and Battle Passes have been replaced by new game mechanics: Season, Seasonal Event, and Season Pass!
Seasons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a3d6629b9e5cfaf75af3a2ab6392f22915217c28.png
This is a new game mechanic that allows players to receive additional new content every 3 months, often coinciding with the arrival of a new season.
 | Each season has a different theme, which can be the same for the entire Year called Act, or completely different from season to season. 
There are 4 seasons within one Act. The current season, Slavic Spring, is from Act 1 and is season zero. In Act 1, there will be as many as 5 seasons instead of 4, so that players can purchase the items and equipment they want. Each Act will have its own name, for the convenience of the players.
 | Each season now offers players a progress bar similar to the free Battle Pass. 
As the season progresses, players can receive: unique seasonal content, consumables and materials that facilitate gameplay, as well as a special currency - battle coupons. Throughout the season, various updates with different content are possible. Each season has its own key rewards and final reward.
 | Season progression increases as Season Points are earned. A reward is provided at each level. The higher the level - the better the reward! 
Among the main sources of getting seasonal points:
 Out of season event:
 During a seasonal event:
 | 
• Completing the main storyline;
• Completing the daily seasonal tasks (described below);
• Obtaining Act Tokens (described below).
 | 
• Participating in the event itself;
• Receiving a daily bonus;
• Completing weekly seasonal challenges;
• Completing seasonal challenges.
 | Outside of the seasonal event, players will receive far fewer seasonal points than during the event, because that's the way it is! After the seasonal event, there will be additional sources of seasonal points. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d21e0bf75d46be0fe88bb8854e7c2830b5acbd64.png
Thus the season is divided into three phases:
- Warm-up before the seasonal event (few sources of seasonal points);
- Seasonal event (many sources of seasonal points);
- The final stage (average number of seasonal point sources).
At the end of the Seasonal Event, players will be able to earn Seasonal Points for some in-game activities in the open world.
Seasonal event
These are familiar to everyone events. The Seasonal Event significantly expands the number of sources of Seasonal Points, which means that during the event players can significantly increase their Seasonal Progress and get a lot of themed rewards!
Season pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a3d6629b9e5cfaf75af3a2ab6392f22915217c28.png
This is a new in-game entity that works similarly to the old Premium Battle Pass. The Season Pass allows players to unlock additional themed rewards, camouflages and unique motifs, as well as extra materials and some more coupons.
 | In addition to various consumables, themed keychains, and paints, there are a certain number of key rewards in the season battle pass. 
Among the key rewards are unique seasonal paints and coupons, as well as various veteran gear. This equipment will allow a player who has recently started to conquer the Zone to make his gameplay a little easier, as it includes a set of "Veteran" level from armor, primary and secondary weapons, as well as melee weapons.
This time we have not forgotten about hardened masters and prepared for them a special, Final Award - master weapon. For this season it is the RPL-20 Light Machine Gun.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/614374a35f3f953fbdbb00cc6689ae0dbdfcaf14.png
This weapon is currently unique and will only be available as part of the final reward of the current season until at least the end of Act I.
Once you reach level 500 and receive a reward, you can continue to increase your progress, now it's even more profitable as there is a new recurring reward mechanic.
Each level up now earns you rewards in a repeating cycle. Once you've earned rewards for all five levels, a new cycle with the same rewards will begin.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e277b87cd01dd107ece2dcab02745265e5133844.png
These mechanic is designed to make the rewards more varied, but still leaves the seasonal crates that players love!
You can view all the rewards within the game by clicking on the "VIEW ALL REWARDS" button on the progress screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c253717c9b02ca157e9717f7c9bf23347a9f48c1.png
Motifs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f5d17d45df426028c8d9a0cda40ce080b2af235c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/370a727a035fea75bf23606e6d66f7c949e088dd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f3f66aa4395d86b565f5d5df72322673dad7280a.png
Motifs is a new customization element that allows you to change the name, description and paint pattern of your gear without changing its silhouette. Now you can customize your gear even better! Motives are worn in the Motives / Appearances slot.
 | Motifs also allow you to keep the memories of a particular Seasonal Event and will not be lost when removed, even if you have a copy of the issued weapon that you have already upgraded. 
Tickets
Tickets are a new currency used as part of the Season Pass. You can only get them through seasonal rewards!

 | "Slav's Coffer" is guaranteed to give 100 Tickets and, if you're lucky, 50 to 100 additional Tickets. 
 | "Slavic boyar chest" is guaranteed to give 200 Tickets and, if you are lucky, 50 to 100 additional Tickets. 
The player can exchange Tickets for equipment and consumables at an NPC named "Commerce":
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/1f30132d2af57241474274e807089acca700f6d6.png

So what is being sold for Tickets?
• Season Pass, in non-personalized form;
• Weapon and armor blueprints from the seasonal crate that are available this season. You can now buy missing blueprints with Tickets if RNG god has been unkind to you;
• Equipment to speed up your progress and diversify your gameplay. From beginner to veteran level;
• Various consumables, materials, parts, seasonal crates, etc.
And, most importantly, an Albatross Heavy Assault Armored Exoskeleton for Tickets!
"Assault Exo", like "Gauss", can be acquired piece by piece, which will naturally take more than one season, as it is legendary level gear.
We have separated the Albatross Heavy Assault and the Gauss-Rifle into blueprints so that you don't have to necessarily play every season to collect them.

Seasonal challenges must be completed in order to receive Battle Pass points. Seasonal challenges include: daily challenges, weekly challenges and trials.

• Daily seasonal challenges are challenges that you will receive every day during the season. Seasonal points and challenge tokens are awarded for completing a challenge. For 25 challenge tokens, you will receive a special reward.
If you do not like a challenge, you can replace it using the "Replace challenge" function.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e8e8677a48426c875c4889cbcec8729e8220cc11.png
The number of remaining challenge replacements is updated at the beginning of each day
Season points for completing the storyline
Starting this season, Season Points will be awarded for completing the main storyline. Up to 50,000 Season Points will be awarded for completing the main storyline, which is equivalent to 50 seasonal levels.
 | For everyone who has already completed the Storyline before, these points will be sent to the in-game mail! 
This will help new players speed up their progress a bit. And more experienced wanderers will be more comfortable starting a new game, for example, for a different faction.
Season Pass Bundles
As before, we are introducing Season Pass bundles into the game, which offer a significant benefit to players.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/45bc96290014622eec58824dec29d7e022938d07.png
The more levels in the bundle - the greater the benefit. For those who are used to achieving everything on their own, we still offer the possibility to buy the "Basic" version of the season pass.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/46471d9b5bd2752d2ac0a91156b8b77cdd441130.png
Transferable Season Pass bundles can be purchased an unlimited number of times and do not burn out after the end of the season and can exist for an unlimited amount of time.
Only one Season Pass can be activated on each CHARACTER.
Buying levels in sets for a profit.
Completing Seasonal Challenges and participating in an Event is not the only way to get Seasonal Points.
You can still purchase Battle Pass levels as before. We made them cheaper and it became more profitable to buy levels.
In addition, the principle of buying levels has been changed - now levels are bought in sets. You can enter your number of levels and they are automatically grouped into bundles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/93ebc2c309f0f1126466e27ce4c2194d8b40e6a5.png

Event crates

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [20.03.24]
historical_patches.text:
Seasonal event «Arena of Slavs»
 | Be sure to watch the tutorial! 
"Arena of Slavs" is the first seasonal event of the year, featuring a team-based mode with waves of mutant creatures, bosses, duels and 5-on-5 player skirmishes. During the battle, players acquire and modify various equipment and strive to defend their idol more effectively than the other team.
 | If you're new to the event, we recommend checking out the Support Center articlefor a detailed description of the event. 
And if you are already an experienced player, you can go straight to the description of innovations!
New setting
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e7b0bc6ba0e0130363beea9cf8825d1860cf5aa0.png
It's not Max Crow's style to repeat himself, so for this year he chose new scenery and ancient Russian setting. Now you will portray bogatyrs defending the idol from assorted creatures and, of course, treacherous lizards!
Duels
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ee75dc7b4d50217a593b55b3c5001fdd7e321561.png
A new type of round has been added - "Duels". On them, bogatyrs from different teams are divided into pairs and fight each other in isolated arenas. Pairs are selected by armor type.
 | Winning a duel earns a lot of tokens for the team! 
Passive Upgrades
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c7b3cd20d46f8b3094881567c24ec8c55f8b5680.png
After each PvP round, bogatyrs can choose one of three available upgrades. Upgrades can be improved twice to increase their effectiveness.
 | Upgrades affect survivability, damage dealt, and even the amount of money you get! 
Artifacts
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f4e79e9124554909b263f1521ed23376a546caf8.png
Instead of "ordinary" artifacts from the Zone, the Arena now sells various gimmicks that give simple buffs.
 | It is no longer necessary to put together a complex build. 
Containers have also been changed - now players have them immediately and their capacity increases as the match progresses.
Modules
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c921c72774a9022b81dac88e917454d303013678.png
The upgrades from Dead Man's Marathon are back in the game! You can buy almost all the modules you're familiar with in the store, and install them on any weapon.
 | All this variety of enhancements allows players to come up with their own builds. 
Comeback system in PvP rounds
When losing in PvP, the team receives a bonus to the damage dealt at the start of the next PvP round. If they lose again, the bonus is increased.
If a team that lags behind wins the match, the damage counters are equalized in the next PvP round.
Example:
 | 1 PvP round 
 | No bonuses 
 | Team A wins 
 | 2 PvP round 
 | Team B has 3000 bonus points at start 
 | Team A wins 
 | 3 PvP round 
 | Team B has 6000 bonus points at start 
 | Team B wins 
 | 4 PvP round 
 | No bonuses 
 | Team B wins 
 | 5 PvP round 
 | Team A has 3000 bonus points at start 
 | – 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/da538fdb6634d632c839b0f0a9296616eb56016a.png
Season Pass
Added a reward for level 1000 – a unique themed style on the RPL-20 "Thunderer".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cf483fdf6dbbbf9a5e85755f569da1a6d663861e.png
 | Available as part of the Folktale Spring season only! 
Challenges, daily and weekly tasks
Trials and weekly seasonal challenges have been launched as part of the seasonal event.
 | The daily seasonal challenges have been replaced with event challenges. 
A daily experience bonus has been added to speed up progression, it gives additional experience when participating in an event and is updated every day.
Quest lines
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/996c4e50f9c866af39aa07422171eed993b96b7b.png
Arena Champion. A seasoned stalker, Max Crow, has returned to the Zone. He has organised an Arena in the Bar, where members of all factions fight for the title of Arena Champion. Will you be able to win this title?
 | The progress of the Max Crow storyline has been saved, and there is no need for you to go through the quest again if you completed it last year. The second part of the quest will appear next week.
The rewards for the quest have been changed. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f0d79100a064fb48610dbc07f2953a6eda691705.png
Folktale in the Arena Besides Max Crow, fights in the Arena are now also conducted by someone called Theophilus. He is a specialist of particular “folktale” fights. Complete Theophilus' quests, collect Bogatyr relics and become a true Bogatyr!
 | Theophilus' storyline is also divided into two parts. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d35455841a634d8c190a75c0fc6550529fc51ac5.png
Arena of Suffering. Meet Reed, Max Crow's assistant hired from the Covenant faction. He organises the most sadomasochistic fights in the Arena: fights that are as unfair and challenging as possible for the gladiators. Will you be able to pass Reed's challenges and not lose your mind? He will definitely show you the world of misery!
 | The challenging questline is now available immediately and does not require you to complete other quests. Komod's quests have been removed and Reed's Arena of Suffering has been added instead. 
Styles

If a player has a reputation on several bases, the discount from the maximum of them will be chosen.

Balance

The final stage of the "Folktale Spring" season
Season pass points from open world events
For the final phase of the season pass, we've added an ability to get season pass points in open world events.
 | Excluding caches and signals, they were not part of the deal. 
A small portion of the points will be received instantly when clearing the event. These points will be given to each participant of the event in equal amounts.
The larger part will be given as a new resource with barter mechanics, at the base it can be sold to the exchanger, the merchant of the current season, at the rate of 1 resource per 25 points of season pass.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/25c1023ee87c08e03dbd9ce3515e3bd3d30ac868.png
Since this is a barter resource, it will drop on death of the character into the backpack along with all other barter resources.
New open world events
We are adding bosses as new events. Bosses are introduced at the following locations:
• The Cordon,
• Agroprom,
• The Dark Valley,
• The Pit,
• The Forest,
• Dead City,

In addition to daily tasks, weekly challenges and trials have been updated to focus on the game's activities.
Consumables
Price revision
We analyzed the current prices of items in the consumable store and concluded that some prices did not fully reflect the importance and impact of items on the gameplay. As a result, the pricing of the product range has been revised to better reflect performance and play value.
Thanks to this, the connection between the cost of a product and its benefits in the game became more clearly visible.
Changing the discount system
The discount system has been updated according to the new pricing logic:
• Prices for consumables will now be the same at each base.
• Players will receive a permanent discount of 2.5% from the original price of consumables upon reaching certain levels at various bases:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b22cad512b4f3bdc27111ab8235f29e2966707c2.png
If the player has skipped any of the levels listed above, the discount will be calculated taking into account that level.
This update aims to create a more consistent and clear approach to consumable costs, as well as provide transparency in the pricing system.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/caabd07c0b9915b97ae2ec763e8fa4afb88cd3ec.png
Changing the operation of limits on the purchase of items
Previously, the timer until the limit was restored began counting from the moment the item was purchased and was applied to each unit separately.
This caused two problems:
• It is unclear from what moment the limit timer starts counting;
• It is unclear when the item will be available for purchase again.
Now the limit reset time is tied to the real time of the server and does not depend on the number of purchases.
Also in the description of items at the merchant, a display of the remaining time after which the limits will be updated has been added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/643384492a42f5cb6e9633784a2adc75b5cdfd4d.png

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [08.05.24]
historical_patches.text:
On May 8, 1945, the final Act of Unconditional Surrender of Nazi Germany and its armed forces was signed in the Berlin suburb of Karlshorst at 22 hours 43 minutes CET (May 9 at 0:43 Moscow time). 
In honor of this anniversary we will activate a small themed session mode dedicated to the storming of the Reichstag for a week. We also gift you a promo code for nice bonuses, which will be active until PM 12:59 UTC+0 11.05.24 - SC8MAY24.
Reichstag Assault
• The map "Reichstag Assault" will be available in the session mode "Confrontation" from May 8 to May 15. The map is presented in two versions - day and night.
• The night version of the map is available from PM 10:30 to AM 05:00 UTC+0
Map Features
• Players are given random themed equipment depending on their team.
• One of the captured points is periodically shelled by artillery.
• Some more powerful weaponry can be found around the map.
• The kill/death score on this map does not count towards a player's overall stats.
• The top 35 players by score (17 in the night version of the map) receive 500 birch barks, 500 season points, and a bound Perun's Grace.
Thematic crates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/467806bb0157a21f72406cac3e6520e60804541f.png
An option to purchase an Echo of War crate has been added from the Exchanger
• The crate and its contents are bound;
• You will receive all the contents of the crate for opening it 50 times.
Fixes
• Molotov cocktails no longer do damage to allies
• Increased the number of points received for seasonal pass in the open world events by 1.5 times
Thank you for your attention,
and good hunting in the Zone!

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [29.05.24]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b8e96d9aee875e44d3d32d3e64c172525c0c8fa0.png
Sealed Season Points Conversion
Sealed Season Points are now linked to the season when they were gained and are automatically converted when entering the safe zone. If the gaining season and the current season are the same, then the sealed points are converted to 25 season points. If they're different, then the sealed points are converted to 1 Trade Coin.
Balance changes
Weapons
The equipment systematization was revised, because of which the levels of some weapons were changed. For the most part, the levels have been increased.
Characteristics have been changed to match the new levels.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a910583342bfaf251f3b5117bf9ecf8572e86c97.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/dcb1c278ae14467dae3eb08df52f4dd21f2d835a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d6044838b7ea87ccfe1740cb23df93d0c42a1d3a.png
Melee Weapons
Melee weapons have long been insignificant in both PvP and PvE, so we are changing their characteristics.
The melee weapon groups now have more distinct differences and are more strictly standardized:
• Combat type has increased penetration and high damage values.
• Hunter type has high mutant damage values.
• Universal is in between, having average values.
In addition, the defenses of some mutants against melee weapons have been revised (for example, the boar is no longer absurdly resistant)..
All melee weapons now have backstab multiplier of x1.7 and cause bleeding with a 50% chance.
Temporarily lowered the anomalous damage of all melee weapons.
We will later replace the damage by imposing the appropriate status effects as separate features.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/1a31ca831f817001a9c4f1d2653ab4dc2ca70c4e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/817756c2c6465529b5b91ec5f161d0e0778bc9ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a6378a50c7ce121ae9bf500de60e938030fd2b7f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0d8b7f696772b11489f464f8134b10afea2673ae.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b4c110de09c340d50e1c07ec6a365dd9418beaca.png
Other balance changes
Updated flashbang's explosion sound.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cb8f165c4bd73bcde65ad685e48c4a1a1cc14301.png
Session battles
Added experimental game mechanic for small maps of the Session Battle Mode (Inferno, Glass, Hospital, Moira House
When killing an enemy, the murderer recharges 65% HP of the maximum health level and 25% of the maximum rounds of ammunition in the weapon's magazine. It comes from the inventory. This means that if the murderer has no spare rounds, the magazine will not be recharged.
Also, recharge after a kill is accompanied by a screen effect.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/298a9cea8e958d6de728eae1b9b24f5a545ba992.gif
This game mechanic was added in a testing format. It should help a player who is heavily outnumbered by the enemy to survive, as well as increase the overall dynamics of the Session Battle Mode
Artifacts on safe zones
We have noticed that the players often lose their artefacts after bringing them to the base. To improve the game experience, a system similar to "large barters" was introduced.
Artefacts obtained in the open world from anomalies or signals will no longer be lost upon the death of a character after entering the save zone. However, you are still free to use them for exchange, auction, or sending via in-game mail.
The rule also applies to artefacts that have been reset with the "Reset Essence".
If the player finds an artefact in the open world, but his character died before reaching the base, then the artefact can be picked up from the backpack.
Thank you for the attention.
And good luck hunting in the Zone!

historical_patches.title: STALCRAFT: X [Patchnote 10.07.24]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/782707012b03c6a725dfcea00dfe1c0b837f24fa.jpg
“Legends say that only chosen stalkers with inhuman willpower and diligence will be able to read all the articles in this patchnote. Are you, Seeker, ready to take up the challenge?” (c) A well known graphomaniac.
Today is exactly 10 years since our Chernobyl Zone first welcomed its first stalkers. For more than a year, we have been preparing a major update for this memorable date, which will be a bright transitional point in the history of the project and will allow us to avoid a midlife crisis. 
 | We've actually put together a massive CGI trailer in honour of this, be sure to check it out! 
Navigation
We have prepared not one, but a whole network of patch notes and guides for those who want to get acquainted with all the changes and updates in detail. Further in this article will be only general descriptions of some changes, and the patch notes themselves will be posted on our website.
• General patchnote
• Guide on Outposts
• Guide on Territories
• Guide on Hideout
• Guide on New Quests of the North
• Guide on Joining a faction
• Guide on Gathering
• Guide on Movement System
• Guide on Signals in the world
• Guide on General map of the North
• Guide on Updated interfaces 
Renaming of game entities
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/be38ff819592aba83e7f22a39172a8bbc0eadb8f.png
Our team consists of very loyal fans of the original universe, but at the current stage of the project's development, it is time to remove crossing titles. We have been extremely scrupulous in our approach to this issue, including a series of important player surveys. 
In general, in combination with a large-scale update of the game, the change of names even allows you to look at familiar things in a new way. Also, some mutants and costumes got new models, and the visuals of artefacts changed completely. STALCRAFT is still as close to our favourite trilogy as it is possible for a commercial project.
 | The full list of changed names can be found at the link: click 
New North locations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4360548222460bababb2db1e5a7d60b7f95017bc.png
New northern locations have finally appeared in the game, customised for the confrontation of the four warring factions. You will have the opportunity to more or less safely mine resources on home locations, and on disputed ones to take part in new open world events. Also, owners of scientist suits can now visit full-fledged infected zones, where all others are not allowed to enter. And of course, in the centre of the new North is Forge-11 — it's not Backwaters yet, but it's already quite a serious test for your shooting and survival skills. 
We didn't forget to update the southern locations (mostly in terms of vehicles and trees), but the northern ones will still stand out strongly against their background. We have used all the experience gained over the years to create a well-thought-out map with a lot of objects and buildings that can be played in your favour. Some of them are obvious, and some of them will be known only by experienced stalkers.
You can only enter the new North after joining one of the northern factions (for stalkers Frontier and Rise, for bandits Covenant and Mercenaries).
 | A more detailed article on New North can be found at this link: Click 
Northern factions storylines
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6c951c691f37c5cc0eca50660f25380e86ea4948.png
After completing the main story in the southern locations, you will be able to access the larger quest lines of the northern factions. The northern faction quests are unique stories that reveal the world of the Zone from different sides and echo each other. Each story has its own special atmosphere and fully reveals the ideology of your chosen faction. 
We also tried to surprise you with new mechanics in quest locations, which allows you to immerse yourself in the story even more and feel a new game experience. And remember an important point — since these are already northern locations, some stages in the story can be quite difficult to pass, but still very interesting!
 | You can read more information on the storyline at the link: Click 
New movement system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fb8c61bf7faed151232c1ce621e3387616ebba61.png
We've completely redesigned the character movement system and 3rd-person animations — we've been working on it for almost for two years! Besides aesthetic pleasures, the new animations allow you to better read the movements of enemies on the battlefield, and in general, significantly improve the basic game experience. And of course, no more Q when climbing obstacles. You get used to the new moves very quickly, and after internal tests, many of us found it very hard to play the previous STALCRAFT. 
All NPCs have also been switched to the new movement system. In the northern locations they have significantly updated Artificial Intelligence, so now bots can be easily confused with regular players. At least for the first time. 
 | More detailed instructions on the movement system can be found at this link: Click 
New game mechanics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e4a4b555e632ac36f480262e2b80639a46fbbb71.png
On disputed locations, everyone now has the opportunity to prove the supremacy of their faction by capturing “Outposts” and receiving quantum batteries as a reward. And hunting for mutants has become much easier, thanks to the “Territory” mechanic (now they live in areas and are highlighted on the map). 
Hideout — your own den for resting and preparing for new raids, which you can equip with various furniture and useful structures. There, you will have access to the creation of high-level consumables, which can also be sold to other players.
We have also greatly expanded the variability of spawning various useful loot in stashes and on the map, at the expense of Hideout crafts. Around this, a full-fledged “Gathering” system has been built, which in addition to searchable decor now also includes various plants, and in infected areas and arch-anomalies — special crystals. 
Daily and weekly tasks have become more flexible. Everyone decides for themselves who to work for and what to demand as a reward for their efforts.
 | More details on the new gameplay mechanics can be found at this link: Click 
Project “Socialisation”
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2c32818a69d925c834634d5d88939122609fb239.png
We've significantly redesigned some interfaces, moving many of the PDA functions to the main menu and expanding them. Now you can make friends, write them letters, join squads and manage notifications in one place, and all this without shrinking into a small screen in the centre. The player profile view has also changed, and it's now possible to display the most important stats on the main page. This is just the beginning and the first iteration of the large-scale project “Socialisation”, which is designed to do everything we can to make sure you find great friends in your squad or subdivision. 
 | You can read more about interface updates here: Click 
Massive graphics update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a6a1dd7c81dedb76ef45040d1b98dedbaddebc0d.png
For many years we didn't pay much attention to updating the graphics of the project, because it's not easy to find specialists to work with our engine, and we had to concentrate on fixing the gameplay. Nevertheless, we finally solved this problem and prepared a delicious update of the overall visuals of the game. STALCRAFT now has gorgeous trees, beautiful models of vehicles, nice water and a new lighting system. 
And that's not all! Our specialists have also developed a complex system for changing the “Weather”, so that every day in the Zone was not like the previous one. Now it can rain at locations of different strength, thick or light fog can form, clear days can be replaced by cloudy ones. Some weather events occur randomly, some are subject to certain cycles. All in all, it will be more interesting to go for a walk now!
 | More about the new graphics can be found here: Click 
Balance and economic changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/bff36d8e182768181614173d4de5ec0c25ce8172.png
Well, it's not without it! This time the balance changes are not just about numbers — super-heavy, heavy and some combo suits got a bigger hitbox, corresponding to their size. That is, it became easier to hit massive opponents. The characteristics of many automatic rifles and some rifles have also increased. And good news for all fans of the AH series combo armour branch!
Also, all barter recipes have been recalculated, including the required resources have been adapted to the logic of using equipment. For example, bartering shotguns no longer requires resources from human camps, but requires more resources from mutants. The prices, weights, and ranks of some barter resources have been adjusted to better match the value of the resource and its weight. The exchange rate of trade coins for some resources has also changed. In addition, any branch of equipment can now be started immediately in the Bar (no more running to the initial locations to learn new lines). 
Battle Pass points have been added to the rewards for announcement board quests, signals, dig up caches, parcel deliveries, and session battles. Weekly/daily quests are now more focused on the open world, and the narrowly focused and annoying ones have been removed. 
 | All details on balance edits and economy changes can be seen in the general patch: Click 
Sounds update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6142611fef5883867afd14fdbf98a4fae3e0bb9f.png
We couldn't release the graphics changes without doing a lot of work on improving the sound design! Even though the overall upgrade of gunshot sounds didn't make it to today's release, the game still features completely redesigned mutant and expendable sounds, new footstep sounds (depending on surfaces), new gun interaction sounds and a bunch of great new ambient and story quest music. 
There's certainly no need to read, but to play and listen! 
 | But you can learn more about the sound update at the link: Click 
In-game shop update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/782707012b03c6a725dfcea00dfe1c0b837f24fa.jpg
We have done a lot of work on redesigning the shop interfaces so that all items can be viewed clearly and conveniently. Some items can be purchased as a set or individually, and we have also introduced the ability to easily preview many items before purchase.
 | A bit more about the in-game shop changes can be found at the link: Click 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cffd216fb812ecdd31e3a0efe4987b1792afaf67.png
Well, and of course in honour of the big date, a new battle pack is now available to buy in our updated fresh shop, which includes:
• 25 levels of season pass (25,000 season points);
• X-Mark paint set;
• X-Mask keychain;
• 30 days of Premium;
• A case of fireworks;
• A case of champagne.
Compensation of award for 2023
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/67eccd00dc6d80efcb81443edb1f18f399f169e7.png
So, you've made it through the huge canvas of text of this patch, now, let's talk about the award.
More precisely, about the award for seniority of the last year. 
We have looked up the secret documents and found out that many of you did not receive all the awards, or they came incorrectly. 
And today is the right time to make up for this misunderstanding.
What didn't reach the recipients a year ago has settled in the pockets of the former Intendant. 
Don't worry, he's already been punished (in all senses), and the rewards you're entitled to will be sent to your in-game mail in a separate letter.
An important clarification: this is exactly the extra part of the reward.
That is, if you were entitled to 50 000 trade coins and 180 days of premium, and you received 30 000 coins and 120 days, 
you will receive the remaining 20,000 trade coins and 60 days of premium.
We apologise for any inconvenience caused.
Conclusion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7f4db23bc68216a5f8a3fee42633816a4dbe0896.png
The update is very large-scale and complex, so please be sympathetic to the possible abundance of bugs and flaws - they are inevitable, and we will try to fix them promptly. Also, in the coming weeks we are planning to release a large-scale revision of faction captures - there will be 1v1 tournament battles, a different format of captured bases in the open world, and much more. 
For the last few years, everything we've been working on has been done with an eye on future development - any skeleton needs a muscle brace after release. So don't even think like we're going to relax and switch to anything. Many of the mechanics released today have huge potential, and STALCRAFT: X is not going to slow down in its development and scaling in the future. The evolution that STALCRAFT is experiencing is a direct reflection of the team's commitment to its development and the total dedication of each individual staff member to the overall endeavour. 
EXBO has never had publishers or investors strangling the company with financial performance requirements. All we have is you, our players, and your support. STALCRAFT is not a game that you can just pick up and make for a lot of money - it's a whole world that has grown around the paths players have trodden and shaped over the years.
We always tried to be sincere with you, and please don't forget that behind all these updates there is a huge labour of live developers, who put all their heart and all their free time into it. And the main motivation for them is not money at all, but your emotions, your reviews, your feedback. Please don't forget to open our social networks not only to complain about something, but also to praise. We all care very much about what you write.
With endless love,
EXBO Team💙

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [17.07.2024]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0b434901ff58fcf9c7412e97105bf189d3e071fe.png
Changes in Subdivision Battles
There have been many changes throughout the history of Clan Wars, and its mechanics were still carrying some fundamental problems, not sharing the needs of certain groups of players. In addition, the number of people willing to participate has become more than able to accept entries. The need for global changes has long been brewing, and its time has finally come!
From now on, Clan Wars will be referred to as Subdivision Battles, divided in three types:
• Brawls;
• Tournaments;
• Base capture.
In order to access the Subdivision Battles menu, proceed to Session Battles → Subdivision Battles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6a13c2715b7c3267a3285879f1112bd21eca59ed.png
Brawls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f7741c15817c3809f10802aca431404cdb2e2ba5.png
A familiar format for all the CW veterans:
• Previously, subdivisions were registered for specific bases, but now registration takes place in a pool of participants.
• After the registration is completed, parallel brackets are formed, and conquests start in 3 stages of 30 minutes each. Each bracket can have 64 members at most.
• The maximum amount of subdivision participants was reduced from 5 to 4.
• Removed factional seeding of the subdivisions in brackets. Groups are now formed randomly.
• By default, all subdivisions are hostile to each other, but alliances can be made with units of any faction.
• Brawls do not affect the subdivision rating.
Brawls Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8e5bf084176ecf6e8c252edd106f60f9fd22927f.png
Maps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/78c143d04b3a5afafcb37ca9d49b9a824b79a437.png
Tournaments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/938eefa5ad645c1dd4771dceea21ea313d5d1fd8.png
Follows a scheme of 1v1 captures. Let’s discuss its main features:
• Just like the Brawls, you register into “general participants pool”.
• After the registration is done, the parallel brackets are formed:
 | The maximum number of participants is 16 per 1 bracket; 
 | There might be up to 4 stages per bracket, depending on the number of the subdivisions participating. 
• Capture time differs from stage to stage:
 | Stage 1 – 10 minutes; 
 | Stage 2 – 15 minutes; 
 | Stage 3 – 20 minutes; 
 | Stage 4 – 25 minutes. 
• Groups are matched randomly, independent of subdivision rating.
• Politics mechanics is off. Everyone are hostile.
• Wins and losses in the Tournaments affects subdivision rating.
Rating system changes
Previously, the Bases were separated by the levels, which affected the amount of award and the rating. The rating itself was just combined with the current one in case of a win.
Now, the rating grows in case of a win and falls in case of losses. The ratings changes depend on the enemy's current rating. In case of an equal rank, the opposing subdivisions will get and lose equal amounts of rank points. If the rating is different, then the subdivision with the higher rank will get fewer points in case of a win and will lose more in case of a loss. And vice-versa with the subdivision of the lower rank.
 | There are limits that won’t allow the subdivision to get or lose extra rank points. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c9df8642064f64c12ea518c69833b2883d81f9e5.png
 | Current minimum rating change = 20, the maximum = 80. 
When receiving a personal award for a place in the faction top-10 at the end of the rating season, Tournament stages played by the subdivision will also count.
Tournaments Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/1728cedf790a8d6acfc12f71487544452fee5bd1.png
Maps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cded66f949d56b1eab48cf70a73c0ddd671e374a.png
Base Captures
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/75e704f9c0742dcf38320171f4ce9221ac327262.png
Base Captures also take place in a 1v1 battle format, just like Tournaments. Specific features are:
• Only the top 10 subdivisions from each faction at the moment are allowed to register (40 in total)
• All 4 bases are captured on the same day. The bases are played in pairs. It is possible to register only on 1 base from the current pair. The pairs of bases are as follows:
 | Bunker - Checkpoint
 | Weather station - Old mine 
• The winners of the first pair cannot register for the second pair played on the same day. The losing players of the first pair may take part in the bases' conquest of the second pair.
• Brackets are formed from the participants registered to a particular base and can go up to 6 stages.
• The timing of the conquests varies from stage to stage:
 | Stage 1, 2, 3 - 10 minutes 
 | Stage 4 - 15 minutes 
 | Stage 5 - 20 minutes 
 | Stage 6 - 25 minutes

Base Features
• A base falls under the control of the set subdivision that captured it. Players from allied factions cannot enter captured bases.
• Fast travel to the base is available once every 10 minutes.
• Respawning and participating in session modes are not allowed on the base.
• An 8x8 cell storage is available, but access to personal storage is not.
• The consumables trader does not offer discounts based on the faction base level; however, division bonuses still apply.
• The Fence purchases items at reduced prices, but division bonuses still apply.
• The Mechanic allows equipment repairs without considering faction base level discounts.
• The base generator allows charging devices for in-game currency.
• Radios are present on the bases.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0bf2e3d5b2527356da421d41b87d176ac7d486aa.png
In the mobile camp, you can purchase the special grenade EG-1 "Barrier". Limit: 30 units.

• On all other maps, the breakdown distance has been set to 60 meters.
Mobile Camps and Outposts
• On Malaya Berdovka and its variations, Mobile Camps and Outposts can be placed in buildings.
Fixes

• Fixed daily quests for killing Mutts in Lyubech-3 and the Zone Center.

• Fixed a bug where the Vahter could not appear at the faction base.
• Increased the number of caches in daily tasks.
• Fixed a bug where converted players couldn't start the northern storyline.
Thank you for your attention, 
and good hunting in the Zone!

historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d7ebbbfd2abe6017e760e02c44b40a6838b26bca.png
Magazines update
Now the magazines have fixed reload time without any reload buffs or debuffs. The weapons now have a new "Ergonomics" stat that affects reload speed. In case of 100% Ergonomics, reload value is as stated in the magazine's description, if it is more than 100% the value gets faster and slower if it is less than 100%.
• In addition, basic reload of some weapons and magazines' stats were recalculated.
Jamming mechanics update
Old random jamming mechanincs was replaced by guaranteed jamming in case of continuous shooting. Jamming happens in case of uninterrupted shooting with at least x1.5 bigger than a standard magazine.
For example, if the weapon's standard magazine is 30 nm, then jamming happens on the 45th uninterrupted shot (the jamming is possible only in case of 46+ ammo magazines).
When reaching 75% jamming limit the weapon starts making a special clicking sounds. After reaching 100% the jamming happens.
Exceptions 
• Machine guns (in case of durability higher than 25%).
• The guns, that have an ability of placing the magazine of different weapon category( e.g. SIG Sniper or SOK-94).
• M16A1 and M16A2 with the standard magazine of 25 bullets jam on 45th shot, as most of the assault riffles do.
• Flamethrower, Tinderbox, Coldcutter, revolvers, and bolt-action rifles do not jam.
• The jamming limit reduces to zero in case of the weapon durability being less than 25% for most of the weapons. Jamming risk elimination takes half of a second of stopped shooting.

The sets with the styles for the TDI Kriss Vector, Mule/Ace Exoskeletons, and Desert Eagle Mark XIX include three Connoisseur cases and premium for 14 days as a gift! 
And the set with the Kukri only includes premium for 14 days.
Black Market signals
Agents of the Black Market conduct their operations in the North…
The details of the operations are carefully concealed, but one thing is clear to everyone: these cunning bargainers are robbing the ZIVCAS Corporation!
Join them if you want to make some money. Look for Black Market signals!
 | The quest is temporary and will be available from 5 September to 11 September inclusive. 
Subdivision battles
Brawls
The requirement for registration in terms of the number of players in a subdivision with a rank of Trooper and above has been reduced from 25 players to 20.
The time for the Brawl stages has been reduced from 30 minutes to 25 minutes.
Capture economy updates
Prices for buying consumables with subdivision treasury from mobile camp and merchant have been revised.
Limits on allowable treasury spending by ranks have also been changed:
• Рядовой: 12 000 → 25 000
• Боец: 20 000 → 40 000
• Сержант: 40 000 → 75 000
• Офицер: 100 000 → 150 000
Map pool changes
In Tournaments and Base Captures, the maps “Lowland” and “The Wind Rose” for 3 capture points have been removed. The maps are removed for revision.
The 7-capture point Lowland is still in the pool for the semi-final and final stages.
“Coniferous” map update
• The location centre belt and capture points have been updated;
• The impact of sniper rifles has been significantly reduced;
• More situations have been created for medium to short range combat;
• The map was brought to a symmetry of possibilities for both sides;
• The breakdown distance of the mobile camp is reduced 60 → 35 metres.
Trade packs
Using items from personal storage
An optional ability to take items from a personal storage when purchasing a trade pack has been added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fe99f0f605ff0a4fb5d966e01e3940d0273f1ac6.png
When a special setting is enabled in the trading packs menu, items will first be taken from the personal storage, then purchased from the merchant.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fcfd5644e62fd225ceb9e471a526d6b1c8d2cdf7.png
 | The icon in the product card informs about the source of receipt 
If there are not enough items in the personal storage to form a trade pack, the missing items will be automatically purchased from the merchant.
Restrictions on the operation of trade packs
• Items packed in bags and boxes will not be used — they must be unpacked to account for the items;
• Only items available for purchase from the merchant are taken from the personal storage — otherwise, items will not be taken;
• The possibility to take items from the personal storage is available only in territories with the possibility to open the storage itself — otherwise, items will be bought from the merchant.
Trade pack editing
A special button has been added that allows editing trade packs without having to approach a merchant in a safe zone.
Other performance improvements of trade packs
• The interface for buying trade packs has been redesigned;
• Ability to open the interface for buying trade packs in the whole territory of safe zones has been added.
Charge display on electronic devices
Charge percentage display in the icon has been added for the following types of electronic devices:
• Metal Detectors;
• Wide range detectors (WBD);
• Short range detectors (SRD).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0c732ad50176aa4c6bcdfe93255049608eec5a00.png

The ability to research multiple artefacts at once in a researcher has been added. The price of the research is summed up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5833ed722fc0cc2edfee8490339a4d739b771a89.gif
Explorer Bonus changes
The Explorer Bonus in its current form gives players 500 Season Points for each stage. There are five of these stages available to players each day, which means everyone can earn up to 2,500 Season Points per day.
We purposely set such a high value at the start of this Season for the most active players, and it has been that way for 4 weeks since the start of the current season. Further, the increased Explorer Bonus will apply to the first 2 weeks from the start of each following season.
As of now, the reward for completing a stage will be reduced to 350 Season Points, so the maximum reward for the day will be 1750 Season Points.
Balance changes
Stopping power
Stopping power allows combining in gameplay a high movement speed in the world and acceptable movement speed in combat.
Too high speed during a firefight makes it very difficult to aim at the enemy and spoils the combat experience by making it too chaotic. However, slowing down too much can also create unpleasant situations by overly restricting the player's movement options in combat.
We will adjust the stopping power to find the optimum values.
Changes
 | 
• Speed penalties reduced by 5-10% for each level of stopping power.
• The maximum possible penalty is now -60% of speed instead of -70%.
CD-4 Armored Suit
CD-4 has confident characteristics and a small hitbox at the same time, which allowed the suit to seriously dominate other combat armour and create a lot of “no damage registration” situations.
Changes
 | 
• Hitbox size: small → medium
Super-heavy armoured suits
The combination of low movement speed and large hitbox makes super-heavy armoured suits less effective in combat than should be expected of them. Their increased bullet resistance in most situations is not enough to outweigh their weaknesses.
Bullet resistance of super-heavy armour will be improved.

• high stopping power;
• weak recoil, which partially compensates for weak damage beyond short ranges;
• decreased penalties for both movement speed and speed in aiming compared to assault rifles;
• serious up-close killing power.
All of the above allows the assault rifle to heavily dominate other weapons and emerge victorious from too many situations.
Since low recoil and high comfort are originally intended as features of the weapon, the weakening will be issued in damage at close range, where the AMB-17 still shows itself stronger against other weapons.

Spawn rates for ammonia and textolite were increased.
Some items, such as the transformer, replacement battery, copper coil and others were removed from the spawn pool.
Subdivision battles
Changes to the rating system
• Changed the penalty system for not attending a Base Capture for top-10 subdivisions of the faction. Before the penalty was applied to the subdivisions that ended up in the top-10 after the first set of base captures due to rating changes. Now the penalty is only applied to the subdivisions that were in top-10 at the start of Sunday.
• Fixed the issue of not receiving rating for skipped stages of Base captures
• Rating bonus for a winning streak now resets after losing a stage in Base captures
Changes to calculations of rewards for the subdivision battles season
• Attendance requirement for a personal seasonal reward was lowered: From 50% to 25% of the stages attended by the subdivision.
• Base captures stages and Tournament stages are now also counted towards the reward.
• The count of stages attended by the player no longer resets upon leaving the subdivision, but it is still necessary to be a member of the division to receive a personal reward. The reward is based on the position in the ranking occupied by the current division in which the player is in.
Division roster management
• Removed the 24-hour waiting period for a player to be promoted after joining a division.
• Increased the maximum amount of members for level 3 subdivisions: 30 → 35 members.
