historical_patches.title: Patchnote [30.10.2024]
historical_patches.text:
Black Market Bosses are going big with raids on ominous Boral island, which is now under control by the mysterious yet high-tech Murmur gang. Your task is to catch up as many technologies as you can from those zombie-puppets and drag your feet away from the island on the whirlybird!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d633c001649e5f99d3247a5e0ccbbc16b7b69b12.jpg
Black raid
It's almost Halloween, and it's time for launching Black Raid event that has so many new features, that make him always as good as last year Dead Men Marathon! Get ready to explore the Boral Island and prove Murmurs that you are a force to be reckoned with. The event will be available until December 4 (That's right, we've decided to prolong the event after the trailer release).
For everyone who hasn't played Dead Man Marathon, we recommend you watching this video guide. We changed content, but the general principles are the same.
One of the main features is the new Ranked mode!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a172a3b4bcb18a292d7e5390c6a0382ce9882987.png
Ranked mode
Ranked mode will be available starting November 2 at 12:00 (GMT+3) for all the characters that have more than 100 play hours. This mode doesn't have Converts (zombie players), and teams can compete with each other at full strength with less random implemented.
At the end of the event, players achieve places in the leader board, which are tied to a certain rank. Depending on the rank achieved, participants will receive one of the following awards:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0067af383f860a571f3fe6a45bb8e047a0b3ebca.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/054a2109b2a04530edc395750bef88912c822239.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/36f05ac5cf8dfc7d03689874a5e723898af2759d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a75de7847eb0fc4a4ca2f0d8154decedb4d17040.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/343bb96882831f0db2de0aab1eb60c221df89f12.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2ac659b0d0224cabad575495a8cfa57a68e4fef5.png
Let's list some awesome prizes:
Chitin backpack that is obtainable for reaching the top of the rating (EU: Top 100, NA: Top 50, SEA: Top 20). The backpack will be exclusive until the start of Act II, and then will be available for purchasing by parts for Act II Tickets at the cost of a legendary item;
Transferable Elbrus Short Range Detector;
Aesthete Token;
99% Barter Coupon;
Pack of masters attachments;
And also a bunch of anomalous serum, advanced spare parts, trade coins, Black Present cases etc.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f8b1de55679947be011ce27d069184ba295dce92.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fb0c00b9cf14fdac81fb5f9d754e1f33b9d0c96c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/926f601bbb2b50d74228e30ba671934465d40b62.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/05765fa013a6c67f422883b2bed9123b36926f2a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fc04bf4ffba26ff3c97fde2a7c4e94ce65471a8e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5308e263105db90607f09e3b8e3cbfd167855123.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e57fd8eeca10dca752ecf993f9fbbf2aed533471.png
Match ranking
You can find out your rating and qualify for awards of the corresponding rank only after passing the calibration, which lasts for 10 ranked games.
After the calibration is finished, each player gains certain rating points.
The amount of rating points received per match depends on the team's ranking, determined by the number of points earned per game.
After the event is finished (December, 4th) the player results will be summarized. Based on that, the players will receive awards, corresponding to their rank and rating.
Rating principle
The game points are received for completing certain tasks like clearing our camps, killing NPCs, killing enemy players etc.
There are extra multipliers that are applied for completing the main objective (+25% of team points) and evacuation (+50% of team points).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e6f079d002de476d9aaca2919ad5735dbd0d2189.png
At the end of the game, a leaderboard of the teams within the match is constructed based on the teams' scores and the multipliers applied to them. The top half of the players gain rating, the bottom half lose rating. The closer the players are to the first place, the more rating points they receive, the closer they are to the last place, the more rating points they lose.
Players and teams ratings at the start
• The higher your rating compared to all players in the session, the lower the multiplier of the rating you receive and the higher the multiplier of the rating you lose.
• The higher your team's rating compared to all teams in the session, the lower the multiplier of the rating you receive and the higher the multiplier of the rating you lose.
So, based on your individual ranking, team relative ranking, and team position on the session leaderboard, you gain or lose ranking.
Black chips
Before the start of a ranked match, you will have the opportunity to bet Black Chips, which will give a multiplier to both win and lose. You can bet fiches only after the calibration.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0b0b974cb5d0151e5085eabdf2753c20b372f824.png
You can bet from 1 to 3 fiches on each ranked game:
• 1 chip multiplies the gained or lost ranking by 2;
• 2 chips multiply the gained or lost ranking by 2.5;
• 3 chips multiply the gained or lost ranking by 3.
For example, if the player has successfully completed the match, he will receive somewhere like +62 ranking points. In the meantime, their teammate who bet one chip before the start of the match will get +124 ranking points. In case of defeat, the former will receive -62 ranking points and the latter -124 ranking points.
Ways to earn Black Chips
After the calibration is finished, the player receives 6 Black Chips.
Additional ways to obtain them:
• Piece by piece for BM-checks in the shop;
• Special Black Chips set in the shop.
The Black Chips sets can be transferred to another player or auctioned off. Accordingly, it is possible to purchase such sets from another player directly or through an auction.
A black chip bet refund occurs when a player who was not in the same squad as you during your quest leaves the ranked game.
Using chips should crank the adrenaline and emotion of the game to the max!
Restrictions for unsportsmanlike behaviour
In case of long inactivity, access to picking up the next games may be restricted, and precious rankings may be lost.
At first, the warning is given, but each following restriction will be stronger.
In case of premature withdrawal from the match, corresponding restrictions will also be implemented. The players that weren't part of the “intruder” team while using the match are free to leave the game.
Ranking abuse penalties
This time we tried to make the most competitive ranking possible, with very valuable rewards. We understand the sensitivity of participants to all sorts of dishonest players who will attempt to play unfairly.
Details on fighting the intruders will be published closer to the ranked mode launch at the end of the week and will be applied not only to the cheaters.
Shop changes
A page for each of the currencies has been added to the shop. On this page, you can find two tabs, “How to get?” and “Offers”.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a66d487743d852d11730849b1035967b197386e0.png
The first one, “How to get?” tells you about the currency and how to get or spend it. For the convenience of players, we have also placed there the most popular offers for each of the currencies.
The “Offers” tab shows all the purchase options for a particular currency that are currently available in the shop. The desired currency page can be opened by clicking on the corresponding currency in the upper right corner of the shop.
Black Market cases
Advanced case
The Black Market Advanced Case is now on sale, and with every opening, the player will receive not only a Basic Item, but also a Bonus Item.
In other words, the player gets two items per discovery.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a9d8661c891ae27753ceb6fc7227496e727d04e9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2764cc545d676d13e495f46dd7bed8e4820144ba.png
Discounts on Black Market cases
There will also be special discounts on the rest of the Black Market cases during the Black Raid season event:
• Elite case 12000 → 9490 (2510 BM-check discount);
• Tactical case 12000 → 9490 (2510 BM-check discount);
• Basic case 2500 → 1990 (510 BM-check discount).
Season changes
Silent Scream
Added a reward for Season 1000 level — a unique Scream style for the OTs-14M Surge.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c153efc006aaebd64eb999bbb422944a892cbf8f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/58a71c935a0d4ffa363abbd8f0003199b084bc23.png
Explorer Bonuses can also be gained for participating in the Black Raid event.
When playing as the Black Market operatives, you must survive the match for at least 5 minutes, complete the main mission, or successfully evacuate. You will receive 1 Explorer Bonus for completing each of these points.
When playing as a Murmur fighter, 1 Explorer Bonus will be granted for not leaving Boral Island before all Black Market units have been destroyed or evacuated. Moreover, you will receive 2 additional Explorer Bonuses for completing Murmur missions.
PIONEER-3 wide range detector
There's a new wide range detector in the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone – PIONEER-3.
PIONEER-3 is a more advanced version of the popular SAK-2 detector model.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0872f499b6ba9b3af0a8487af874da6485f86100.png

historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/740ffeb9f6871b05ee03f2cdfb59222bc9135705.png
Evacuation
Evacuation system changed In response to a players' popular demand, we decided to change the Evacuation mechanic closer to what it was during the “Dead Man’s Marathon” with some tweaks.
Helicopter Call
After completing all the tasks, the team has the ability to evacuate from Boral prematurely.
Players will have to reach an inactive Evacuation event and wait for 90 seconds for a helicopter to arrive.
After landing, the helicopter will wait for the players for 30 seconds. After taking off, the next helicopter can be activated on the same point after 180 seconds.
Final Helicopters arrival
2 minutes before the end of the match, all the inactivated Helicopter Call events get activated before the session ends.
This is the last chance for the team to escape the Boral island.
Group departure
Now the squad doesn't have to wait for the timer expiration to evacuate by helicopter.
If the helicopter is occupied by any three players, an early timer starts for 5 seconds. After this time, they are successfully evacuated, provided no one in the group has left the helicopter.
Тhe players can be from different squads, yet the evacuation will happen anyway.
Helicopter overload
If the evacuation chopper contains more than three players, it will be in an overload state. The evacuation timer will be postponed until there are three players left in the helicopter.
Other changes
• Partially fixed the problem with NPC Zombies spawning in front of players;
• Fixed the AFK status being applied after successful evacuation;
• Added weapon reload to Converts after respawning;
• Fixed situations where players got stuck while using the grappling hook;
• Added distortion effect for invisible Converts;
• Fixed the signals display on the PIONEER-3 wide range detector.

The value of paint drops, weapons, and equipment parts have been increased to benefit player comfort.
Added a limit on the drop of repeat Master and Legendary gear parts up to a certain number of open cases.
Season stash
The remaining time of existence has been increased from 30 to 90 days. The changes were made to suit the players using it. Now there is no need to measure the right time when to place it, as it will now last for whole season.
Instant season points from the signals
There were too many instant season points dropped at the Northern locations, due to an overall decrease in signal collection time and an increase in the frequency of signals. The number of points was reduced so that signals did not stand out from other activities.

Merchant Replacement
Merchant NPC on starting bases was replaced to 3D object. All the NPC's function are retained, including the ability to purchase trade packs inside the base perimeter. The players used to experience the situation, when the merchant took a long time to load or did not appear at all. The replacement was done to solve this issue.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a84bd87b2c9baafceb6d247bf35872ef55b38219.jpg
Recruit rank changes
• The Recruit rank was renamed “Reserve”;
• Senior members of subdivisions now have the ability to demote players to Reserve rank;
• The players with the Reserve rank can't attend the Subdivision Battles;
• If the player gets demoted to the Reserve while playing the Subdivision Battle, he'll be eliminated from the game. That way, another player with a different rank from can take the Reserve's place.
• The players with the Reserve rank don't receive Subdivision Battles awards, even if they attend any stage that day.
Changed the condition for receiving an award
How it was before?
To get the Subdivision Battle stage award, the player should meet the following criteria at the end of the stage:
• Take part in the capture stage;
• Be in the top-30 players of his team by the end of the stage (even if all the 35 players has taken part in it);
If there are more than 30 players, there is a screening by:
• Points received;
• Date of joining the subdivision;
If some players have the same amount of points, the award is received by the senior member of the subdivision.
How it is now?
If there are more than 30 players, there is a screening by:
• Points received;
• Rank;
• Date of joining the subdivision;
That is, rank prioritization now takes place before taking into account the player's date of joining the unit.
If some players have the same amount of points, the award is received by the member with a higher rank.
Other Subdivision Battles changes
Fixed the bug that made it impossible to view a past Base Capture grid if the player's subdivision was not registered to that base.

It is important to note that this is only the first iteration of adjustments. We will gradually improve and rework the Northern dungeons so that they will only get better.

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [13.12.2024]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/964e8566bc4fd6e04fed48ffd64d9fbd00484153.jpg
The time has come when the Zone is covered in a white veil and researchers begin to decorate their bases with Christmas decorations, listening to the sounds of holiday chants on the radio. The holiday is approaching, so it's time to decorate the tree and get your presents!
Snowy weather
The Weathermen's instruments did not fail this time, the forecasts came true.
The Zone is frozen again.
The Swamps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4eb2cce164534942707ad5ea41d716f151c1cc34.jpg
The Scrapyard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/70dc7fdd6f75b54d16819e69dc946b6a9163b1ae.jpg
The Path of Fools 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a34f8c97e4ff4bcf507076548fb9d126572cfd69.jpg
Polesskoye
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c5afd623ec969ac0b71b439d6f22a1b06f866b40.jpg
With the changing landscape, expert researchers are advised to update their camouflage so that they don't stand out amongst the white scenery.
Temporary quest line “A Voice From the Other Side”
A New Year's Eve is here. While civilians are decorating their shelters and bases, the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone has visitors. The Scientist Professor Nicholas and the Snowmen from The Inside Out both have their own jobs and their own gifts for you. But someone is missing. And where is our Snow Maiden? What happened to her?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8ba8f054b49a530c3046cbbed7b014df3a844bab.jpg
Meanwhile, amidst the icy cold and howling winds, the call for help is being heard. And those who dare to answer the call will be drawn into the flywheel of events, the echoes of which will make itself known.
The quest line is available until the end of the season event.
The Snowstorm
The Snowstorm is a temporary but large-scale event that occurs between the usual eruption. It covers the entire Chernobyl Exclusion Zone, except for the Lyubech-3 and Stillwaters locations.
In the similar way as the eruption, the announcer warns of an approaching snowstorm that lasts approximately 30 minutes.
During a snowstorm, visibility is limited, and Cold infection is imposed. The norther the location of the player is, the stronger is the effect of the infection.
The Weathermen continue to work through the winter. Predictions of approaching snowstorms have been added to the location.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/89d4cb1719343dc3f276c5e924435d21bf7c7d1d.png
Consumables
The following consumables are available for cold reduction from the Merchant:
• Warming Serum;
• Alcohol;
• Lighter;
• Experimental Thermoplate.
Crates of consumables appear in the open world to help you deal with the snowstorm. In addition to the above items, there are also:
• Emergency First-Aid Kit;
• Frosty Vodka.
Also, in addition to consumables, players will be helped to cope with the storm by the most common campfire. Yup, it's keeping you warm! When the Heaters are in a free state, within a certain radius, they help you to drain the Cold from your body.
Snowstorm activity
During the snowstorm, winter artefacts begin to appear, and ordinary events are replaced with their frosty versions.
Ordinary events
Frosty events
 | Anomaly Research Installation 
 | Heater's protection 
 | Researchers’ protection 
 | Help Frost Fighters 
 | Proto-Discharge Cluster 
 | Protoanomaly Snow Cluster 
 | Zombie Group 
 | Zombie Frost Fighters Group 
Some events need to be completed first so that frosty versions can take their place.
There are also mutant bosses that may appear on the locations. There are four types of it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7a427506ab8387430e19dcadcd24581070287d92.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/eabb760314089097d76e1d8bae726cfd6dc66fee.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6aedf67f34be83dabb9be3a3e76c0f86b3df7b96.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/54dbff5a3ed8c3ff80cf5e0bfb780c03f7674e3b.jpg
Anomalous Contract Supplier
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9dba3002034d6f8b55c366f5c5cc7346ce35ffce.jpg
During the storm, special contracts are available to players to deliver packages to the Frost Fighters. Depending on the contract chosen, a player can get a Small, Large or Huge Gift Box. But don't forget — the time is limited.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c4caca49f373d1e1a3fb950ccf2b5bf6d2e97129.png
The packages warm their owner and all the nearby players within a five-meter radius.
Yet, be careful! If one tries to get rid of the package, the time runs out or the player dies by an external factor, the package will explode and release fireworks.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2268453866bcd817132b1516b0cbada18ab8629b.gif
New frost artefact
A new artefact has formed under a large snowdrift — Chilly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/15ff412eae931dfa3e9ac3eaa2523db1a6f22710.png
Friendly reminder: The frost artefacts can be found during the snowstorm only.
Christmas Tree
Every player now has their own Christmas Tree on the safe zone that is to be decorated with Christmas Tree decorations. Every decoration boosts the Christmas Tree with a certain amount of points and levels up the Christmas Tree.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ee0286689df9b95e9652dc377026d45bc1555faa.jpg
All the decorations are combined by sets the more strictly the player adheres to a certain set while decorating the Christmas Tree, the higher its level becomes. The decorations' rarity also affects the Christmas Tree level.
For each set of decorations collected, the player receives themed rewards in the form of paints and keychains!
Interaction with the Christmas Tree is done through an interface where you can change decorations, track its level and look at your friends' Christmas Trees.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/25e12fb3d5530581cb2adb4314604bcc42934f62.jpg
The level of the Christmas Tree affects the daily rewards that will appear under it — the higher the level, the better the rewards. The rewards are refreshed at 12 AM (GMT+3)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/04a02e4a88faccc695df7b1b587e645f7576e4ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6069dfd74ada876d2672d2d96a813a0b275aa263.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9cfdaf8423787a999392ffd68698f5321ff4198e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a5f035d99f7a464d4dacd34ff051827edf39a776.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/172cf18e905b0606ccca0f7df3d2ac979346e20f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e3efd5613f1f8bfc18cef49f902e0c7e0a599f11.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/49c054c569adc60096fb367f34d1006d23f14504.png
Added the ability to select a specific set of Christmas Tree decorations from the corresponding list.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2240d495bbc964b88c8bcb17ae7dc8473cc6e9a7.jpg
Gifts
The gifts can be received in the following activities:
• Gathering and decorations;
• With a slight chance from open world events;
• New Year Airdrops;
• Daily login rewards;
• Daily and weekly Season Pass tasks;
• Session Battles modes: Standoff, Dead Time and Subdivision Battles;
• For every new Season Pass level. By the time you log in into the game, you will receive the gifts for the level you have already reached.
Christmas Tree decorations
The decorations of one level can be combined, so don't be in a hurry to throw away duplicate Christmas tree decorations. Combining them will give you an upgraded decoration, which gives more Christmas Tree points
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/79788773b0c236caf72bae8fd995834d3017e79a.png
There is no limit to the number of decoration improvements in this case.
You can combine decorations either with a special button on the side panel or directly in the Christmas Tree decorations selection menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2240d495bbc964b88c8bcb17ae7dc8473cc6e9a7.jpg
Decorations can no longer be sold to the Exchanger for season currency.
Once the season event is over, gifts, and decorations for the Christmas Tree will be removed from the game.
Shelf for Christmas Tree decorations
A separate shelf has been added to each player's personal storage area just for Christmas Tree decorations.
Ten times bigger the standard personal storage shelf.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f52a593acc4343973e04ecd7cbdde0d08c91b765.jpg
When you open gifts, all new toys will automatically transfer to this shelf and be highlighted with a special frame.
Snowman
New mechanic for the Christmas Tree that affects Christmas Tree decorations.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/25a1319cfe2909a55645d5edd710cd0d57500a5c.png
You can feed The Snowman spare decorations. In return, he will supply you with the special coals and glasses for the Christmas Tree. Also, the Snowman's carrot will get longer… No, that's not what you thought… Literally… just a carrot.
We recommend you to check the Snowman's behavior depending on the number of decorations eaten.
The extra points go directly into the Christmas Tree leadership board without taking into account the various modifiers.
Coals can be used in the Snowman's lottery.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c1b2033fe9c160c4ab0524a3e956417ab1021987.png
This lottery's goal is to get four special rewards. Once the goal is reached, the player gets all the rewards from the card — both already opened using coals and those that remain closed.
After closing 5 cards, the Turboman Card х10 will appear. The same as Snowman's Card, but the rewards are 10 times greater. But the cost of the opening one is 10 times higher as well.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b7af43d3751fc61aaefee857dfafe184cc135a7c.jpg
Don't forget to pay close attention to what decorations you feed to the Snowman. Filtering and sorting features have been added to the Feed the Snowman menu to avoid losing valuable decorations..
Unique winter NPCs
Vasilich
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/01be1a645367d5333c65e83c5d2b72f0aaa31d9b.jpg
If you have any questions remaining about the snowstorm, you can find Vasilich in the safe zones to advise you on how to survive and act in these conditions.
The Grinch
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f830e1687febbab3c962775fc3017e1a77104455.jpg
The Grinch appears on the Scrapyard and Forge-11 locations. He offers a unique skin “Grinch” and a New Year's issue of STALBOY magazine in exchange for gifts. Good luck with the search!
Leadership board
When your Christmas Tree reach the 7th level, you can compete in the most beautiful Christmas Tree competition.
The results will be displayed in the leadership board, allowing you to track your current position and the number of points you need to win.
Final result will be shown at the end of the season event. Each participant will receive a reward based on their place on the leadership board.
Prizes in the battle for leadership
During this event, you will have an opportunity to compete for really impressive prizes.
We know we got your attention! Let's have a closer look at the main awards:
• ZIVCAS M2-C Armored Suit with unique leadership board place number.
Top 100 (Eu), Top 50 (Na), Top 20 (Sea) participants can obtain a legendary rank combo suit. But don't worry if you can't get it during the season event. The opportunity to purchase it will appear with the start of the next Act (summer 2025) for the cost of Act II Tickets.
• Transferable Elbrus Short Range Detector;
• Frosthrower;
• Frost razor.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/501586169b46e91a9d588be323d6d641f36d4dda.png

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [26.02.2025]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d2751640f154ac6f9358fbe3fea54606b7f175a1.png
Matchmaking system
The following changes have been made to the matchmaking system:
Removed calibration
Now, when you use more powerful gear in the open world, you'll get to the servers matching your power immediately, rather than gradually.
Note:
• Earlier in the system, there were situations where a notional newbie could get Master rank gear and stay on their difficulty for a while. Now that's not going to happen.
• It's not an open matchmaking system — a player's power can still only grow upwards.
• The difficulty only increases when going into the open world. Don't worry, more powerful gear worn in Session Battles and in the Hideout does not affect the matchmaking.
Changes in the boundaries of the matchmaking levels
Player power limits for each difficulty have been narrowed slightly. Now you will meet opponents even more matched to your power.
Note: Previously, while wearing a Voshod/Thug suit and armed with an AKM, the maximum power equipment you could encounter was a worn Mule/Ace suit with an AK-203 (stock and no artefacts).
In the updated system, it is already a Samson/Trump +4 and AK-103 +4 (no artefacts).
Change in the impact of success in PVP on matchmaking
At early levels of matchmaking, such as Newbies in the Swamps, the impact of successes in PvP was enhanced. In the middle and late stages, such as the Stalkers at the Pervomaisky Factory location and beyond, it was minimised.
Note: The effect of PvP successes on matchmaking is only necessary to protect newbies from experienced players who decide to bully them. In the middle and late stages of the game, this is no longer necessary..
Network protocol
So far, our game has used the TCP. It performed well with a perfect connection, but failed with an unstable network.
Now is the time to move to a new network protocol based on UDP.
It opens up opportunities for net code optimisation and makes the game more stable, with significant latency and packet loss. In addition to implementing the new protocol, we made additional changes to troubleshoot and improve network performance.
UDP is in test mode. It can always be enabled in the game settings, in the Performance section, which presents a choice between the old and new network protocol.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ee3cc4c80be693c2d32a55a0e24af6686627f27b.png
During the open testing from 13 to 16 February on RU region, we have identified all aspects required for the successful operation of the new protocol.

Now the Digger Base for Bandits is located at the Kolos Agrocomplex location, and for Stalkers at the Black Willows location.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/defb8fb1c79cb21bee1cec06c857f0d8252229f3.png
Digger Bases are no longer located underground and are called Digger Hut for Bandits and Digger Plot for Stalkers.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/52ed7334273168074fcda6d4a22c3f0ef3b30ee1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6cf0e85381a4963d264d9b9bfb32ef07ad5bd5b6.jpg
If the player has visited the Digger Base, they have the option to reappear at this safe zone.
Since this is not the main safe zone, the player will only be able to buy consumables and charge devices to continue their journey further, but there is no access to personal storage at these bases.
Redefining the safe zones of the Roadside location
The Photon-2 and Garages safe zones were second in the outdated grading. It was decided to completely redefine them to reflect the new visual style of the Roadside location.
Now on the Bandits‘ side there is a Village School base, and on the Stalkers’ side there is a Fire Station base.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7f502ff4911cd9a8b781803954d12dde8a70060f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9b195a51c0f7d9c8ecc5c9e7d44f120effd5472c.jpg
These bases were made with a bias towards player findability, where we reworked:
• The location of the main quest NPCs from other quest NPCs.
The main quest NPCs will now be in separate convenient places, where players should not interfere too much with those who just wanted to buy consumables for the next raid.
• The location of functional NPCs.
All trade functional NPCs in the safe zones of the Roadside are now in pairs and sometimes groups.
• Visual style of trade points.
New players will now be able to visually locate the right NPC thanks to updated models of signs and the very counters where merchants are located.
• Added a separate room for events.
This is a future plan for all safe zones, but we plan to have all NPCs and unique content during season activities in special dedicated rooms that will be decorated for the theme of the season.
Improvement of safe zones of The Swamps location
After gathering feedback from players, it was decided to finalise the Ataman's HQ and the Boathouse.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7976dbbc865174dd2d399894bf7052ac999619e6.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b047c3948ec9cbba5518475be2fb26de9518a4ea.jpg
For easier player navigation, it has been redesigned:
• Trade NPCs placement;
• Quest NPCs placement;
• Room geometry for more comfortable movement.
Future plans for safe zones
After gathering feedback and completing other projects, we will also redesign the following safe zones:
• The Bar;
• Safe zones of the northern factions.
We plan to improve the player experience by:
• Avoiding bunker-type safe zones altogether;
• Giving a unique visual style for each functional NPC;
• Adding new mechanics that will deepen player interaction in safe zones.
QoL improvements
Outpost capture progress-bar
Added an impersonal progress bar for capturing an active outpost to the map event description.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/748acf6f80a0058ac67279a0aab30bc6768a1ca3.png
When hovering over the event icon on the map, you can see the progress of capturing an outpost.
Notification of the beginning of the outpost capture
Added notification of the beginning of a battle for an outpost.
The notification appears as follows:
• For attackers – When starting an event to kill an outpost boss;
• For defenders – At the start of the active capture phase of an outpost.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/698ddbea6f8738fab83cf40da1d4b6bfdf8ac5ad.png
Display of a penalty to movement speed from weapons
Added a previously hidden movement speed penalty to weapon and character characteristics, which works when the weapon is in hand.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fa03d1ed33da154d3ab5ea5b3987575c212879e2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8a5ff47b6c65eff190bc282a7b33a30160f32e55.png
Also, in character stats, you can now track the decrease in movement speed as the overload increases.
Unpacking bags and crates
Added the ability to fully unpack packed items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9538911cd8bfa11157bc860c9eea3f6dccd6608a.png
Updating the functionality and interface of merchants
Reworked the sorting of merchant assortment on all safe zones.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4c18b37c69e813e527d6960aa3246815cc389c07.png
Also, starting in the North, items that are crafted in the Hideout have been added to the merchant's assortment.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9a272e0fffe3efd2b9d294907796b42ce95de3c5.png
These items cannot be bought from a merchant, but the player can now add crafted items to their trade packs for quick purchase.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ab4438f313a712422be937d6c90d93417e37c433.png
Since these items cannot be bought, they can only be obtained by using the “Use items from personal storage” function.
From safe zones where there is no access to a personal storage area, trade packs will not work.
It is also now possible to view item crafting from the merchant's menu when right-clicking on a crafted item.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a551dfbe576dcbfc412d36c526afa07c74c044b6.png
Redesign of night vision goggles
Dark nights
The nights in the Exclusion Zone have become much darker.
The further the player moves north, the darker the nights become. If you can still do without a night vision goggle in The Swamps, then further on you can't.
• Old night at The Swamps location.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9762c40a81f6f82a95e33ca1d5acd44949cce54e.jpg
• New night at The Swamps location.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f39fd65ca1350957467310eb436f4f2294d75f09.jpg
• Old night at The Pervomaisky Factory Bar location.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4825089e8862c1f4194f836c98e955080818ee6b.jpg
• New night at The Pervomaisky Factory Bar location.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/220ae0d27c1f6d42de4d30d68720fab06afaacee.jpg
• Old night at The Serpentine location.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ca1d95ea2a49fb63dfa76588367f6d6a66636fa0.jpg
• New night at The Serpentine location.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/52cd6454f53499de79a9b236f1f72b730ffa7e44.jpg
Night-Vision Goggles
All night vision goggles were massively redesigned. We tried to remove all the problems of past NVGs and make playing with them more enjoyable and comfortable.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8b0f18ca15ea00f0bf89b15938ccc243616d3384.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/05245fdcbd0a641b4126ad786a3ab26722c6b61b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3b9f969f8838bf99282f6e87a8c74db81d2b8357.jpg
Among the nice things, the detector screens, the SN-2u Leglet and the Castor F2N appearance screen on the FAMAS G2 are now clearly visible when the NVG is switched on.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a9e6ca706245351ac771d62bfcfeece698de78f4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5ec57a555a2a38c05aa29688b4de155de04adad4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/19d76ea5e90f2687435c63b40821934633859116.jpg
Getting all the NVGs is now only possible through the barter tree.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d08058384e8ae0b892e44cd88e1875683f40c8db.png
The latest model of the NVG implies three variations of different colours.
The choice between them is absolutely free so that the player can choose the option they feel more comfortable playing with.
Two conceptual NVGs have also been added: Broken NVG and Aww scary NVD They are designed primarily for media content creation, but not for performance play.
Replacing old NVGs with new models
The old NVGs models were replaced with new assault models of appropriate quality.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/80bb62a2577168f4a46266089930a6be38b8ea2b.png
All transferable NVG models are converted to a personal NVG with associated compensation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ddb4b8b0f60198f6d12e51e774fc306adc3fd7bc.png
Also, each player, for all available armour on the character, was given one NVG of the best model.
It should be noted that if the player has a suit with Combat NVG, which existed in a built-in form in a number of suits, the player will receive an Assault NVG of Master quality.
Changes to armour barter branches
The development team decided to remove all worn and damaged versions of the suits from the barter progression. In addition, the MIS-113 Iolite, MIS-116 Emerald, MIS-116 Emerald, and MIS-105 Topaz suits were removed from the progression of the scientist branch of suits, and the Scythian-4b Armored Suit was removed from the progression of combo armour.
Now all suit branches are linear development and progression, except for the AH and Exoskeleton branches, these branches as before start in branches of other armour classes, scientist for the AH branch and combo for the Exoskeleton branch.
As part of the redesign, some armour styles have moved to the last armour types from progression.
Styles and the armour they are now fitted to:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6221afda990f01bd7b5bc821297fbb670aea15bf.png
Southern signals and SRD Buryat craft changes
From now on, signals on such locations as Scrapyard, The Pit, The Forest, The Dead City, The Graveyard, The Path of Fools and Polesskoye will depend more on the number of players on the location, which will make it easier to get them on average.
Also, crafting of Buryat and camo containers will be aimed towards Northern locations, making them more accessible and relevant on average.
Changes in SRD Buryat craft
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/741980ff2f4191ef1bc6f1ff3d58370941e7b7f5.png
Changes in crafting of containers with weapon camouflage and armour camouflage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f0b78cfcebc8ba7bb48ca6c68e4f8b914f7ea66a.png
Balance Changes
HK XM8S rework
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0b9132bc2c9f34676280222f5570ebb063a5d09e.png
• Players who have improved HK XM8 or HK XM8S in the Arsenal workshop will be compensated with 10000 Arsenal reputation;
• Players who have Arsenal's HK XM8S and HK XM8S on hand will receive updated HK XM8S;
• Added the ability to exchange Arsenal's HK XM8 and HK XM8 for the HK XM8S from the Exchanger and Dealer before the end of the season.
• Added a free exchange offer of HK XM8 for Arsenal's HK XM8. The offer will only be available until the end of the season.
Weapon, armour and plate changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6132d7efdea3066d86cc71db56efd2d3963a37eb.png
Magazines changes
Previously, magazine penalties and bonuses were excessive, causing a conventional assault rifle with an ergonomically designed magazine to have significantly less hip spread than a submachine gun, which has the default advantage of reduced hip spread.
A similar situation occurred with penalties — a drum machine gun could have a much greater hip spread than a machine gun.
The situation has been bad for the perception of weapons, causing the range of penalties and bonuses to be significantly narrowed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9c086a209fd08ebabef29430785d35024cd94e03.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3aeaf40f10403b8a46bad7f62096761ec6701122.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cf395d57acded937a61060962e40a0b28a5024d2.png
Overheat changes
Previously, the overheat limit of a weapon did not take into account the initial damage and was set solely by the size of the magazines. The principle of setting the limit has been changed to take into account the damage a weapon must do at its level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ae6b1edc098e16a1f0f7e10807b203c640d6dce0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/04dca3ebe39554aa3da96556b27dfd8af5a19e64.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a34f6956544cdfb3bf47637a5c2b254b45864a67.png
Hideout changes
The ability to quickly exit Hideout into the open world has been added. The exit leads to the location corresponding to the last visited safe zone.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2a5bba962fd0e70a9937d0971544e20ee86110b9.png
Added the ability to remove all objects, extensions and decorations to the laptop interface, as well as view the object characteristics and remaining extensions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2994db5f4a125dd7423dea8d592b144729d215bd.png
Also, all functional safe zone NPCs have been added to the laptop with some changes, which you'll learn about below:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/603481d013bcfc5ebacb03aa2d06828746b1f6a3.png
Any barter item can now be purchased from the equipment merchant in the Hideout according to the reputation level of the desired equipment.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2511588aa4064a7abac5b4c5d725c99332e5492e.png
Installing additional extensions to the Generator (you can learn more about the mechanics of the Hideout here) increases the energy decay rate for artefacts in the Hideout Researcher. Note that each extension has its own cleavage rate increase value.
When the Generator is upgraded, the Hideout Researcher is also upgraded. It became possible to increase a scientist's speed of energy decay.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/22ea2b002c2d4c391796ffb1d5fa465398fd4a83.png
Hideout merchants are also affected by all boosts from faction bonuses and subdivision bonuses.
Added the ability to charge devices in the Inverter for hideout energy.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/1a6dd7f3f7e2c2b323f9bcc9693748a47c67319d.png
You can now choose to respawn in Hideout when you die. If you select this option it will become a priority, it also works vice versa.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5a3a024c0d463bc54d65e0b6757ffda7db7bdb5b.jpg
Outposts and quest locations will still have the highest priority of respawn locations.
Added the ability to go to Hideout from the regular map, not just the global map. Also added a function to switch to the hideout from the map with the Q button.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/978ae05aed7cd01c83aabaa05d8757e8dcd159df.jpg
Switching between item crafting tabs can now be back and forward using the Q and E buttons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d3799cd518cd036ef50b3fc211b98c9f4f9c0371.png
Hideout item capacity has been increased to 300.
Arsenal Changes
Changes have been made to the cost of the following items:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3ec67d34ee36b056891e985e2d6585ea98733e20.png
Issued a separate compensation in the form of the reputation value difference of the Arsenal altered Items.
Safes changes
Added new items in the safes contents.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b85633b2600988fb4fc4a3f3aea31fe574188504.png
The following items have also been added to all safes:
• Advanced Spare Parts;
• Advanced Tools.
Changes in armour characteristics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d9828b2b1f4d8fbaa66385fc8308e268f9bbc237.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fc8c233a49f5cb27a2c675e78b69cb67227357b5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/434eaa85ab971da50e6c7aa9c5cd1215072ef067.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ecbbfc08e2336d94311ab4b41b5594167dfa7f6b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5926a1dcd6f5457f2903c932fc9ff410c62bbe40.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e610ed9c6fa2226a5e8b11621340b98ede48375d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/112db496a58d168094f186d15f160924c4080265.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b96aa758701d14b5fde20b9daf289aab334c42bd.png
Armour compensation
Replacing player armour
https://support.exbo.net/en/help-center/articles/2/2/545#mcetoc_1ilik0tm02c
Compensation for players who bartered final versions of master armour during the last year
Due to the fact that some players will receive master versions of armour as part of the basic compensation, the development team decided to compensate the barter of players depending on the time of ownership of the armour and, accordingly, the unlocked potential of the master armour.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/39667b6ab554434c08887ab8ac3ebceca919e912.png
Other changes and fixes
• Daily login rewards no longer have a time limit after which they will disappear;
• Season points from Session Battles and Dead Time are no longer issued as timed points, but as sealed season points tied to the current season;
• Now to change the copy of the location by transition you need to wait 30 seconds or die, also bubbles are placed on the locations, which are aimed at changing copies of locations;
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/99cd7d181a5874dfeda535d9b332e96721cac809.jpg
• Added models of ammo lying on the ground;
• The Sig Sauer P320 paint mask has been updated;
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a7241a004717eb7f143c009148286c2cb42378be.png
• The paint mask of the ALK-22 Dragonfly has been updated;
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4765e8e299172063b48a538976a4a5d4c036c2c5.png
• UPD: Updated Kurkri model
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/655bb068de5afa8f63da8d1bc4aa6c3bb3cfb87c.png
• Fixed incorrect appearance of the player during the final assault of Forge-11 in the North storyline, when the player appeared right in front of enemy fire;
• Fixed a bug that made it impossible to talk to Mormon.

historical_patches.title: Q&A with Kazugaia
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8650eff1007a83db5d6393b0337ef8033da62e59.jpg
Kazugaia — Game Director of STALCRAFT: X.
Well, dear players, this is Kazugaia. I am the person who plans releases of our glorious game and determines what we will do next. Obviously, I do not make all decisions on my own, but according to the requirements of various analyses, available resources and problems of the game.
Before I move on to your questions, I'd like to say that the answers will be rather skimpy. Why? Because I'm just going to come to the Discord server and answer your questions there for some time. I believe that a live chat is much better than a simple reply.
I will keep silent on some questions, I won't tell you the timeframe, and I'm unlikely to give you specifics either. Any words I say now will be used by you against us within N time. But I will be able to share my hypothetical thoughts about the development of STALCRAFT: X in each of the directions and highlight the main issues we face in their possible development — besides the lack of resources.
Well, read the Q&A and go ask me questions in the Discord discussion!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a042eecbdbbd2cba157a06c6e7e143f1d1627bc4.png
We plan to redesign Lyubech next summer with a complete rework of the location. We will not simplify current Lyubech. If you want to experiment on the current Lyubech — gather a petition, if there will be a lot of people I'll poke events there myself. But this does not mean that Lyubech will become easier…
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/90b57aaa34e2e001f38accb614fa31b27c3f60ca.png
Yes, it's expected. Either this year or next year. Too many issues with the quest date. ROOT CHARACTER FACTIONS WON'T BE ABLE TO BE CHANGED.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e2ff1bc7764137b5fad400c470eb3b58e0f17e82.png
Players strive to factions, and the preponderance is different on each server. Armour and player preferences affect. As soon as all factions will have armour, only preferences and unaccounted factors will impact. We will try to cover unaccounted factors, and with preferences will not do anything.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ac839d651eeb5a36f118f6db103f819752e55644.png
Unfortunately, I can't, because I don't have enough resources to put a person to work on sound only. I can say that 1 of the iterations of the positional sound has already passed the tests, now the second one is in development, but due to the workload of the programmers I can't give any deadlines.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/873fae4151292cbc2c5da9421652d0fa1072795b.png
March-April. If we don't run into any problems.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c78dce53f4eb5fd060063f82259298efbf6fb06f.png
We haven't planned something like this yet.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9fde94f09689557b62ac6e4ddc4e02ec69309b91.png
It is planned to add a branch of backpacks together with the rework of backpacks. And it also depends on inventory rework, which is also planned.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9a5bd0644adcee4b9623b615019cc2acb330cd68.png
There will be separate gear for signals, with signal rework. Mechanics will get a change.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/72ce2ef6ed71dd854bab55188b5affaf56c8e30c.png
These items will go into season boxes as extra filler.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8847f375e0aca9ee45b24b79e6f5002145797e69.png
There are no plans yet.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6286472e75b4b770831eb366104d104852295d66.png
Then the event cannot be re-launched next year. We have already had such an experience, and as a result the mode was abandoned by players within half a year. So we are not leaving them for now. If there will be more players, we will probably leave some of these modes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7aff495d69190f3e1ea15eba9745ffe687b38a92.png
I would like to, but not a priority in the near future. The mechanics are not trivial, and there is not much impact.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/846059eb70ffad3ab036aa6d3d91446341484f64.png
It's very difficult to describe. In short: we have the option of developing into wild locations, and developing into faction gameplay. Both concepts contradict each other, and we would like to understand which of these concepts the gamers like more. Some events and content updates are aimed at increasing the understanding of where the endgame will go.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a51103e2f428867143770c8dbd9fb4ee954e66d9.png
Unfortunately, that's not possible right now. But we are preparing for open matchmaking. For example, on the new Roadside NPC spots will vary in difficulty depending on your matchmaking level. Open matchmaking is very closely tied to faction balance, as well as the economic viability of locations, so it can't be released here and now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0bb286fa586d9fdba917338ed805171b00803d3a.png
We really want clan halls. The problem is that they require a lot of resources. We will try to start full development this year. Personally, I would like to see on the base standing D-30 artillery batteries, which you equip to the CW, and can use them to a limited extent, and similar things.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cb8aeb9f84a5fce7002fa92d071a3d28810fe72e.png
There are at least 5 projects aimed at balancing factions and fighting AFK copies. They will be released as soon as they are ready.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6428bcd15a150091ae62509d5b984d6d2eccbe4b.png
It will be possible to convert extra items into something.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7aff495d69190f3e1ea15eba9745ffe687b38a92.png
The contusion effect will be possible together with the rework of infection effects. The grenades themselves, I don't know if we will rework them significantly, but we will definitely try it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3c0289a6b453cc41775f5bf537aa0ce10f4c1257.png
New locations are in development.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fc0c25a1fc7cbd095845e0d6def849a4c085b617.png
Yes, it's planned.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9969a03e28c8d96bbe803447c6a594e96ab3de47.png
Yes, we do. When we're done with the main gun branches, we'll move on to the secondaries.
Q&A session to be continued in Discord discussion!

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [19.03.2025]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9b0ad793e4c789d2d968c3149c385e81b38d54ab.png
Faction armour
Adding analogues of the armour suits of the northern factions
Faction armour suits have been set to four archetypes:
• Super-Heavy;
• Combat;
• Combo;
• Scientist.
Armoured suits of the combat, combo, and scientist archetypes have minor differences in characteristics that highlight the individuality of the Northern factions, but remain within the intended archetype.
We will monitor the effectiveness of the suits and adjust the ones that are striking out in effectiveness accordingly in a timely manner.
All suits will carry their temporary model! In the future, the models will be changed to more elaborate versuibs.
• Frontier's combo suit
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5ec28f5b050fb1b12f0eefd6c1b9b15a50259d26.png
• Frontier's scientist suit
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/63c264e60692cd94b084ce872499bf463d68ac6c.png
• Covenant's combo suit
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d8c8cf0a3c0a94c27356955bd913e2b9c21e4475.png
• Covenant's combat suit
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cb7ca37f110c390cafd948ebbb6f4c8218396949.png
• Mercenaries combat suit

historical_patches.title: Theory of the Inside Out
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e8b2c2b825706d1cf542354957b481514ab349a8.jpg
Inside Out, Inside Out, Inside Out… How many conjectures, hypotheses, and questions revolve around it. Seekers make theories about how it will manifest and what consequences it will bring. 
In order not to multiply conspiracy theories, we turned to a specialist — a real scientist who has devoted several years to studying the Inside Out, Dr. Carpetsky. He kindly agreed to give the interview. After we placed a bet for him in the bar sweepstakes.
Dr. Carpetsky is a scientist, inventor, and expert (perhaps self-proclaimed) on all the Inside Out questions.
— It was very wise of you to contact me on this issue. My colleagues would have a 97.5% chance of confusing and misinforming you, and with such a delicate structure as the Inside Out, it could cost you your life. So, what are you really interested in?
— Tell me, Doctor, what is this Inside Out?
— Well, since this is an interview, then the short answer is 86% unlikely to suit you.In fact, the Inside Out is a subspace that is likely to be mutually dependent on the Zone and very similar to it, but exists according to other fundamental laws.
— How did it even appear?
— There are two versions of the origin of the Inside Out: it was either created artificially in some way, or it is an unexpected result of entropy. 
Eruptions in the Zone generated too much energy, some of which, unable to dissipate, interacted with the noosphere. The result of this synthesis was the birth of the Inside Out.
— They say the Inside Out changes everything it touches. How would you describe this phenomenon?
— This phenomenon is commonly called “distortion”. Of course, this is just a theory, but I believe that “distortion” is both a state and a process. That's what I'd bet on.When an object of our reality gets into the Inside Out, it carries information that is alien to it. Therefore, this space strives to make the object “its own”, replacing the original information of the object with itself. But it is not able to completely change the object due to the limited amount of information that matter can contain.This is the process of “distortion”. When the amount of information on both sides reaches a balance, “distortion” sets in as a condition. The object is now in superposition and is considered to be something suspended in the middle between two realities. A phantom!
— The phantoms? Are these the projections of people that can be found there?
— Perhaps they can be considered projections.… I am 72% sure of this. When the Inside Out replaces some original information of living objects, it remembers what it has displaced and projects its outlines in the place where it has overtaken. And since the distorted object contains both the original and the modified data, the phantoms manifest themselves in our Zone when the influence of the Inside Out is especially strong.
— It makes me feel uneasy. And why do they even appear?
— Perhaps this is because the original information of the object is pushed away from the one of the Inside Out and is drawn to its own kind. And when the border gets thinner, it finds a way out and is reflected here. But this phenomenon has hardly been studied, and I would not bet money on the truth of this hypothesis.
— Well, thank you very much, Doctor, for clarifying at least a little what we are going to face.
— You're welcome, I was glad to help! And even though your bet didn't play out, I'm sure that we definitely met for a reason. I'm not saying goodbye, because I think we'll meet soon.

historical_patches.text:

Session Battles update
A major update to session battles has been introduced to the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b26903c884ac72285f375d954506d45f4bcf8299.png
A new merchant, unique barter branches, temporary paints and charms. Two new game modes, a custom-built map for them, and of course a new interface for all of this stuff!
Let's take it one step at a time.
Session merchant
A new merchant and part-time organiser of session battles, Spartak, has appeared in the Zone.

You can find Spartak on the Pervomaisky Factory Bar and on the safe zones of each Nothern faction.
Reputation and currency of session battles
Reputation
First and foremost, the reputation system of session battles has been redesigned. It now fully inherits the combat set rules and is converted at a 1 to 1 ratio.
The player now has a “session battle level”. Reputation is earned for completing any session match.
Each new level opens after receiving 10,000 points. The number of levels is endless.
As the player levels up, they will unlock access to new items from the merchant.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/30b9f726b70beab9905add7c82b6aa83dc43334d.png
Battle Tokens
For completing a session match, the player will receive battle tokens, which will be the currency of session battles. They can be spent at Spartak.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/04629bddb64c8f53bcf426ffcbe921810f3807b6.png
Players who have previously been active in session battles will receive emails with rewards in the form of battle tokens.
Ranks
Depending on the session battles level, you will receive a certain rank. At the moment, it's just a visual display of your achievements.
The rank cannot be lost, and it will not reset.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4ef8e802269618794efbef6b956ef0807dec84f6.jpg

The first one who kills the enemy with the last weapon wins the match!

The second mode, DeathMatch (DM), was inspired by games like Quake. It is fast and dynamic, with a short TTK and difficult shooting.

Season Pass points for session battles
You will receive Season Pass points for completing the session match. They will be issued in unsealed form and credited immediately.
Their number directly depends on your contribution to the match..
Report system refinments
Added a feature that allows you to report the player right in the characters profile.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9e59d0f90ae14d32254a25d5fe63c6a84860faa1.png

Heavy combat suits
Heavy combat suits eventually became obsolete over time, giving way to more comfortable representatives of their class.

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [09.04.2025]
Patchnote [16.04.2025]
historical_patches.text:
Back to the Inside out season event 
The Back to the Inside Out season event is a time-limited PvE mode designed to help players earn points for the Season pass.
Each match lasts 30 minutes, and the goal is to collect Onyx, which can then be converted into Season pass points at a 10 to 1 ratio.
So, if a player extracts 10,000 Onyx, they’ll receive 1,000 Season pass points.
At the moment, only the regular mode is available.
How to enter the Inside Out?
While in a safe zone, a player can start a match at any time via the Spring Season menu — go to the “Event” tab and hit the “Play” button.
Before each match, players choose between three locations, each with its own difficulty level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/db436d494f2fada76bbbccf749be53832ffa7501.png
After every eruption, the set of available locations is updated.
Choosing difficulty
Difficulty affects several key aspects of the run:
• Onyx multiplier;
• Intensity of passive distortion;
• NPC and mutant balance;
• Amount of Onyx gained from farming;
• Boss fight stages;
• Rewards found in Inside Out safes;
• Quality of Inside Out artefacts;
• Amount of stabilized Amalgam needed to exit the Inside Out.
Difficulty also affects the maximum number of Season pass points that can be earned per match:
• For easy difficulty level — 2000 Season pass points per match;
• For medium difficulty level — 3000 Season pass points per match;
• For hard difficulty level — 4000 Season pass points per match.
Which locations are available?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4f1e66627fe6ec92e084d2e9084694b02cd5c1ec.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f6bfa7fbd8cb15a54be185233e3323f20ee363be.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/aa83af138da2388dea9c8e6ca79d9e5765ecd16d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/99251306107eb85a8e27d0a8f6b0f01399cfc032.jpg
Currently, players can choose from the following locations:
• Kolos Agrocomplex;
• Black Willows;
• Roadside;
• Forge-11;
• Stillwaters.
During the season event, the number of available locations will increase to ten.
Distortion
Distortion is a unique infestation effect found in the Inside Out world. It accumulates in the following ways:
• Passively, while staying in a location. It scales with the match’s difficulty level;
• By taking damage from NPCs and mutants.
If a player accumulates 1,000 units of distortion, they will die.
To reduce distortion, players must either collect Memoria Fruits scattered around the ground or purchase consumables that lower distortion from the Hub.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5ce8b509f0a8b9deff968b83e74288776b5f98cd.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4302599a8d29d2a549671b13df96fc7dfd75e5fd.png
Onyx multiplier
In the top-right corner of the screen, players can see various values: match time, total Onyx earned, and the current Onyx multiplier.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c68d0dfad6c3c7379237daf822f513ba5cc1d8a7.png
The Onyx multiplier depends on:
• The selected difficulty level;
• The amount of Onyx the player is currently carrying.
The more Onyx you carry, the higher is the multiplier — meaning you earn Onyx faster.
However, the trade-off is that you also take on more distortion from NPC and mutant damage as the multiplier increases.
The Hub
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b7386f406faf76171fabf7b3a626541b370ef9bc.jpg
Items and consumables purchased from the Hub cannot be taken out of the Inside Out.
The Hub is a local shop within the Inside Out, where players can purchase both standard consumables and unique items related to the distortion.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/78ddea63f7353bb7ce9e7078ca23831c6bb94113.png
These consumables help players reduce distortion or even respawn and continue their journey within the Inside Out.
Phantom Melody
If a player purchases the Phantom Melody, upon death or reaching the maximum level of distortion, they will transform into a Phantom.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/111a70460277af96607ebc8c46c58ef4792febf3.png
To escape the Phantom state, the player must complete a special challenge and, within a limited time, reach the Altar of Cleansing.
Upon successful completion, the player will revert to their human form.
Stabilization
If a player accumulates an excess of stabilized Amalgam, they will not be able to take it into the open world.
There is a group of items that require stabilization:
• Amalgam;
• Inside Out artefacts;
• Some items found in Inside Out safes.
To extract these items from the Inside Out, players must stabilize them.
Stabilization becomes available after completing the Stabilization installation event.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/09807ce4f7a8f8c3fe76fab7ef94a700493c2675.png
Once the event is completed, players can use a special sphere to stabilize the required items in exchange for Onyx.
Boss
The Inside Out features a unique boss with distinct attacks and multiple combat phases.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6a5b37f38b2899e7d2a516263480c08acbcc4281.jpg
These bosses are designed for team play and are separate from the usual Season pass point grind. Defeating them rewards players not only with unstabilized Amalgam, but also with a key to the Inside Out safes.
Inside Out safes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/249e5bc55821508914dc370e36c23e617cdf1043.jpg
After clearing a boss, players receive a safe key.
Inside each safe, you can find:
• Onyx;
• Unstabilized Amalgam;
• Two unstabilized Forgotten supplies crates;
• Two Memoria Extracts.
Depending on the match difficulty, you may also find:
• Two unstabilized units of standard parts and tools;
• Two unstabilized units of advanced parts and tools;
Players can open up to six safes per eruption — two safes per difficulty level across three available tiers.
Inside Out artefacts
After each eruption, unique artefacts are born within the Inside Out. Their properties are significantly more powerful than their regular counterparts — but at a cost: they negatively affect other attributes of the bearer.
The Inside Out introduces ten new exclusive artefacts that can only be found within its depths.

Burnt Onyx
The player may use 150 units of Burnt Onyx as a first aid kit.
You can receive Burnt Onyx in the following ways:
• When stabilizing items;
• Buy in the Hub with Onyx.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2fd582af985ada41a9c9658a1319155483e9e875.png
Exit the Inside Out
Depending on the selected difficulty, different amounts of stabilized Amalgam are required for exit.
• Easy — 8 stabilized Amalgam;
• Medium — 6 stabilized Amalgam;
• Hard — 4 stabilized Amalgam.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/1e1e67d09591635ab8522eb1e3afe3d766850252.png
Upon exiting the Inside Out:
• All earned Onyx is converted into Season pass points at a 10 to 1 ratio;
• All stabilized items are transferred to the player’s inventory;
• All unstabilized items and Inside Out consumables are lost.
Third-person view
While in the Inside Out, the player can press the F5 button and play in third-person view.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/15fd8a7a476c31d7c001e732be7da2d6955fe5cc.jpg
Divided quest line
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d06a5c62da712feee07f9f62af7f4a1c242735e0.png
A stalker known as Mockingbird is in serious trouble. It seems that on his last raid into the Inside Out, he lost… himself. Try to save Mockingbird!
The quest is only available during the Back to the Inside Out season event.
Season pass
Added reward for 1000 level of Season pass.
Upon reaching level 1000, the player will receive a Model No. 47 style and a Deconstructor motif that can be worn on the MK47 Mutant.
The player can customise the weapon at their discretion by wearing either the style together with the motif, or by wearing only the Model No. 47 style.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/09bc65106ae1e794487bc71ca45c29d862b025ab.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7ce619e68db344b1ae212b6a6dc9b7ba2853741e.png
More details on the mechanics of using both the style and motif at the same time will be described below.
Season challenges
With the upcoming Inside Out, special season challenges of varying difficulty have been added to the game. Can you complete them all?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/37dc3ac726bc10fc232148ba5d10e547f4a29eb8.png
Special offers
Back to the Inside Out starter pack №1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fb35efd0ddcd86a486ceaa4e1cd255890fd1a61d.png
The first Back to the Inside Out season pack has been added to the game and includes the following items:
• 50,000 seasonal points;
• 100 Forgotten supplies crates;
• Woobaga charms.
New Back to the Inside Out motifs
New motifs available for purchase:
• The Inside Out imprint motif for the Saturn jumpsuit. The motif is compatible with both the standard version of the suit and the Liquidator style.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9e2734e80a40b3caa443edd31a733b799f77bf6f.png
• The Break-through motif for the VSS-M Vintorez sniper rifle. The motif is compatible with both the standard version of the weapon and the Vint style.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/061706433bbbcc808d849eb09382cbdb74ac2af7.png
Last spring styles
Last year's spring styles are available in the shop with a special discount:
• The Wisest for Saturn jumpsuit;
• Lizardbane for Saiga-12 shotgun;
• Perun's Wisdom for OTs-33 Pernach pistol.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d86975950deaef6205e31e1d14b9aa9798b33169.png
Separation of styles and motifs
Boxes for styles and motifs in the equipment customisation window have been separated.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e0a0a5f72ee29c3b302a23560db6ecc555496d3e.png
More motifs compatible with different styles will be added to the game in the future to allow the player to dive deeper into customising their character.
Interface update
Gear and artefact upgrade interfaces
The interfaces and design of the following entities have been updated:
• Gear repair.
• Gear upgrading;
• Artefact charge;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/02263275c54c8953ede7df618f5878bec33334a7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/997082144303a17bb5b5c1bffc71a7929bea7487.png
Changes in interface mechanics
You can now use these windows to select items directly from your personal storage, without moving the necessary items to your inventory.
It is also possible to choose which consumables to use, either personal consumables only or transferable with personal ones.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/984711cfffdda80183e76772e62a5bee425090b6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e6f00634319f1463efd43fd04d38306e1e4df923.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4fa89af33baadce9d1fa81ba65108a26ef99b925.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5f9f362e08ced998fc2724f7201affafddb2179a.png

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [23.04.2025]
historical_patches.text:
Seekers, thank you for your patience and unfailing activity! We listened carefully to your feedback after the Black Raid rating — and this time we decided to change our approach. The new format of the rating Back to the Inside Out mode has become more available: now everyone who shows persistence will be able to get their deserved rewards.
The league system is already familiar to many seekers, but now it has an important change — every league reached, except the highest, is permanently fixed. Progress is no longer rolling back, and you're guaranteed to receive all the deserved rewards, including the highly awaited Rubik artefact.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/e22ba2f5912a8bdd0682878ce8f01eba8685785e.jpg
Rubik is a mysterious artefact of the Inside Out that acquires unpredictable properties with each increase in potential. In other words, this artefact can have its properties rerolled!
The competitive intensity only remains in the top league, where only the best explorers (TOP-100 EU, TOP-50 NA, TOP-20 SEA) of the Inside Out will get in. This is where the real fight for a place and the main prize will unfold.
We would also like to point out that the interesting content does not end with this update. Ahead of the seekers awaits the third quest line, the largest of all within the season.
We also took into account your feedback on rewards: for the quest that is released today, the reward is already higher than for the first one, and for the third one it will be even tastier.
Back to the Inside Out event rating
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/1f6da5cc1dadce9e2421ea4732246a7805e5961e.jpg
The fight for the rating became available to every player in the period from April 23 to May 7 in the regular mode and the mode with a bet, which we will tell you about a little later.
The rules of participation are very simple — to get a rating, you need to take Burnt Onyx out of the Inside Out.
How to earn rating points?
First, you need to get the Burnt Onyx. This can be done in two ways:
• Stabilization of some objects in the Inside Out;
• Purchase at the Hub for regular Onyx.
Onyx is converted to Burnt Onyx at a ratio of 10 to 1.
In order for the Burnt Onyx to be converted into rating points, it must be taken out of the Inside Out.
Burnt Onyx is converted into rating points at a ratio of 100 to 1 (rounded up).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/675873a28f53d660040c42b9060b8c15b660027f.png
Rating ranks
Players who pass the calibration are included in the season event rating.
Once a player reaches a certain threshold of points, they will no longer be able to roll back to a lower rank, which means that they will receive a guaranteed reward.
At the same time, the player will not be able to lose rating points under any circumstances.
Below are the ranks with guaranteed rewards, as well as the number of rating points required to reach each of them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/95f6f599c6efd50cfe1d35bd8eabfb7333dcac28.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3dd603783f62d41d50a53f8c01d31818fa128bb9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5bd3e7b715bb7071d3a3a06efc94994707e1b913.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d6d87454a026c8af92d99785d11043e976e79c44.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6565ad89801dd634abfa6b0e10d25044da033f23.png
For each difficulty level there is a maximum number of rating points that can be obtained:
• For easy difficulty level — 140 rating points;
• For medium difficulty level — 180 rating points;
• For hard difficulty level — 250 rating points.
Holders of the Risen rank gain access to the final stage — the fight for a place in the TOP of the region of the highest Legend of the Inside Out rank.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/02137b0d92cf238f3fcd3b0a76cbf0d58051d8eb.png
Breach injection
For those who like to tickle their nerves, we have prepared the Breach Injection — it allows you to raise the bet by increasing the complexity of the gameplay in the Inside Out. It works on the principle of “more risk — more reward”, namely getting a significantly higher number of rating points.
Before entering the Inside Out, when choosing a mode with a bet, the Seeker can activate up to three injections. They apply random negative effects, but in return increase the conversion rate of Burnt Onyx into rating points.
In other words, for the same amount of Burnt Onyx taken out, the player will receive more rating if they used injections. At the same time, the limit on rating points remains unchanged.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8804c742fa9010d9ad29227d668d417963e090ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/87ff1c99c8d1e5be708bf9e1a2166bfe26a65f58.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c5f32643a6e869ed1a044b017242f350bb4c4b54.png
Each activated injection imposes a random negative effect — the more of them there are, the more difficult it becomes to survive in the Inside Out.
In return, the player receives tangible bonuses:
• With 1 Injection: raid rating is multiplied by 1.4 and the Season pass level cap is increased by 1;
• With 2 Injections: rating is multiplied by 2.1 and level cap is increased by 2;
• With 3 Injections: rating is multiplied by 3 and level cap is increased by 3.
Additionally, you can spend one injection to change the set of negative effects.
Important: in the rating mode, injections do not increase the maximum number of rating points allowed, they only multiply the number that was taken out.
Where to get Breach Injections?
After completing the calibration, each player will receive 3 personal injections.
Additionally, injections can be obtained in the following ways:
• For the Isonite season currency — in personal (non-transferable) form;
• As part of special Seeker sets — in this case, the injections will be transferable.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5b525e482e44e74a81cd602ac9c87dec3a833cbc.png
Besides, all Black chips remaining in players' possession after the autumn Black Raid event have been automatically replaced on Breach injections.
Echo Crystals quest line
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/082831af354fa6534571d723699e0cf1832c769f.jpg
Help Dr. Carpetsky research the mysterious echo crystals found in the Inside Out. They are said to contain echoes of voices you may have heard before…
The quest line is only available during the Back to the Inside Out season event and will be unlocked for those who have completed the main storylines of the South and North.
Special effect for Season pass level 1000 reward
It has been established empirically: Deconstructor style for MK47 Mutant, obtained in the Inside Out, with each kill, absorbs the souls of defeated enemies!
Be careful, Seekers! You should not point this weapon at those walking next to you.
Special offers
Advanced case
The Back to the Inside Out advanced case has become available in the in-game shop.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8ab825b4f682f6eafcf8b9f5eb98d1248af79996.png
In addition to the bonus item, a new 7.62×39 drum magazine has been added to the case to fit the A-762 Ares, MK47 Mutant and some other weapons of this calibre.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b7cc9a3a66de60f4068cb30adefc8da94c76a179.png
Hurry up. The offer is limited and will be available for 14 days.
The Inside Out Explorer's Pack
Additionally, the in-game shop has received the Inside Out Explorer’s Pack, which includes:
• 25,000 Season pass points;
• 25 Forgotten supplies crates;
• 25 Breach Injections;
• “The Other Bar” decor for the Hideout;
• Two paints for weapons and armour “Call of the Dead”.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a8698581bce88e1c13fadb401b14dec731b4be13.png
Other changes and fixes
• Minor adjustments have been made to the appearance of stray mutants in the Inside Out;
• The stabilization rig no longer breaks from the eruption in the Inside Out;
• Reduced the speed of small mutants of the Inside Out;
• Increased resistance to explosions for Inside Out mutants;
• When killing the boss of the Inside Out Amalgam, the safe key and other consumables drop as a reward only if you contribute 5% or more damage.
 We understand that the launch of the mode was not the smoothest — not everything worked as planned. But we are not giving up what we have started and continue to closely monitor the situation, collect feedback and step by step put the Inside Out in order.
We read all your feedback — and it helps us become better. Thank you for staying with us, Seekers. And ahead, besides everything else, there is at least one surprise waiting for you… a very smiling one.

historical_patches.title: Patchnote [07.05.2025]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4c360d3abd3425477c56d049f3500e2afe489fae.png
Repair Parts
When the Repair Parts currency was first introduced, there were plans to expand its use in new gameplay mechanics. However, after further discussions, we’ve decided to abandon those plans entirely and remove the outdated repair system, which no longer aligns with the concept of “free repair”.
As a replacement for removing this special currency, the cost of repairing equipment for rubles will be reduced, the amount of ruble rewards in activities and quests that previously awarded Repair Parts will be increased. A generous compensation will be provided: the conversion rate will be boosted, allowing players to exchange their remaining Repair Parts for items need for gear and artefacts upgrade.
We hope this change will make expeditions into the Zone more straightforward without causing significant inconvenience for players.
A new digger NPC named Estaсada has appeared in all safe zones.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ac1ec75ba421097c9c2eba04386187fc9c69c2a2.png
He offers to exchange your Repair Parts for the following items:
• Advanced Spare Parts and Tools;
• Standard Spare Parts and Tools;
• Unstable Anomalous Batteries;
• Catalysts.
All offers, except for the catalysts, have purchase limits that will not be refreshed.
For the next two weeks, players will still be able to use Repair Parts to fix their gear, after which this option will be removed.
After these two weeks, the NPC will disappear and remaining Repair Parts will be automatically compensated in rubles.
All sources of obtaining Repair Parts have been disabled, but ruble rewards in quests and activities have been increased.
Below is a comparison of ruble rewards before and after the removal of repair parts:
Before removal
