historical_patches.title: Patchnote [03.09.2025]
historical_patches.text:
Horrors of the Zone season
Something strange is happening in the Zone... More and more stalkers are encountering new oddities. Tales and rumours about various weirdness fill the Bar. Some blame anomalies or mutants, others the autumn madness. However, those who know the answers to the Zone's mysteries understand the true cause of the changes... But can an ordinary person get close to the solution and remain the same?
In this patchnote you will see the following changes: new Horrors of the Zone season, second iteration of Arsenal, artefacts, armours and containers balance changes, addition of in-game event hub, weather changes and much more.
Season rewards
In this season, the following key rewards are available:
• 
SR-1-10mm pistol;
• 
Witness Amulet Charm;
• 
Phantom Hunter Armored Suit;
• 
SMG Nut;
• 
Special Case Tokens;
• 
Experienced Hunter Skin;
• 
Claw Charm;
• 
Act II Tickets;
• 
Hunter's Ornament Container;
• 
Watcher Charm.
Pancor Jackhammer shotgun — a unique reward for reaching level 500.
Special Case
The Special Case now has new offers, and one of them is a unique shotgun — KS-12 Komrad.
Styles and Motifs
Added new unique motifs and styles for the Horrors of the Zone season to the shop.
Horrors of the Zone Starter Pack
The Horrors of the Zone season Starter Pack is now available for purchase in the in-game shop. It includes the following items:
• 
10 season levels;
• 
7 day Premium;
• 
Bad Intentions Paint in two pieces for weapons and armour.
Charms-Counters
You can now buy kill counter charms for session battles in the in-game shop.
You can now also exchange the open world kill counter charms for session battle kill counter charms at the Dealer NPC.
Events Hub
Events Hub is a new system for displaying in-game events and news. It’s designed not only to organise all relevant information, but also to serve as the place where in-game events will live — some of which you’ll be able to experience very soon.
The hub will include:
• 
Patchnotes, news, and important announcements;
• 
Events — both small and big.
When you enter the game, you’ll be greeted by a special page with the latest information, acting as a news hub. News is also duplicated in the character selection menu and remains available during maintenance.
You can access this section both from the initial character selection screen and through interaction buttons in the in-game menu.
On the events page, you’ll see brief information about each event, as well as links to the platform for discussion.
Daily login reward
Moved daily login rewards to the Event Hub.
From now on, rewards are no longer claimed automatically — you’ll need to collect them manually through the Event Hub.
Exchanger
You can now sell almost all unnecessary gear from past seasons to the Exchanger. Simply open the “Sell” tab at the trader to get rid of excess items.
Please note: Veteran and Stalker gear can no longer be purchased for Act Tickets.
Arsenal
New weaponry
The collection of weapons that Arsenal can upgrade has been expanded with the AUG A3, AK-12, and HK416. Upgrading them will cost you 20 000 reputation.
Upgrading attachments
Arsen is expanding his field of activity. He now also takes attachments for upgrades. Currently, you can upgrade grips, silencers, and muzzle breaks. An attachment upgrade will cost you 30 000 reputation.
Arsenal assignments
Arsenal has started offering daily tasks to those who want to obtain Arsenal items with less financial investment.
Here's the tasks that Arsenal can offer you:
• 
Shoot — Have a look. You are granted a random Arsenal weapon, and you must use it to eliminate a certain number of enemies. Once done, come back to Arsenal. Ammunition will be issued with the weapon. The weapon itself has a very limited durability amount. The weapon cannot be repaired, or used in various game modes.
• 
Feed Imp. You must gather an estimated amount of food for Imp.
• 
What are you murmuring over there?! You must find and destroy the Murmur psy-installations.
• 
Dig deeper, brotherly. You must dig out caches in Labirynth and Stillwaters.
Arsenal voiceover
Arsenal has been given his own voice, so that everyone can hear his charming tone!
Drossel
Drossel, a pal of Arsenal, has appeared in the Zone recently. He is ready to help you earn Arsen's reputation. Drossel can be found at faction bases.
He requires specific items which he then puts in packages for Arsen.
Items presets required for trading are individual for each player and will change daily throughout the week.
Packages come in two types: dropped upon death and not. The latter requires more valuable items. The list of items can be viewed when interacting with Drossel.
Changes to selling items to Arsenal
The Arsenal's items selling mechanic has been changed.
From now on, every day, each player will receive a random set of items instead of fixed sets shared by everyone.
Other changes
Reduced the number of players allowed to enter the Stillwaters burrow to two instead of five.
Weather
We’ve reworked both the visual and technical aspects of weather in the following locations: Radial North, Labyrinth, Lyubech-3, and Stillwaters.
Made minor adjustments to the weather in the South Zone, making it a bit darker and more ominous.
Updated vegetation colour grading across the entire Zone to match an autumn atmosphere, and in open-world locations added the effect of falling leaves.
Fog is now dynamically adapting to the character’s position, further enhancing the sense of immersion.
Balance changes
Containers
Here are the key changes you need to read to fully understand the container and artefact system update. Please review this carefully to make sense of all further adjustments.
We’ve reworked the system of containers, backpacks, and artefacts, extended the barter branches for both compact and bulky containers, while backpacks have now received full progression lines of their own. From now on, container effectiveness directly influences the strength of the artefacts placed inside.
Different types of containers have become more balanced: containers with fewer slots now provide greater comfort when assembling artefact builds. Containers with more slots offer far more potential power, but require a more complex setup — with reduced internal protection, they demand a more careful build approach. Overall, containers have become stronger, which is why their prices have been adjusted — though the amount of Serum required has remained unchanged. In addition, a completely new 7-slot container has been introduced — a true behemoth that will certainly attract those who enjoy assembling the most powerful builds.
Armour no longer comes with built-in advantages or drawbacks tied to equipping specific containers — you can now wear any container with any armour suit without limitations. As for artefacts, their changes are aimed at broadening build diversity: some presets have been updated to improve compatibility with new setups, and their certain qualities have been revised.
You can find more details about the balance adjustments in a separate article via this link.
Barter branch changes and edits
Due to the barter reshuffle, some items will be replaced with others for players.

historical_patches.title: Hotfix [06.09.2025]
Patch Notes [17.09.2025]
historical_patches.text:
The longer the stalkers dwell in the North, the more legends and rumors appear in their stories, but are they all true? The wanderers and allies from your faction you pass by in the North can now tell you what happens in the area, whether it's artifact hunting, storming outposts, or something else. However, lately, their stories have started to seem increasingly strange and even eerie. The Zone has begun to reveal hidden fears, reality is distorting, and piercing screams of the unknown echo throughout the night. And more often, the same advice is repeated: don't turn around at the sound of footsteps behind you, don't move, don't answer calls from broken phones. Or… Take a risk and find out where it leads.
In this patchnote, you'll find:
• 
Outposts changes;
• 
Painting of short range detectors;
• 
Exits from Klondike;

Outposts changes
Previously, you might not have received rewards from outposts when the eruption began. This has been fixed.
If an outpost event is cancelled by an eruption, the outpost will be captured by the faction with more than 50% capture progress. If there is no such faction, but more than 5 minutes have passed since the boss was killed, the outpost will go to the faction with the most progress.
In both cases, all participants of the event will receive the appropriate reward by mail.
Painting of short range detectors
Added the ability to paint short range detectors — weapon paints are used for this purpose.
Exits from Klondike
New exit points from Klondikes have been added to the Labyrinth.

Balance changes
Consumables adjustments
Reduced types of consumable effects: 
• 
Weak boost and Strong boost are merged into Boost.
• 
Strength Improvement and Stamina Improvement are merged into Mobility
• 
Bleeding Protection and Burn Protection are merged into Protection
The changes were made to reduce the number of consumables that need to be used simultaneously to get the maximum bonuses. For example, previously it was necessary to use both Pea Soup and Alcobull to obtain the maximum weight from the sum of Weak and Strong boosts, but now one Pea Soup or Alcobull from the new Boost category is enough.
Due to the reduction in the types of effects, the characteristics of many consumables have been revised. Now, consumables in the affected categories have a bias towards one main property and several (depending on the consumable level) additional properties that are weaker. The main property on average became stronger than the sum of the same properties from the two previously combined categories, while the secondary properties became slightly weaker.
For example, previously a character could gain a maximum of 4.2% vitality from using Weak and Strong 10-level boosts. Now they can gain 4.6% vitality from using a single 10-level boost, which main property is vitality, but the sum of secondary properties will be weaker.
Food now has a bias towards vitality, while drinks have a bias towards speed.
General balance adjustments: 
• 
Reduced sway duration after using certain consumables.
• 
Reduced excessive rollback time for some consumables.
• 
All consumables with the following effects: Boost, Protection, Mobility, no longer drop upon death (exception: Industrial Alcohol and consumables from direct sales by the supplier).

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [01.10.2025]
historical_patches.text:
Autumn reveals what was hidden. The leaves are falling, and with them, the last illusions of security. The frozen figures could come to life at any moment. Silence and calm became deceptive. Shadows in the darkness prepare cruel games for anyone who remains alone.
Your home is no longer your castle. There is no place that will be safe. The hunt has begun. The only question is who will be the prey.
New season updates
Psy-field hides many secrets. Where did it come from, how does it work, why does it drive crazy?.. Witnesses say that careless stalkers — whether due to lack of experience or inattention — return changed after entering the psy.
But now something else has appeared... something sinister. Stalkers whisper at the bar and around the dancing embers of the bonfire: don't stand in the psy-emission longer than usual... if you get more than 3000, you'll die. First, a strange message will arrive, then paranoia, panic, and you will disappear without a trace.
The voices in your head say: look around, pay attention to the little things, search for what is hidden in the darkness, and you will find it!
Discover more details in the game!
Side quests
Life goes on as usual in the North — the new side quests for Frontier and Mercenaries will tell you about the difficult situations faced by two factions that are so different, yet so similar in some ways. Household quarrels, unexpected returns, and simply stories about people outside the walls of their bases. 
Covenant and Rise will also receive side quests in the near future. After all, science does not stand still, and Peace in Suffering still needs to be brought.
Start of the Mushroom Harvest event
Special mushrooms have begun to appear in northern locations, which can be collected and delivered to a safe zone.
Upon entering the safe zone, collected mushrooms are automatically converted into the currency of the episode.
Various items can be purchased with the currency earned in the episode:
— Anomalous Serum;
— Spare Parts;
— Nightmare Collection case.
Mysterious items for the hideout drop from the Nightmare Collection case. 
Event features:
— The number of mushrooms appearing increases at night;
— The event will be available until the end of the current season.
Season pack №1
In the game, you can purchase a new season pack containing:
• 
40 Season Mysterious Loot crates;
• 
50 Season levels;
• 
2 Cheekbone charms.
Subdivision Battles
Off-season and rating season
The Off-season is played outside the active rating season, during which Subdivisions ratings do not change in Tournaments, rewards are set at a fixed level, and the matchmaking is still random.
It is necessary to allow players and subdivisions to take a break from intense battles, proceed with roster changes, and accumulate more resources for a new rating season.
The Rating Season will provide skill-based matchmaking in Tournaments mode, based on subdivisions rating. Rewards in the brackets are set according to the rank of the bracket's strongest subdivision, with both rating gain/loss enabled. Participants will be awarded rewards at the end of the season based on their rating and participation.
Off-season will be active from October 1 to October 8. In the meantime, developers will be fixing all the Subdivision Battles issues that have suddenly appeared. 
Rating season will be active from October 8 to November 2 (totalling four weeks).
We will be monitoring participants feedback and, based on the rosters “fatigue” and potential economic strain on subdivisions, will adjust our approach to running future seasons.
Ranks and ratings
Ranks
In total, there are 6 subdivision ranks:
• 
S | Best 4 subdivisions starting from 2000 rating points;
• 
A |‌ ‌ > 2000 rating points;
• 
B | 1750-1999 rating points;
• 
C | 1500-1749 rating points;
• 
D | 1250-1499 rating points;
• 
E | 0-1249 rating points.
During an active season, each subdivision will be set at 1000 rating points (equal to rank E) upon participating in Tournaments. During the Rating season, the subdivision will either gain or lose rating points while participating in Tournament stages.
Ranks determine the reward level in Tournament bracket stages during the Rating season, as well as the final reward received at the end of the season.
The rank system and the selection of the top four are based on the overall standings of all subdivisions.
The top subdivisions are no more separated to each faction.
Beginning of the Rating season
Subdivisions' ratings will be reset at the start of the Rating season. Ratings are reset using the following rules:
• 
All S and A rank subdivisions are reset to 2000 Rating points;
• 
Lower rank subdivisions are reset to lower threshold of their current rank only if not participated in 3 game days during the season; 
• 
If the subdivision is at the endpoint of their threshold and hasn't played 3 game days, it will be moved down to the minimum limit of the preceding rank;
• 
D ranks are reset to a rating of 1000.
• 
Rank E subdivisions are not applied to any rating changes throughout seasons.
Conditions for receiving season rewards and counting the game participation days

Conditions for subdivision members

 |

Attend 35% of all battle stages
Game Day is counted as valid for the subdivision when at least one battle on that day was not counted as a “Desertion”.
A battle is counted as a “Desertion” for the subdivision if one of the following conditions was met:
• 
Total kill count is below 30 players;
• 
In this case, the “Desertion” is assigned to the subdivision with the lower number of points counted below.
• 
The subdivision scored less than 10% of the total capture points.
• 
No Mobile Camps were placed.
• 
The Mobile Camp was bought and not deployed or destroyed by an enemy player;
• 
Not enough players joined the subdivision battle than the minimum threshold required for it to be registered.

•

• 
Also receives a personal reward, as the rest of the subdivision members.
Rewards are issued when the subdivision or its member meets the receiving conditions.
Rewards depend on the subdivision's rank at the end of the season (for ranks A to E) or its numerical position (top 1-4 for Rank S).

Change in the mode format
Up to 16 random participants are put into Brawls brackets, rather than 32 as before.
In the first stage, random groups of two to four participants are formed (depending on how many participants there are in a particular bracket). 
During the stage, participants earn capture points for holding key points on the map. Based on the capture points they have earned, they will share the prize pool in percentage terms.
After the previous stage, the groups of participants are reassembled based on their success in terms of the points they scored in the previous stage. That means those who do well in one round of Brawl will face each other in the next rounds.
Thus, there will be three stages. Even if you don't take first place in the group, you'll still play again.

The reward is given to the thirty best members of the subdivision who took part in the Brawl stage.

Change in the mode format
The mode brackets are still made up of eight participants per bracket. 
During the off-season, tournament brackets are formed randomly from participants and do not depend on their ratings. Ratings do not change based on wins or losses during the event, and prizes are set at the same level. 
During the active rating season, tournament brackets are formed based on the participants' ratings, which change depending on their wins or losses during the event, and the prizes in the brackets are awarded according to the rank of the strongest subdivision in the bracket.
Stage 1 
Participants in the grid start in 0-0 group. Pairs of participants are formed randomly and are not based on their ranking.
The winners of 0-0 group move on to 1-0 group, while the losers move on to 0-1 group.
Stage 2 
Pairs are randomly formed from participants in 1-0 and 0-1 groups. 
The winners of 1-0 group move on to 2-0 group, while the losers move on to 1-1 group.
The winners of 0-1 group move on to 1-1 group, while the losers move on to 0-2 group.
Stage 3 
There are only two participants in 2-0 and 0-2 groups, and the pairs there are fixed.
There are four participants in 1-1 group, who are randomly paired up.
Result
A block in the bracket for displaying the results of completed matches.
• 
3-0 - the winner of 2-0 group goes here;
• 
2-1 - the loser of 2-0 group and the winners of 1-1 group go here;
• 
1-2 - the losers of 1-1 group and the winner of 0-2 group go here;
• 
0-3 - the loser of 0-2 group goes here.
Defining the stage map
Previously, in Tournaments, the map for matches was selected randomly from a pool of maps, and everyone could have different maps within a single stage. Now, one map is selected for all groups in this stage. This map will not appear in the bracket again until the current map pool runs out.

•

• 
The reward for defeat appears. It is received if the losing subdivision has scored more than 20% of the total capture points.

Removing a rating from an event
Base captures are no longer an event where subdivisions can gain or lose ratings.
The 160 rating penalty for not attending the Base capture on Sunday has been removed. 
Change in the mode time and registration rules
Registration end: 17:30 → 18:30 region time 
Capture start: 18:00 → 19:00 region time
Registration for the event opens on Sundays at 5:00 a.m. region time.
Players with the Officer rank and above can set priorities for the bases they wish to register for. For this, the bases you are interested in are inserted into the registration slots. 
To register, you need to select at least one base in the first slot. It is not necessary to fill in all the slots, but you must fill them in one by one. This means that it is impossible to set a third priority base if the second priority has not been set.
After registration is complete, the system will begin to distribute subdivisions among bases according to their rating and priority. That is, the subdivision with the highest rating among all subdivisions is guaranteed to participate in capturing the base that it has set as its first priority. Of all applicants, the top 16 divisions will be selected based on their ratings and distributed among the bases. Subdivisions that did not participate in the Base Captures will be refunded their registration fees. 
During the off-season, the ratings obtained in the previous season will remain valid. Registration for the mode will take place on this basis.
Change in the mode format
All four bases are played simultaneously in groups of four participants per base. The brackets were changed, and a second chance bracket was introduced. After the first defeat in the upper bracket stage, the subdivision will fall into the lower bracket, where it will be able to continue fighting for the base capture. If it loses there too, it will leave the event.
Rewards in Base captures
As in Tournaments, there are rewards for victory and defeat in Base captures. The defeat reward is awarded if the losing subdivision has scored more than 20% of the total capture points.

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [15.10.2025]
historical_patches.text:
People eventually get used to all the strange and incomprehensible things in the Zone. Even the crawling toys that emit a nasty screech have stopped being novel, though they still induce fear, especially when encountered alone. What awaits us next? Will the Zone reveal more secrets from the stalkers' eerie campfire tales? We'll find out soon enough, but for now, let's familiarize ourselves with the new shipments from the Mainland.
In this patch, you can expect:
• 
Barter update featuring a new shotgun branch;
• 
Display of equipped weapons on the character;
• 
New season motif;
• 
Balance adjustments for hip-fire spread, stopping power, reactions, and new adjustments to weapons and armour;
• 
Other changes, including sound updates, tracer rework, and the long-awaited side rails for the AK-15!
Barter updates
The shotgun branch has been completely redesigned: its final, master version is now the Franchi SPAS-15 shotgun.

New season motif

Balance adjustments
Hip-fire spread adjustments
In order to increase the importance of aimed shooting, the following changes to spread have been introduced:
• 
Machine Guns: 3° → 3.25°
• 
Assault rifles: 2.7° → 3°
• 
Shotguns and SMGs: 2.4° → 2.75°
• 
Pistols: 2° → 2.25°
The spread multiplier and hip fire spread multiplier for all weapons except flamethrowers is now 1.5.
Stopping power changes
 | 
All ammunition with stopping power 30
 |

 | 
All ammunition with stopping power 40
 | 
Stopping power: 40 → 45
The stopping power of 5.45, 5.56 and 7.62 mm calibre rounds proved too weak to have a noticeable effect, especially when compared to 9 mm and 12 mm ammunition. In this regard, these ammunition types have been slightly reinforced.
Burn changes 
The penalty for healing effectiveness from burn has been increased from -50% to -75%.
Now all incendiary ammunition inflicts Burning on first hit, but the average amount of burning per unit of time has not changed, as the burning input per unit of damage has been reduced.
 |

Bleeding: -45% → -100%
Due to their poor performance and the prevalence of burn reactions, incendiary ammunition was ineffective and unpopular. 
Burn penalties have been increased, and reaction power has been reduced. 
Reaction changes
Reactions to damage types were simultaneously useless due to their situational nature and overly powerful due to their potential to temporarily increase vitality under certain circumstances. All reactions to damage types on artefacts have been weakened and now provide less significant bonuses. In return, the affected artefacts received other full-fledged characteristics or enhancements to their existing ones.
Duration of effect: 15 sec. → 20 sec. 
Hoop, Colophony and Gills were also additionally enhanced.

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [22.10.2025]
historical_patches.text:
Link to video overview of the patch notes with subtitles:
Disappearances in the Zone are not uncommon, but in recent months there have been too many: stalkers vanish without a trace — no bodies, no gear, not even the slightest clue. No one knows the reasons, but there is more and more talk about an abandoned scientific complex that used to be unreachable. People began to disappear just when the anomalies blocking the way to him suddenly vanished. Now the four go to explore a place that was considered dead and abandoned. They hope to find answers, but instead they will find a monster that only resembles the human form. A monster that guards its secrets... or lures new victims to itself. Run away or reveal the secret, at the risk of dying? A tough choice — especially when someone is watching you from the darkness.
Content
• 
New mode;
• 
Style for Season Pass level 1000;
• 
Profile customisation;
• 
New offers in the in-game shop;
• 
Other.
New mode
A new game mode, Encaged, is now available in the Events Hub.
You are given a choice of two roles:
• 
Hunter;
• 
Survivor.
When playing in a squad, you can only play as Survivors.
Hunter
Features of the Hunter:
• 
Keeps the entire location in fear;
• 
Senses the presence of the Survivors in his lair;
• 
Has special skills;
• 
Restricted in jumping, overcoming obstacles and fast running;
• 
Does not kill the Survivor after a knockout — only captures them in a cage. However, be aware that prisoners can be rescued by other Survivors.
Hunter's main goal is to capture all Survivors and stop them from escaping.
Survivor
Features of the Survivor:
• 
Avoids the Hunter by all means, or tries to fight back;
• 
Divided into several classes;
• 
Has increased stamina usage;
• 
In order to survive, they need to complete the main task and evacuate.
• 
Rummage through the contents of the boxes in search of a means to fight the Hunter;
• 
After completing the main task, tries with all their might to find the door for evacuation, or to fight back against the Hunter by unlocking the safes.
Classes
There are four classes available for you to play: Medic, Engineer, Scout, and Military.
Main task
The task always consists of two elements:
• 
Collection of folders;
• 
Repair of equipment.
The number of folders and repair equipment varies from match to match.
Folders:
• 
Randomise the placement for every match;
• 
Can be detected by its signature sound.
Equipment repair:
• 
Randomise the placement for every match;
• 
There are always two more than required by the task;
• 
Can be detected by its signature sound;
• 
If you make a mistake, the Hunter will see you through walls.
• 
The Hunter can interrupt the repair progress by hitting the panel of the broken equipment. 
Evacuation
Evacuation becomes available after completing the main task. 
• 
To evacuate, press and hold the two buttons next to the hermetic door;
• 
There are several hermetic doors on the map, but not all of them are suitable for evacuation;
• 
After completing the main task, the door appropriate for evacuation will begin to emit a signature sound;
• 
Attentive players can identify the escape door even before completing the main task by the flashing red lights above the hermetic door and the presence of push buttons.
Boxes
There are three types of boxes in this mode:
• 
Medical: 
• 
Appear in random locations on the map;
• 
Contain medical items that increase the resistance to the Hunter's hits, increase speed and restore health;
• 
Medic uses items from this box more effectively.
• 
With weapons: 
• 
Appear in random locations on the map;
• 
Contain traps, flashbang grenades, and weapons to fight the Hunter;
• 
Military uses items from this box more effectively.
• 
Safe: 
• 
Always located in the same place;
• 
Unlocked after equipment repair;
• 
Contains medicine and weapons of the mode, allowing you to defeat the Hunter.
Other mechanics
• 
Door with button: 
• 
Allows Survivors to close the door directly in front of the Hunter or use it to escape;
• 
Hunter can break the door;
• 
Has a timer for opening and closing, the status can be monitored by the red button above the door.
• 
Breakable obstacles: 
• 
Can be broken by the Hunter;
• 
Give Survivors an advantage during the chase.
• 
Flask with mysterious liquid: 
• 
Appears in random locations on the map;
• 
When found in inventory, speeds up nearby Hunter;
• 
When used, instantly restores the Survivor's stamina.
Rewards and tasks
During the session, the player receives session points, which are converted into:
• 
Game Rubles;
• 
Event currency — Grim Sigil.
You can obtain Grim sigils by playing Encgaed mode and completing challenges.
Players receive session points for almost every useful action, but the following are particularly valuable:
• 
For Survivors: 
• 
Helping teammates and freeing them from the cage;
• 
Evacuation;
• 
Killing the Hunter.
• 
For Hunter: 
• 
Capture and murder of the Survivor in the cage.
Challenges and Event Shop
In the Events Hub tab, you can find information about the Encaged mode challenges and the rewards for completing them.
There is also a shop where you can purchase the items you need using the event currency.
Season Pass tasks
Two Season Pass challenges have been added as part of the Encgaed mode.
Event cases
You can access the themed boxes via the Shadow Trophies tab in the Events Hub. There you can open them for the Grim sigil currency.
The following rewards await you for the most valuable case, Hunter's Reliquary:
They offer new artefacts that can make your build even more effective. They have the following properties:
Style for Season Pass level 1000
Upon reaching level 1000 of the Season Pass, you will receive the Knacker style for the Pancor Jackhammer weapon as a reward. Get ready for some wildly stylish close-range fights!
Profile customisation
Now you can customise your profile to suit your taste.
Click on the Profile Design tab to do this.There you can change your visit card: choose a tag, set a background, pattern, and add stickers, which you can even change the angle of!
Rework of character interaction 
Now, a mini banner of the player's profile will be displayed in the interaction window.
Updated interaction with the menu itself:
• 
Opens with F, closes with F/ESC or by pressing any menu button;
• 
For convenience, hotkeys are assigned to the interaction buttons.
New offers in the in-game shop
Discounts on styles
Great news for collectors!
The in-game shop has been updated: prices for styles of Black Market season have been lowered, and they can now be purchased in transferable form.
And during the Encaged mode, there is an additional discount on the styles!
Forbidden pack 
The in-game shop offers a Forbidden pack for a snappy start to the event's most valuable rewards! It includes:
• 
15 000 Season points;
• 
5 Mysterious Loot season boxes;
• 
7 500 Grim sigil event currency.
The pack can be purchased 20 times, but please note that the special discount only applies to the first 5 purchases of the pack.
New section in the shop 
A new section has appeared in the in-game shop where you can purchase season items to customise your profile!
Advanced Case
The in-game shop has been updated with an advanced case — now featuring a new Freezer container inside.
Case will be available for three weeks.
Aesthete's Case II
The Aesthete's Case II has also been added to the line-up of new items, including previously released armour motifs and unique styles for the bolt — Battery.
Other
Updated design of safe zones to match the theme of the season.
Updated the announcement board model.
Updated descriptions for all armour.
Added the ability to convert personal Anomalous Serum and Quantum Batteries into their barter variants via the item menu.
Updated the ZIVCAS 3.0 EXPANSE clan style paint mask for Albatross Heavy Assault.
Added ammo for PTRD-M to Session Battles purchase.
Removed the Stability parameter for the STOMP medicine.
Changed the speed of messages in the location chat from three messages in 30 seconds to one message every 10 seconds.
Increased the maximum number of items that can be stacked together from one to two for the following items:
• 
PDA Spare Parts;
• 
Expensive Cigarettes;
• 
Strong Behemoth's Eye.
Corrected several minor localization bugs in all languages.

To improve in-game economy and overall balance:

⚠️ The listed adjustments are not final. We’ve been actively fixing bugs and issues since day one, however, these particular hotfixes are specifically aimed at bringing the gameplay closer to an optimal balance.
Sincerely,
EXBO Team

historical_patches.title: The final word on Encaged
historical_patches.text:
Over the course of the event, there’s been a lot of questions, confusion and negativity around it. We see that the community expects transparency, so we want to clearly explain what happened, why it happened and what comes next.
Teaming
The situation with teaming and the uncertainty around whether it was allowed or not came down to a simple communication failure within our development team. On one hand, players were gaining large amounts of event currency through unusual means; on the other hand, we had effectively allowed it ourselves. We’ve learned from this. Moving forward, there will be no such inconsistencies with the vague concept of gaming behaviour — we've drawn the appropriate conclusions.
Economy and drop rates
Teaming certainly affected the in-game economy, but it wasn’t the main issue. The real problem was in our calculations — we underestimated both the hype around the event and how deeply players would engage with it. We didn’t expect people to play 30+ matches in a single evening. We had to adapt quickly, lowering currency income and drop chances to keep the economy and balance from breaking down. Right now, the situation is stable. Yes, we did reduce the chances for key event-case rewards, but they were never “set to zero”, as some might think — they remain roughly on par with the Attack on Perimeter cases. We understand the frustration of players who didn’t get to take advantage of the “feast” on day one, but if we hadn’t acted fast, the entire game’s economy would’ve suffered far more in the long run.
Event state and what’s next
We want to thank everyone who continues to play and share their feedback — more than 60% of all players log into the event mode daily, which genuinely makes us happy. We’re aware of the issues the community is highlighting, and fixes are already on the way.
Unfortunately, not everything can be patched instantly, and some changes require maintenance work. Soon, the issue of equipment spawning too close together will be fixed, and a “five-player mode” will be added.
The mode will continue to be developed and reused in the future, with new mechanics, classes, killers, and maps planned. Encaged is one of the first “mini-events” that will enter regular rotation, running alongside larger or simpler events.
We know this release didn’t go smoothly. We made mistakes — we’ve identified them, analysed them and drawn our conclusions. Your feedback and reactions matter, and we’re continuing to fix what’s still out of place. Thank you for sticking with us, and to take the edge off the rocky start, here’s a promo code valid until 4 November, 20:59 (UTC) — one use per account:
SCX-28OCT2025-SORRY
Sincerely,
EXBO Team

historical_patches.title: Q&A with the Game Security department
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/75defafe8a493a66c1f89dad7eac75ad64e2e255.png
ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤWho decides where a “bug” ends and an “exploit” begins?
ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤWhy do some players get banned while others receive only a warning?
ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤAnd what exactly does the Game Security department do?
Jilee, the head of the PAWS team that keeps order in the Zone, answered these and other questions.
PAWS is?..
Why is the department called PAWS? Are you really “the paws” now?
Jilee: The name changed after an internal reorganisation.
 The abbreviation stands for Player Account Welfare & Security.
How much has your toolkit changed since SC first launched?
Jilee: Since I became head of the department, we’ve developed many new tools and in-game improvements.
 For example, the buyback system for accidentally sold items and the partial character deletion mechanism were both created at our initiative.
Would you say the MMO nature of SC: X makes your job easier or harder?
Jilee: That’s quite a philosophical question. Since this is an MMO with an open economy — it certainly makes things more complex. But overall, it’s a manageable challenge.
Are bans issued only after violations are confirmed, or can a player be banned before the investigation?
Jilee: Usually, bans are issued only after a confirmed violation. Rarely, a mistake can happen due to human error.
 A temporary “pending investigation” ban is possible, but only when we need to immediately stop malicious actions.
Any inside jokes or memes about your work?
Jilee: Sadly, we can’t show our internal memes as they’re under NDA, but we have favourite memes outside of work too! Here are some random ones:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2e03b3a77fc2cc3b74dbfec7533d0ced8fb0fdd5.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0726f708b379cf9f3e0e848e4abeb1a3327bc5a2.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/dc7865f16f104d63d6c30c10ed5b0bc6476cbb3d.png
ACCOUNTS & SECURITY
Will a player be banned for sharing an account that participates in clan wars, if the other person doesn’t actually take part in CW?
 For example, lending your account to a friend just to farm open world, but not to play Tournaments.
Jilee: Technically, account sharing is forbidden even outside of CW. However, we do understand that such practices exist.
 Restrictions are applied through a support ticket. For now, nothing is changing in this regard.
 Also note: if you share your account with a friend or even your mum “just to test some guns,” support team may refuse assistance in case of an account theft.
How does PAWS deal with Steam-related incidents?
 For example, if someone’s Steam account gets hacked, the attacker logs into STALCRAFT: X and uses cheats, resulting in a ban.
Jilee: The responsibility for third-party account security cannot be on us — legally or technically.However, we’re prototyping a system to improve protection for Steam users. No details yet.
Is there a vulnerability that allows session hijacking through fake links?
Jilee: Depends on the link. Some scammers create phishing websites mimicking trusted platforms.
 Always double-check where you log in. The official resources are:
· https://stalcraft.net/
· https://support.exbo.net/en
· https://exbo.net/
Official social media links can be found on the game’s website in the Community tab.
RMT & THE BLACK MARKET
Why fight the black market instead of legalising it like in some other MMOs?
Jilee: RMT is like cancer for games with open economies. It causes long-term damage to both developers and honest players.Other games like Albion Online also fight RMT activities.
 Legalisation is rare and usually found only in games with fully bound, non-tradable items. And let’s be honest — if we legalise RMT, it stops being a game and becomes a job. This leads to many other problems.
 Where’s the line between RMT and legitimate gifting? How do you tell the difference?
Jilee: The main rule: if in-game items are earned legitimately (farming, selling crates, etc.), you’re safe.
 If you receive valuable items from an unknown source, the item or rubles may be confiscated. Easy come, easy go.
 Punishments are applied only with solid evidence. If you believe deduction of funds from your account was a mistake, you can email complaints@exbo.net.
What sanctions apply for RMT — item removal or negative balance?
Jilee: Both can be used, depending on the case.
Does PAWS recognise that in-game items, once purchased, represent monetary value protected by law?
 And that confiscating them without compensation could be seen as denying a paid service?
Jilee: No, we don’t, and won’t, recognise that.
 We operate strictly within the legal framework and the Licence Agreement.
BUG ABUSE, CW & AMNESTY
Why do bug abusers (excluding those harming the economy) receive light punishments?
 Even before the Reconstruction, I reported people clipping into walls and shooting from inside — they only got a one-day ban.
Jilee: We’re not executioners. Anyone can make a mistake. If the violation isn’t critical on a global scale, the punishment will be proportional.
 However, it’s important to understand that if we see repeated violations, the next punishment becomes more severe.
Why weren’t players punished for bug abuse in CW before the new rules were introduced?
Jilee: That’s not entirely true.
 Players have consistently been restricted when such violations were detected. The new Subdivision Battles rules now allow us to apply sanctions to the entire subdivision. For example, if something is placed outside the playable map, the whole clan benefits from it, so the sanctions may apply to them collectively as well.
Under the new Subdivision Battles rules, are all clans monitored closely, or only S- and A-tier ones?
Jilee: The rules apply to all clans without exception.
 If you’ve noticed something suspicious or have information about a violation, you can always report it to Support Team.
 But don’t worry — we also have our own monitoring tools.
Are there penalties for using out-of-bounds areas of the map?
 For example, exploring the map beyond the boundaries or using out-of-bounds areas for more efficient farming.
Jilee: Yes, there are punishments for that. We’ve even fine-tuned our logs to detect such cases more effectively. However, we must distinguish between different levels of bug abuse. There’s usually nothing interesting beyond the map, if it doesn’t pose a direct threat to other players or fair play. We’ve always been fairly understanding about this kind of “exploration.”
Will there be amnesty for players permanently banned under rules 4.1.9, 4.1.2, etc., if many years have passed?
Jilee: No, amnesty is not planned.
OTHER
Why does the Support Team ask players for evidence when they file complaints? Isn’t collecting proof supposed to be your responsibility?
Jilee: We receive an enormous number of tickets. If we were to review every case without evidence, our efficiency would drop significantly.
Are there penalties for using auto-traders, stash-farming bots, crafting scripts, etc.?
Jilee: Some of these systems are getting blocked, but the details fall under the responsibility of the EXENS department.
Do you play STALCRAFT: X, and what kind of activities do you enjoy?
Jilee: Yes, from time to time. Nearly 5 000 hours on my main character. My favourites are quests (always interesting to go through them) and session modes.
How do you feel about some players calling PAWS a “sledgehammer” rather than a “shield”?
Jilee: That’s fair, but you must understand — a shield can’t exist without a hammer. Protecting players also means punishing offenders. Without that, there would be no order.
What would you like players to understand about your work above anything else?
Jilee: We’d like players to understand that we mostly deal with the consequences of someone’s actions. Sometimes we manage to address the causes as well, but, for example, we can’t protect you from a virus downloaded onto your PC — that’s the player’s own responsibility.
 The articles we write together with the Interactions Team, the requirement of mandatory 2FA for Support Team requests, and many other rules are primarily aimed at protecting those who don’t think about risks or aren’t familiar with basic online security principles. 
All of these measures didn’t appear out of thin air — you could say they’re written in blood.
ㅤThe Zone shows no mercy, but the chaos remains contained as long as PAWS stands on guard.
 ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤWe thank Jilee for his answers and all of you for your questions.
 ㅤTake care of your accounts, Seekers. The Zone has enough enemies, no need to make anotherㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤone yourself.

New session PVE mode — Operations

New session PVE mode — Operations
New mode is available in the Session Battles section of the Operations tab. 
It challenges players to work together to complete tasks and battle both regular enemies and bosses in order to earn the final reward.
How to open it
Operations become available after the player completes the Operation Breach quest. The quest is available to all players who have accessed the Bar location. It is not necessary for the entire squad to complete the task — it is enough for the leader to do so. After that, it will be able to launch the Operation even if the other two members of the squad have not completed the task.
A representative of ZIVCAS named Phil has appeared at the bar, ready to give anyone who wants it a new and interesting task.
Classes
Operations use the player's own equipment, and depending on the armour equipped, they are assigned a class with a unique set of skills:
Combat suits — Assault;
Combo suits — Operative;
Scientist suits — Support.
Clearance levels
Clearance levels
Clearance System represents the difficulty levels of Operations: the higher the Clearance Level, the stronger the opponents.
At levels 3, 6, and 9, a new condition is added to Clearance: Modifier.
Modifiers are designed to complicate and supplement gameplay when playing at high Clearances.
Please note that Clearance levels are levelled up separately for each Operation. Clearance may also be reset in the event of major changes in balance or the economy.
How to play
More detailed information about Operations and their features can be found in the updated in-game guide, which is located in the How to play section of the Operations tab.
Two Operations are currently available.
In Operation Big Clean Up, players will face the following challenges:
• 
Capture of communications hubs;
• 
Power supply for photon generators;
• 
Defeat the Ratcatcher boss.
In turn, in Operation Focusing, players need to:
• 
Escort the anomaly;
• 
Make laser incision;
• 
Defeat the Storm boss.
More details about the bosses' tasks and abilities are described in the How to play section.
The mode is designed to be played by a team of three, but Operations can also be played solo.
However, be ready: for a single person, this challenge will be a real nightmare. Take it at your own risk.
Operations rewards
Rewards for successful completion
After successfully completing the Operation, the player will be able to choose one of three rewards. Depending on the Clearance level of the completed Operation, the quality of the rewards increases. The player may once replace each of the rewards they have received with in-game currency.
The number of rewards for successfully completing Operations is limited. The counter is updated every Wednesday at 5:00 server time. 
List of rewards that can be obtained for successfully completing the Operation:
• 
Quasi-destructor;
• 
Advanced Tools;
• 
Advanced Spare parts;
• 
Module Cores of standard, unusual and special quality;
• 
Catalysts;
• 
Trade coins;
• 
Module inhibitors;
• 
In-game currency.
Weekly rewards
In weekly rewards, you can receive: Module Cores of any quality, from common to legendary, and Module inhibitors.
You may select one reward from three offers if you have fulfilled the conditions for unlocking these offers:
• 
One offer: one successful Operation;
• 
Two offers: three successful Operations;
• 
Three offers: five successful Operations.
The higher the level of Clearance achieved, the greater the chances of receiving a more valuable reward.
If you do not make a selection within a week, a random reward will be issued.
Modules
The main reward for Operations is the Module Core, which is used to create the Modules themselves.
Modules are improvements that can be installed on any weapon.
The modules consist of three components:
• 
Add-On — a positive base property that affects weapon characteristics by percentage.
• 
Concept — a positive base property that affects weapon characteristics by percentage, or a special property.
• 
Deviation — a negative base property that affects weapon characteristics by percentage.
The significance of the positive and negative effects of the Modules depends on their quality. In turn, quality depends on the best property among those available.For example, if a Module has special Add-Ons and Concepts, but has a rare Deviation, then the quality will be rare. 
The quality may be as follows:
 |

Creating and interacting with Modules
To create and subsequently modify the Module, the following are required:
• 
Core inhibitors — currency used to replace the properties of the Module being created. It can be transferable and purchased in the shop for stalcoins.
• 
Quasi-destructor — an item used to extract and remove the personalisation of a Module installed on a weapon.
• 
Module Cores — items required to create a Module on Noomachine.
• 
Noomachine— a table for creating Modules. Installed at the Bar and at the factions northern bases.
After obtaining the Core, the player must take it to Noomachine to create a Module.
The Module is created without any additional resource investment. The player only needs the Core.
However, it has certain settings for less random creation. But in turn, they will need to be replaced to create the desired combination, and this will consume a special resource — the Core inhibitor.
Using Core inhibitors, it is also possible to change the characteristics of the Module.
As part of the Operations, compensation for the technical ZIVCAS token is provided. The compensation itself will be made a little later. 
When creating a Module for the first time, you cannot select which property categories to discard. When creating the Module again, those categories that were previously excluded can be removed.
The selection of Add-On, Concept, and Deviation categories opens gradually. The categories that you have previously unlocked by obtaining a Module with certain properties become available for selection.
Excluding the category costs a certain amount of Core inhibitors. With each additional exclusion, the cost increases.
After selecting categories, you can create a Module, where the player can also replace the characteristics with Core inhibitors.
No need to research the Module further! Module specifications are known immediately.

Installing the Module on a Weapon
A slot has been added to the weapon modification menu where you can install a Module.
The Module is personalised upon installation and becomes transferable when removed from the weapon.
Only one Module can be installed on each weapon.
Removal and disassembly of Modules
There are two ways to remove the Module from the weapon:
• 
Removal and destruction of the Module;
• 
Removing the Module without destroying it — requires a Quasi-destructor.
Modules that are not installed on weapons can be disassembled at the Noomachine. When disassembling a Module, a certain number of Core inhibitors are issued. Clicking on the replenishment button will open a tab where you can disassemble Modules into Core inhibitors.
When you click on the restore Modules button, you will be taken to a window where the Modules you have disassembled are stored, if you want to buy them back at a markup that depends on the quality of the Module. Please note that the Module can be restored within one day, otherwise it will disappear forever.
Destroyed and sold Modules cannot be restored.
If the Module was installed on a weapon that is subsequently used in barter, it will automatically be transferred to the new weapon.

historical_patches.text:

historical_patches.title: Patch notes [26.11.2025]
historical_patches.text:
As the seasons change, much transforms in the Zone. Even familiar places have taken on new appearances. The Bar and the Pervomaisky Factory were among the first to undergo these changes; their walls may have changed, but their spirit remains the same. Drunken shouts at the counter, heartfelt conversations in the gloom — this chaos somehow warms the soul…
In this patch, you can expect:
• 
Updates to the Pervomaisky Factory and the Bar locations;
• 
New shop items;
• 
Changes in Operations;
• 
And more.
Updates to the Pervomaisky Factory and the 
Bar locations
The next iteration of location updates has taken place, this time updating the Pervomaisky Factory and its safe zone.
Bar
The Bar was the last outdated safe zone in the South, which did not suit us for many reasons:
• 
Very old visual;
• 
Poor and close grouping of functional NPCs;
• 
No space for content implementation;
• 
Confusion that disoriented all newcomers;
• 
Inconvenient level design, where the entire first floor was blocked by a train that you couldn't even walk through;
• 
And many other reasons.
Due to the impossibility of fixing these problems easily and quickly, we decided to completely redesign the safe zone.
We’ve been told that some bandits managed to steal your favourite green screen from the Bar…
For the next updates, we’ll buy and bring a brand-new green screen into the Zone, and of course we’ll put it back where it belongs in the Bar.
Dorms
The Bar now has an additional location called Dorms, where many quests have been moved. The motivation behind this decision is quite simple — we simply did not want to turn the new Bar into a huge maze.
Now in Dorms, you can find:
• 
Leaders of Stalkers and Bandits factions;
• 
Shaman in The Call storyline;
• 
Black market;
• 
As well as many other minor characters from our quests.
Drunken Geiger
For those who have reached the final level of Bar's reputation, access to the updated Drunken Geiger is now available.
Updating this safe zone is a tribute to the old content of our project. Now Drunken Geiger serves a purely cosmetic function.
Interactive furniture
You've been waiting a long time for this! The interactive furniture that you can sit on has been returned.
Locations where you can now sit down:
• 
The Bar;
• 
Drunken Geiger;
• 
Some objects in the Hideout.
In the future, we will add the ability to sit on furniture in all safe zones.
Voice rooms
We have also brought back the voice rooms.
In The Bar and Drunken Geiger, it is now possible not only to sit on furniture, but also to communicate with other players via voice chat.
Safe zone reviving
This is the first iteration of reviving our safe zones from a narrative perspective, in which NPCs will behave in a more elaborate manner and immerse the player deeper into the world of the Zone.
In The Bar, we did:
• 
Unique armour for merchants;
• 
Unique animations for merchants and ordinary NPCs;
• 
Unique phrases for ordinary NPCs.
The current version is only the first iteration, which has its flaws. After the release, we will begin collecting feedback and gradually refill the safe zones in our game.
Pervomaisky Factory
Pervomaisky Factory was very old and did not allow players to move around normally, which caused newcomers to leave our project.
In this regard, we have updated this location:
• 
Eased orientation;
• 
Removed buildings where enemy players often ambushed people;
• 
Merged the routes of players going to other locations and to the safe zone;
• 
Reduced the number of noisy objects for better orientation and visibility;
• 
Relocated all hiding places on the location.
Now this location should be perceived by players as a comfortable refuge for rest and movement between other locations in the South.
New arrivals in shop
Variations of familiar containers have appeared in the Zone, but with a slight mystical twist. Gossip lovers are eager to discuss the mysterious craftsman who is now on everyone's lips, while thrill seekers and collectors can't wait to get their hands on one of these containers.
Show off your style and strike fear into your enemies with these new styles! They can also be purchased in both transferable and personal forms:
Changes in Operations
General changes
• 
We decided to disable the option to play solo. Originally, Operations were designed for teams of three players — that's how they work best. Playing solo was frustrating and felt unfair.
• 
Added accuracy display to the statistics screen, with shooting at allies with the Support class not counting as a miss.
• 
Added a significant amount of healing for 3 seconds after the injector is used by the player.
• 
Added brief invulnerability after the player uses injectors.
• 
Reworked some texts: in the How to Play menu, descriptions of Modules and enemy abilities.
• 
Added a progress bar to the Cargo Escort mission. Added a display showing progress to the next checkpoint and an indication of anomaly movement backwards when there are no players in the capture zone.
• 
To count towards the weekly reward, you no longer need at least one star — any completion will count.
• 
Made a number of improvements to the HUD.
Changes in opponents
• 
Added the ability to charge antennas with proto-discharges during the battle with the Storm boss.
• 
Reduced damage from Suppressor's kick and Murmur's Step.
• 
Increased the cooldown time for the Murmur Suppressor skill. 
• 
The Fighting Spirit buff from the Murmur Suppressor is now reset when an NPC is knocked down.
• 
Reduced health and damage of the Murmur Voice.
• 
Removed the decrease in stamina from missing the Murmur Gaze.
• 
Changed the logic of the Murmur Sight. If the Sight cannot see the player but has seen them previously, it will fire at their last known position.
• 
Reduced the amount of stopping power required to interrupt opponents' abilities.
Class ability changes
• 
Now, pressing abilities in Operations will activate the effect immediately, rather than after the animation has finished.
• 
The effects of the Support class abilities Healing Composition and Defender, as well as the Operative class ability Dexterity, are no longer reset when a player is knocked down.
Ability Tremor of the Assault class
• 
Increased radius from 12 to 16 metres.
• 
Increased damage accumulation during the ability's duration from 100% to 150%.
• 
Added a fixed five-second cooldown instead of accumulating damage to reset the ability. 
Ability Provocation of the Assault class
• 
Reduced ability animation time from 2 to 1.5 seconds.
• 
Increased vitality bonus from 100 to 150 points.
• 
Reduced ability cooldown from 16 to 8 seconds.
Ability Berserk of the Assault class
• 
Added a limit on the maximum damage from the ability.
Ability Defender of the Support class
• 
Increased vitality bonus from 25 to 35 points.
• 
Increased ability radius from 20 to 30 metres.
Challenges
• 
Operations episode extended until December 3.
• 
Shifted the time frame for the Complete Operation Focusing in less than 12 minutes challenge from 12 to 16 minutes.
Other changes
• 
Fixed a bug with searching for the Decompressor module at auction. 
• 
Fixed a bug where the Assault class could gain permanent invulnerability.
• 
Fixed a bug where negative effects from bosses could persist after exiting Operations.
• 
Fixed battery passing through doors in the Big Clean Up operation.
• 
Fixed the spawn points for Murmur's Gaze during the anomaly escort stages in Operation Focusing.
• 
Fixed a bug where some modifiers, including Frost, did not reduce player regeneration.
• 
Fixed a bug where Ratcatcher could use his Syringe ability to restore health above the current phase.
Other
• 
Pushed NA Subdivision Battles times: +1 hour.
• 
Organised list of equipment in the list of items compatible with paints and attachments.
• 
Added the Change FOV in x1 sights setting, which changes the player's field of view when using x1 sights or mechanical sights.
• 
Updated models of Trijicon ACOG and ACOG 2x40 sights.
• 
Items from the Medicine Kit now go into your inventory when opened, rather than your personal storage.
• 
Basic versions of the Burrow and Streets of Pripyat maps have been returned to the general list of maps.
• 
Added painting of decorative side rails.
• 
Fixed multiple translation inconsistency bugs across all languages.
• 
Corrected several minor localization bugs in all languages.
• 
Fixed an issue with incorrect display of information in the weekly rewards menu in English, French, and Spanish.
• 
Added NPC dialogue subtitles. You can enable or disable subtitles and change their size in the settings. For now, subtitles are available for NPC lines in the Bar and the Drunken Geiger.

historical_patches.text:
Link to video overview of the patch notes with subtitles:
The crackling of a Geiger counter is replaced by the crackling of frost on the gas mask lenses. The Zone is changing more rapidly, and not everyone can keep up with its rhythm. The latest changes awaiting us are:
• 
Sub-Zero Zone season;
• 
Economy adjustments;
• 
Signal dungeons;
• 
Fixes to the Bar;
• 
Operations adjustments;
• 
Other changes.
Sub-Zero Zone season
Winter weather
Overnight, the Zone was covered in snow: the paths disappeared under a white blanket, rusty fences turned into ghosts, and familiar places suddenly became unfamiliar.
You will see the following changes in the game:
• 
Added new season effects;
• 
Updated old winter weather phenomena;
• 
Changed the brightness of winter nights;
• 
Updated textures for snow and snow-covered trees.
Season rewards 
The following key rewards are available this season:
• 
Cobra Two-Tone pistol;
• 
M249 SAW machine gun;
• 
Expedition Suit;
• 
Special case tokens;
• 
Frostproof skin;
•

•

• 
Snow Trail container;
• 
Nord charm;
•

• 
Sub-Zero Zone customisation set;
Marten exoarmour — a unique reward for reaching level 500.
Special case
Updated content for the Special case. New unique rewards — Ganymede jumpsuit and CRAW-6 container.
Season styles
Welcome winter with new skins! Transform your weapons and armour with the following new items:
• 
 Orca style for Mule and Ace suits;
• 
 Frozen Steel style for KRISS VECTOR;
• 
 Zero Point style for GLOCK 18X;
•

Sub-Zero Zone starter pack
Start the new season not from scratch, but with a starter pack! Here's what's inside: 
• 
10 season pass levels;
• 
7 days premium;
• 
Two unique Blood on the Ice paints for armour and weapons.
Economy adjustments
Change in the cost of Fragments and Data blocks
Fragments and Data blocks have become a significant part of players' income, which has disrupted the original concept and purpose of these resources. As a result, we have decided to reduce the sale price of these resources in rubles and reallocate the revenue to other activities:
• 
Daily tasks;
• 
Weekly tasks;
• 
Delivery contracts.
 | 
Alpha Data Fragment
 | 
290 → 80
 | 
Beta Data Fragment
 | 
600 → 90
 | 
Gamma Data Fragment
 | 
900 → 100
 | 
Lambda Data Fragment
 | 
900 → 100
 | 
Alpha Data Block
 | 
42 000 → 8 000
 | 
Beta Data Block
 | 
60 000 → 9 000
 | 
Gamma Data Block
 | 
90 000 → 10 000
 | 
Lambda Data Block
 | 
90 000 → 10 000
At the same time, we are increasing the number of rewards with resources for sale from activities where fragments and data blocks drop.
On average, the reward for resources for sale has been increased by 33%.
Change in crafting gear for blueprints
Now, when crafting gear from blueprints found in season crates, you'll need barter resources and rubles.
Previously, players could obtain master gear too early in their progression, which could cause them to end up on servers with a higher matchmaking level. Now, before collecting gear from the blueprints, you will need to obtain the necessary barter resources from the North, i.e. complete the corresponding progression stage.
This change also preserves the need to collect barter items, without devaluing the need for progression in the game.
New rewards for daily and weekly tasks

 | 
Daily
 |

Weekly
 | 
40 700 rubles → 80 000 rubles
At other bases, rewards for tasks have been increased by 50%.
Changed delivery contracts
Now, every player in the faction will have deliveries to the same locations, allowing players to cooperate to complete contracts together.
In total, excluding deliveries to Stillwaters, there are also 6 contracts available:
• 
2 light;
•

Signal Dungeons
When searching for signals, you may encounter a new mechanic — Signal Dungeons.
What is it?
This is a small challenge that must be completed in order to receive a reward. 
It uses locations that are already present in the game. For example, you may meet Master of the Zone or Twins again.
Reaching the location
To reach the Signal location, you must find the signal that will lead you to a special bubble.
As soon as the player enters, they are teleported to a random Signal location.
Bubble types
There are 6 types of bubbles.
Each bubble differs by:
• 
Difficulty of challenge;
• 
Reward for completion.
Each type of bubble has its own colour.

• 
There is also a bubble at the beginning of the location where you can leave the challenge.
• 
After completing the challenge, a bubble appears next to the reward box, which also allows you to leave the location.
• 
Exiting through the bubble returns the player to the point where they entered the location.
• 
If a player dies, they are sent to the last safe zone.
Appearance point
Exit point
Rewards
As a reward for completing the challenge, the player receives a standard Signal reward. 
The higher the bubble's difficulty, the more valuable the reward.
In addition to the standard reward, the player can receive blueprints for new weapons.
• 
Blueprints can only drop after completing challenges led by Red bubbles and higher.
• 
Blueprints can be sold to a fence for rubles.
What's next for Signals?
This minor update does not mark the end of our work on signals. In the future, you can expect:
• 
Expansion of the pool of Signal locations and requirements for entering them;
• 
Forming closer links between Signals, Caches and Safes;
• 
Reworking the visual component of WRD and forming their progression.

• 
Added stun indicator for the Storm boss.
• 
Fixed incorrect behaviour of the Thermos and Finisher modules when shooting at training targets.
• 
Fixed bugs with the display of weak points and point capture progress in Operations.
Other
• 
The Arsenal Art motif is now available for all Arsenal weapons by default, except for the Arsenal Rune.
• 
Some characteristics that were redundant are no longer displayed for grenade launchers. These characteristics are now displayed in a separate block and depend on the grenade charged.
•

•

•

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [10.12.2025]
historical_patches.text:
The first snowy week has flown by... During this time, we've learned to detect mysterious signals leading to the most difficult challenges, and this is just the beginning!
Rumour has it that the Bar has already taken on a special order: to find the least radioactive X-Mas Tree in the entire area.
By next week, the Bar will transform — festive lights will begin to appear, and perhaps even mysterious gifts from the Zone itself...
Keep an eye on things, as winter in the Zone is just begun!
Signal changes
Economics
• 
The resource reward for Purple and Red bubbles has been increased by an average of 20%.
• 
Significantly increased reward for all resources for a signal from the Master of the Zone.
Signal spawn
• 
New signals now appear 10% faster in the North and Stillwaters.
SAC-2

To implement this capability, the characteristics of the SAC-2 were changed.
