historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [17.12.2025]
historical_patches.text:
Brrr... It's freezing cold! Even a rat has frozen to the doors of the Bar – that's how fierce the winter is! Quiet evenings with the crunch of snow underfoot are now a rarity. They are increasingly replaced by the eerie wind that knocks unprepared stalkers off their feet. But not everything is so bleak! Experts have already found the least radioactive X-Mas Tree in the area and are waiting for you to decorate it.
Content
• 
New Year's event;
• 
Gift Zone;
• 
Storm;
• 
Record-player;
• 
Santa Viv's mail;
• 
Looting update;
• 
Adding items to trash;
• 
Operations adjustments;
• 
Other changes.
New Year's event
X-Mas Tree 2026
Stalkers got once again caught up in the festive spirit and put up decorated X-Mas Tree.
The Event Hub now features an X-Mas Tree section, which includes challenges and the opportunity to interact with the X-Mas Tree interface itself.
Let us remind you of the mechanics of the X-Mas Tree and tell you about the updates. In the safe zones, each player now has their own X-Mas Tree, which can be decorated with New Year's toys, just like last year. Each toy earns X-Mas Tree a certain number of points, thereby increasing its level. The number of points is also impacted by the rarity of the items worn.
All toys are grouped into sets, and levelling them up increases the level of the X-Mas Tree itself.
For each set of decorations you collect, you will receive a themed reward in the form of paints and charms!
Interaction with the X-Mas Tree takes place via an interface where you can change decorations, select a specific set of X-Mas Tree decorations, track its level, and view your friends' X-Mas Trees.
Gifts
Gifts began to appear here and there throughout the Zone. Mutants certainly have no interest in them, but in safe zones they are generously paid for. You can sell them, or you can open it and get toys for the X-Mas Tree.
Gifts can be found or obtained from the following activities:
• 
Gathering on the ground and in decorative items;
• 
With a slight chance from open world events;
• 
New Year airdrops;
• 
Daily login rewards;
• 
Session Battles modes: Standoff, Operations and Subdivision Battles;
• 
For every new Season Pass level. By the time you log in into the game, you will receive the gifts for the level you have already reached.
New Year's toys update
This year, the toy system has undergone conceptual changes.
• 
X-Mas Tree toys no longer exist as inventory items and cannot be sold. They are now grouped into sets for collection, and you will receive a reward for collecting a full set.
• 
Opening the gifts immediately sends all the toys to the X-Mas Tree menu, where they are automatically merged together.
• 
The updated interface now features a log of changes to your X-Mas Tree's levelling after opening new gifts – click the “Learn more” button.
• 
By clicking on the “Learn more” button, you can find information about other toys that have increased in level. 
Toys can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.
• 
There are two types of toy changes resulting from automatic merging:
• 
Toy has been upgraded;
• 
Toy has been ranked up.
• 
You can track the progress of the toy's upgrade by hovering over it in the pop-up window. This information is duplicated on the filling background.
After the end of the season event, gifts and decorations for the X-Mas Tree will be removed from the game.
Snowman
Snowman has returned to us, refreshed and... hungry!
No more need to store gifts or feed toys from the X-Mas Tree. Now, every gift you open gives you one Snowflake, which you can feed to the Snowman right away!
You opened 100 gifts? You receive 100 Snowflakes! It's all fairly simple and honest. 
In exchange for Snowflakes, the Snowman gives:
• 
Special coals, which are intended for the snowman lottery with 10 to 1 prizes;
• 
Points for X-Mas Tree go directly to the final score, without taking modifiers into account.
The more you feed, the bigger the carrot!
As before, we recommend that you keep an eye on the Snowman's behaviour depending on the number of Snowflakes he has eaten.
To unlock the Turboman card, you need to open 10 cards.
Holiday calendar
New winter calendar is here!
Open it every day to receive daily rewards, track your progress, and receive up to three final prizes at the end of each week! Don't miss a single day, because the rewards are worth it!
The level of the X-Mas Tree affects the daily reward in the calendar. The higher the level, the better the rewards:
Rewards are updated at 05:00 server time.
• 
The mechanics of the daily X-Mas Tree have been replaced with a calendar mechanic, where a new gift is revealed every day.
• 
Daily rewards consist of a case, which depends on the maximum level of your X-Mas Tree, and an additional item from the list.
• 
If you complete 21 days, you will receive all the rewards from the list without any repeats.
• 
Each week contains a final reward: backgrounds for customising your profile and a New Year's record, which we will discuss a little later. To receive it, you must open all 7 days within the week. 
• 
If you miss a day, you can redeem it for one of the currencies of your choice.
Leaderboard and prizes
The legends of the Zone have already made it a rule that the length of the carrot does not matter, the main thing is your place in the ranking. 
Once you reach the 7th level of the X-Mas Tree, you can compete with each other to see who has the most luxurious X-Mas Tree.
All participants' results will be displayed in a general leaderboard, allowing you to track your current position and the number of points required to win.
At the end of the season, the results will be summarised. Each participant will receive rewards depending on their position in the leaderboard.
Prizes in the race for leadership
During the event, there will once again be impressive prizes to compete for!
Let's have a closer look at the rewards:
• 
Exclusive CR-72, a compact version of the Gauss Rifle, which will be available for tickets in the next act.
• 
Icicle bolt with a new freezing effect, covered with thick anomalous ice.
• 
Exclusive set for customising the profile —Coldline.
• 
Average charm, showing the size of your snowy friend's carrot.
• 
.:S4NT4_CL4U5:..: charm, which displays your personal New Year accuracy indicator.
Unique winter NPCs
New Year's Eve bustle and the warm lights of the Bar attracted suspicious and not-so-suspicious characters to the Zone. Each of them will participate in this event in their own way.
• 
Gift thief
Gift Thief appears at the Scrapyard and Forge-11 locations. This time, he prepared a special assortment in exchange for gifts. 
• 
Vasilych
Will tell you about Storm and its tricks. 
• 
Sled
Contract Provider during the Storm.
During the storm, special contracts for delivering parcels to Frost Fighters are available to you. Depending on the contract you choose, you can receive a small, large or huge box with gifts of all sizes. But remember, time is limited.
Parcels warm the owner and nearby players within a 5-metre radius. Please be careful! If you try to get rid of the parcel, the time runs out, or you die from an external factor, the parcel will explode and release fireworks. 
• 
Messenger
A Snowman with riddles from the southern and northern parts of the Zone. You will receive gifts for completing the challenge.
Sable exclusive style
Upon reaching level 1000 of the Season Pass, you will be able to obtain the chilling Sable style for the Marten exoarmor!
Winter special offers
The storm has once again brought special sets, where you can find missing items that warm the soul.
For those who were most struck by the spirit of the New Year, Gift Sets were added. Treat yourself to some festive cheer and grab a couple of gifts at New Year's discounts!
Visual case
Meet the new Aesthete Case – a collection of exquisite designs that will transform your gear. Don't miss the opportunity to explore all the options available and find the one that perfectly complements your personality.
Gift Zone
Anomalous cold spells in the Zone are the perfect time to share the magic!
Welcome to the Gift Zone!
This year, you can send your friend a Mysterious Gift – a special kind of gift that the recipient can only open after the New Year.
Mysterious Gift can be purchased in the shop for Stalcoins, as well as for in-game currency. Additionally, you can receive gifts as you progress through the Season, as well as for completing challenges in the Gift Zone.
How to gift a holiday to a friend?
• 
Go to the Gift Zone.
• 
Enter the nickname of a friend or random stranger and send them a Mysterious Gift.
• 
You will receive Coal for the Snowman, and after the holidays, the recipient will find valuable resources or even Wrappers inside — a festive currency that can be exchanged for exclusive cosmetics, consumables, and rare items!
• 
Gifts received appear in your mail. With the arrival of the New Year, they can be opened in the Gift Zone.
• 
Every 100 Mysterious Gifts contain approximately 20 Wrappers in addition to other rewards.
All items from gifts are personal.
What to spend Wrappers on?
This special currency can be exchanged for exclusive cosmetics, valuable consumables, and rare items in the Gift Zone shop. Team up with other players! When the community achieves the global goals for the region, new, even more valuable rewards will be available in the shop for everyone!
We will closely monitor progress and, if necessary, reduce the target number of gifts for certain stages to maintain the festive atmosphere for everyone!
Special achievements and titles await you for sending and receiving gifts.
• 
Santa's Helper 2025: Send 10 Mysterious Gifts.
• 
Santa Claus 2025: Send 100 Mysterious Gifts.
• 
Unpacker 2025: Receive 10 Mysterious Gifts.
• 
Santa's Favourite 2025: Receive 100 Mysterious Gifts.
ZIV has a special surprise for you!
Even ZIV is filled with festive spirit! He has already prepared a batch of Mysterious Gifts for you: 
• 
December 17-18,
• 
December 31 - January 1.
You just need to be in the game at the moment of drawing. Perhaps you will be the lucky one! 
Give the gift of magic. May everyone have a holiday.
Storm
A temporary but large-scale event that occurs between regular eruptions is returning. It covers the entire CEZ, except for the Lyubech-3 and Stillwaters locations, severely limits visibility, and also imposes the Frost infection. The further north your location is, the stronger the influence of these effects.
Similar to the eruptions, the announcer warns of the approach of a Storm, which lasts approximately 30 minutes.
On the location map, you can see predictions of the Storm's approach and observe its activity from a safe zone.
This year's Storm: what has changed compared to last season?
• 
Boxes containing consumables that will help you cope with the Storm appear in the open world. They now appear constantly, with a lower spawn density. 
• 
Updated the Storm effect.
• 
Activities: airdrops at the Scrapyard and Forge-11.
• 
New frosty artefact: Opal.
• 
Daily tasks related to the Storm have been added to the Season Pass.
Record-player
Everyone can now craft a record player in the Hideout. 
The records themselves can be obtained from various sources within the game.
1) Location ambient is obtained through looting with a small chance.
2) For some story quests, such as completing the South and North storylines, you can receive album entries. For those who have already completed the storyline, expect compensation soon.
3) Event records – will be obtained within modes in various ways.
The owner of the player has the option to allow their guests to play their own tracks by enabling a special setting. Guests will also be able to manage the owner's collection.
The player is in the safe zone.
A public music player has been installed next to the stage at the Drunken Geiger bar, and anyone can add a song to the queue.
Limitations: 
• 
One player may only place three compositions at a time;
• 
Maximum queue length – 100 tracks;
• 
When leaving the safe zone, the player's compositions are removed from the queue.
Santa Viv's Mail
The New Year season is a time to look back on the ending year and to make wishes for the year ahead.
On the Mainland, Santa Claus is in full charge during this time, but the Zone has not been left without its own wizard either. Meet Santa Viv!
He's here for a reason: Santa Viv wants to collect letters about what your year in the Zone was like and what you would like to see in the following year. He will definitely pass these wishes to the EXBO team.
Santa Viv will accept your letters from December 17 to December 24.
How to write a letter?
• 
Talk to Courier.
• 
Choose “Send a package”.
• 
In the “To” field, enter the name: Santa_Viv.
• 
In the “Message” field, write your wishes.
Santa Viv can also explain how to send him a letter — you can talk to him in the Bar and at faction bases.
What should you write?
Tell us how your year in the Zone went:
 · which moments you remember most;
 · what wishes you would like to leave for the developers for the next year.
The most heartfelt letters will be read by ZIV during the EXBO New Year stream.
However, please follow a few rules:
• 
The letter must contain at least 300 characters;
• 
Insults are prohibited.
All senders whose letters match the theme and do not violate the rules will receive a small gift from Santa Viv next year!
Attention! Be cautious to avoid possible scams.
Santa_Viv will never contact players directly, will not ask for money or other in-game valuables, will not distribute “prizes” through third-party links, and will not ask for personal data. Gifts for submitted letters will be sent by the System — no additional contact with anyone is required.
Looting rework
Updated visual display
 Each lootable object now has three states:
• 
Closed — not looted;
• 
Half-open — partially looted;
• 
Open — fully looted.
Example 1 (Stash):
Example 2 (Military crate):
Example 3 (Safe):
The placement of all lootable objects has been changed to balance their quantity for each faction.
Economic changes
Made minor adjustments to the looting economy, and no major changes are planned in the near future. However, a comprehensive rework of the economic system is planned in the long term.
Stashes
Added stashes to all open world locations where they previously did not exist.
Faction containers
Each faction now has its own containers.
A container can only be searched if it belongs to a faction that the player is not a member of.
The closer a faction container is to the faction’s home location, the more valuable its contents may be.
Changes to the faction container economy are possible in the future. 
Old lootable objects
All old lootable objects can no longer be searched.
Adding items to Trash
Added the option to move items to Trash for easier selection of needed items during activities and looting.
Right-click an item to select “Add to Trash”.
Quick pickup using the X key will not pick up items added to Trash.
Items can still be moved manually.
After adding an item to Trash, its icon becomes darker and a corresponding symbol appears.
Items that can be added to Trash include:
• 
Plates;
• 
Grenades;
• 
Items for sale;
• 
Ammunition;
• 
Mutant parts;
• 
Consumables;
• 
Barter items.
Operations changes
• 
Access to the mode no longer requires completing a quest.
• 
After completing a task, a timer starts, after which players are automatically teleported to the next task or the Operation ends.
• 
Updated the design of the Special goals tab.
• 
Reduced the number of Core Inhibitors received from disassembling Picklock and Newbie Modules.
• 
Reduced the number of Inhibitors in rewards for completing Operations.
• 
Reduced prices for restoring Picklock and Newbie Modules.
• 
Increased the chance of receiving Module Cores for completing Operations.
• 
Changed the composition of enemy waves summoned by Ratcatcher.
• 
Changed the composition of enemy waves in the second stage of Communication Hubs capture.
• 
Fixed an issue when squad members were not displayed during the search of the game.
Other
• 
Added the ability to sit on seats in all main safe zones.
• 
Added voice chat rooms in the following safe zones: 
• 
Fire Station
• 
 Village School
• 
Added the option to change the volume of incoming messages, such as eruption notifications. 
The "Volume of incoming messages" option now adjusts the volume of messages related to game events, eruption notifications, and story-related PDA messages.
• 
Item grouping has been added to the exchange interface in the list on the left. This option can be disabled if desired.
• 
Returned the Veteran rank to the SAC-2 detector.
• 
Updated models of Trijicon Collimator Sight and LaRue Collimator Sight.
• 
Updated models of PKP Pecheneg and all versions of FAMAS G2 and AA-12.
• 
Adjusted the weight of some items.
• 
Added sections for containers, backpacks, and bags to the auction.
• 
Added display of the percentage of plate armour penetration for ammunition.
• 
Fixed the lack of statistics display on Arms Race and DeathMatch.
• 
The Handmade LD can now be mounted on the lower rail of the Glock.
• 
Added an integrated collimator sight for Glock 18X and Glock 18X Gift for the Chosen One.
• 
Increased the maximum number of players in the Hideout to 35 for the duration of the New Year event.
• 
Changes to Season Pass tasks:
• 
Merged the tasks “Complete the ZIVCAS Raid event”, “Complete the Protecting scientists from mutants event” and the “Helping Allies event” into a single task “Complete the helping allies event”.

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [24.12.2025]
historical_patches.text:
The sound of popping champagne bottles fills the safe zones. Everyone is anticipating the upcoming holiday! While some are giving gifts and spreading New Year’s cheer to their friends, others are eagerly hunting for rare artefacts. Meanwhile, we have prepared a small patch note for the rapidly ending year.
Contents:
• 
Year Recap;
• 
Advanced Case;
• 
X-Mas Tree adjustments;
• 
Santa Viv’s mail closed;
• 
Other changes.
Year Recap
It’s time to sum things up!
Your personal Year Recap is now available in the Event Hub. The event will be accessible until January 14, 2026.
Inside, you’ll find personal statistics collected throughout 2025!
Take a moment to review your accomplishments and share your achievements, favourite gear and game stats with your friends.
On the final slide, a pleasant surprise awaits you in the form of a promo code and a commemorative achievement.
Today, the Zone has noticeably grown with titled stalkers. Artefact hunters, resellers, brave fighters, and… cool skeletons? Players who placed top 250 in the featured activities will receive special profile achievements! 
Please note: achievements can only be obtained by viewing your Year Recap.
Festive Set
Have you decorated your profile for the holidays yet? If not, now’s the perfect time to visit the in-game shop — the Festive Set is now available. It’s a great way to update your profile card and treat yourself with some gifts. Keep in mind: it can only be purchased once.
Inside you’ll find:
• 30 000 Season points;
• 15 Frozen Loot crates;
• Purrzy Customization Pack;
• Gifts.
Snowmaiden didn’t make it to the Zone this time, but Purrzy is already here and ready to decorate your profile.
Don’t miss your chance to grab the Festive Set while it’s available.
Advanced Case
So, have you stocked up on Thermal Blocks? It’s time to put them to use — the Advanced Case is returning to the in-game shop. It’s available for a limited time, so make sure to open it while you can!
X-Mas Tree adjustments
The holiday has arrived in the Zone! Gifts have become more generous and can now be found much more often. In addition, we’ve prepared several more pleasant surprises for you.
• 
Issued compensation for North and South storyline vinyl records, as well as profile customization sets for completing the South storyline.
• 
Updated contents and prices in the Gift Zone Shop.
Added a music vinyl record, profile decoration elements, and new paints.
• 
Added the ability to purchase frost consumables at Forge-11 clan bases.
• 
Added the ability to purchase fireworks crate in all safe zones.
• 
Added the ability to select the container level when claiming calendar rewards.
Available options depend on your current X-Mas Tree level:
At level 3 — containers of levels 1, 2, or 3 are available;
At level 7 — all container levels are available. The reward automatically resets to the maximum level when re-entering the gift-claim interface or switching tabs. 
Session Battles
• 
Increased gift rewards for Brawls, Tournaments, Base captures, and Session modes.
• 
Increased gift rewards for completing Operations.
Gifts from all Session Battles are now transferable, so share the joy with your friends!
Snowstorm
• 
Increased gift rewards for all Snowstorm events.
Gifts outside the Snowstorm
• 
We continue to monitor Gift Thief and actively adjust gift farming on locations from various sources outside the Snowstorm.
Other X-Mas Tree fixes
• 
Fixed the distribution of the Minister of Energy achievement.
• 
Fixed the display of player’s X-Mas Tree points in the leaderboard.
• 
Fixed the display of received and sent gifts in the Gift Zone tab interface.
• 
Fixed the inability to sell X-Mas Tree container contents to the Exchanger.
• 
Fixed the number of paints awarded in X-Mas Tree ranking rewards.
• 
Fixed the number of charms-counters and Average charm in X-Mas Tree ranking rewards.
• 
Fixed display of the rating number on the CR-72 pistol in the X-Mas Tree rewards.
• 
Fixed display of the last visited safe zone in the interface.
• 
Fixed the barter recipe for the New Year's Glock 18X and FAMAS at the Exchanger.
• 
Fixed flickering of the location in the X-Mas Tree interface.
• 
Fixed the absence of Snowstorm warnings in safe zones.
• 
Fixed a bug that occurred when killing a player with an Anomalous delivery.
Santa Viv’s mail closed
Letters are no longer accepted! Thank you for your warm congratulations and kind words! Santa's elves will sort through the letters, compile lists of those who deserve gifts, and send gifts in the New Year.
Other changes
• 
Restored previous economy of stashes and backpacks hidden across all locations.
• 
Fixed a bug where incorrect nootropics were obtained from fraction crates.
• 
Fixed stamina reset to 100% when changing locations.
• 
Fixed multiple naming inconsistency bugs.
• 
Fixed multiple translation inconsistency bugs across all languages.
• 
Corrected several minor localization bugs in all languages.

historical_patches.title: Hotfix [27.12.2025]
historical_patches.text:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/05604671c11187b778445a7d585e1b67a4b3bd2a.png
The following changes have been made without stopping the game servers:
• Fixed incorrect time for updating the Holiday Calendar.
• Fixed incorrect container selection in the Holiday Calendar reward when switching to it from another player's profile;
• M90 Green Holiday paint has been returned to the Gift Zone shop;
• Removed the ability to paint the bandit sticker in black.
The changes will take effect after updating and restarting the game.
Sincerely,
EXBO Team

historical_patches.text:

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [14.01.2026]
historical_patches.text:
While snowstorms rage outside, the situation in the Zone is heating up. The stakes are rising, and it’s the perfect time to intervene in the affairs of the Murmur fanatics! To prepare yourself for battle, we recommend familiarizing yourself with the latest balance changes.
Contents:
• 
Balance changes;
• 
Other changes and fixes.
Balance changes
Artefacts
Slightly reduced the power of the Regeneration and Healing Effectiveness stats on artefacts.
With the latest increase in the maximum power of artefacts, these stats were having too much of an impact on player survivability in firefights. On average, half of the bonus containers received in the patchnotes was removed.
Strengthened Prism, Fossil, Dumbbell, and Raisin
These artefacts did not have strong additional properties (or they had too little power), which made them insufficiently relevant compared to their equivalents and even lower-level artefacts.
Reworked Black Hole
The artefact has had its regeneration reduced in exchange for increased Stamina Improvement and the replacement of the Resistance to fire penalty with a Bleeding Protection.
The old characteristics made Black Hole too versatile, but now its regeneration is inferior to the regeneration of artefacts with an emphasis on regeneration of similar levels. 
Reworked Dark Viburnum
As with Black Hole, Dark Viburnum was too powerful in several areas at once: regeneration and speed. Speed was reduced in exchange for increased Stamina regeneration. 
Heavily reduced the amount of damage absorbed by Polyhedron 
The ability of the artefact to absorb massive single hits, combined with its other characteristics, made it too powerful, and its widespread use made life excessively difficult for sniper rifles.
In exchange for a significant reduction in damage absorption, the reload time has been significantly reduced.

historical_patches.title: Hotfix: Airdrops on Forge-11 [21.01.2026]
Patch Notes [28.01.2026]
historical_patches.text:
The gathering of the Storm’s gifts has come to an end, and the time for fierce and spectacular battles has arrived! Once again, the interests of various forces have converged on a mysterious island—and, as always, you will find yourself at the center of events, ready to seize every advantage. Welcome to Boral!
Link to video overview of the patch notes with subtitles:
Content
• 
Frost Troopers season event;
• 
Pack from subscribers;
• 
Operations adjustments;
• 
Signal dungeons economic changes;
• 
Balance changes;
• 
Other changes and fixes.
Frost Troopers season event
Temporary Frost Troopers mode has been added to the game.
PvPvE mode for both teams and single players. The mode will be available until February 18.
You can find the mode in the events tab. Go to the main menu (ESC) → Event Hub → Frost Troopers.
How to play?
To travel to Boral, the player must select the format of the raid: Scout or Trooper Group.
• 
Scout — a single-player mode where everyone is on their own. 
• 
Trooper Group — team mode, involves 6 teams of 3 players each.
Tasks:
• 
Complete the main tasks specific to each squad;
• 
Successfully evacuate from the island within a limited time.
The list of main tasks is located on the right side of the screen.
The reward depends on the number of tasks completed.
During evacuation, squads need to:
• 
Successfully reach the evacuation point;
• 
Surviving under the pressure of Murmur;
• 
Evacuate successfully.
Whether you evacuated or not determines the reward at the end of the mission.
Tactical support
At the beginning of the mission, you will receive a radio to call for tactical support.
Tactical support can be as follows:
• 
Attack — artillery strikes, bombs, helicopter strikes;
• 
Defensive — healing station, shield generator;
• 
Support — player revival.
Tactical support can be found in gear crates and after clearing events.
To call for tactical support, press the radio activation button (default — X).
Then enter the combination in one of two ways:
• 
By pressing the left and right mouse buttons, where the mouse buttons correspond to the directions of the arrows on the screen.
• 
By pressing the arrow keys on the keyboard.
After successfully entering the tactical support combination, it will be activated. It can be activated as follows:
• 
Get the laser for aiming by holding down the right mouse button.
• 
After pointing the laser at the spot where tactical support will be called, activate it by pressing the left mouse button.
Be careful, because tactical support disappears after use.
The Support tactical support
After completing each combat mission, you receive Support, which allows you to:
• 
In Scout mode — respawn after death;
• 
In Trooper Group mode — revive an ally.
Gear after respawning depends on the current match timer.
Encrypted Data Block
After successfully defending the golden psy-installation, you receive an Encrypted Data Block.
If you successfully evacuate with this Data Block, you can exchange it with a season trader for themed motifs, attachments, charms, paints, and a Trooper's Crate.
Season trader
Coupon for Trooper's Crate
In the vending machine, you can purchase a Coupon for Trooper's Crate, which can be exchanged for a Trooper's Crate upon successful evacuation with it.
Skill levelling
To increase your chances of survival on Boral, you need to level up your skills and improve your starting gear.
By obtaining Murmur trophies in missions, you can improve the following industries:
• 
Gear — affects your starting gear and consumables when landing on an island.
• 
Adaptation — strengthens the body's regenerative functions and increases overall resistance to damage.
• 
Grappling hook — reduces skill cooldown, speed, and range of use.
• 
Fame — affects the reward at the end of the mission.
Rewards
For completing the mission, the player receives:
• 
Game Rubles;
• 
Respect — the currency required to open special season event cases;
• 
Murmur Trophies — items needed to level up skills. Also can be converted to Respect if at least one branch is upgraded to the maximum level.
Reward size depends on:
• 
Selected mode;
• 
Number of tasks completed;
• 
Successful evacuation.
If the player dies, fails to complete the main objectives, or the evacuation is unsuccessful, they'll get fewer rewards.
Trooper's Crate
For the technologies obtained from Murmur and, of course, a good show, Trainer and Baron reward the brave troopers with boxes full of prizes.
They can be purchased with Respect earned from missions or by exchanging Murmur trophies.
In this crate you can find:
New Albatross Heavy Assault Armored Exoskeleton style — Dude
Master weapon attachments:
• 
Angled Grip RK-1;
• 
Steiner Optical Sight;
• 
2A Armament X3 Compensator;
• 
Truglo-Ace LD.
New weapon motifs:

Playboy for SA-58 CTC;
• 
Rescuer for Beretta ARX 160;
• 
Tourist for PKP Pecheneg;
• 
Civvy for FAMAS G2/SOPMOD;
• 
Lucky Ticket for Panсor Jackhammer.
New armour styles:
• 
Concussed for JD ZIVCAS 2A Exoarmor;
• 
Peacemaker for Saturn Jumpsuit;
• 
Grinner for Centurion Armored Exoskeleton.
Challenges and achievements
Added new achievements for the Frost Troopers event.
Pack from subscribers
While the people call for spectacle, Boral waits for the first victims. Basically, it's best not to go there without being prepared. This set is designed for those who want to shine in the midst of chaos.It includes:
• 
10 000 Season Points;
• 
5 Frozen Loot Season crates;
• 
3 days Premium;

5 000 Respect — the currency of the Frost Troopers event.
The set can be purchased 15 times. Please note that a special discount applies to the first and second purchases.

The Skip animation setting in the module GUI now also skips the animation for replacing explored characteristics.

•

Signal dungeons economic changes

Added keys for Safes to the rewards for Pink, Red and Yellow Signal Dungeons. They drop with a higher chance than in the open world.
•

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [18.02.2026]
historical_patches.text:
Baron keeps his customers engaged. This time, he plans to sell off a large shipment of equipment from the Mainland, which will cause a stir in every corner of the Zone.
Content

Frost Troopers event end

Access to the mode and levelling up is restricted, but the event interface is still available in the Hub, where you can buy Trooper's Crates and convert your remaining Murmur Trophies. Merchants will also remain within safe zones for some time, maintaining the ability to exchange encrypted data blocks for rewards.
Encrypted data blocks can now be exchanged for Trooper's Crates.
Order from the Mainland
ATTENTION TO ALL ZONE INHABITANTS!
Baron is on the air. A new wave of cargo has arrived from the Mainland. Black market established a supply channel and opened an order service called Order from the Mainland.
Find details in the video with English subtitles.
How it works
Baron's people set up a reception for the resources. The scheme is simple: you help them, they help you.
Progress bar
As part of the order acceptance process, there is a progress bar ranging from 0% to 100%. This progression is divided into four stages, each accounting for 25%, with its own resource collection rate.
• 
For every 5% of progress, you receive a small but guaranteed reward: overdrives, tools, spare parts, unstable anomalous batteries, and much more. The higher the percentage, the more valuable the cargo. 
• 
In the final stage (from 75% to 100%), special rewards are available, such as: animated sticker ULTRA JIDEN, Market Crate with Attachments, Market Crate with Styles and others. The last crate can be transferred, and the items obtained from it can also be used in exchanges.
Payment options
Black market dealers are ready to accept payment in various ways, but they have their preferences. Since this is a new venture, we have selected the following resources:
• 
Game Rubles;
• 
Trade Coins.
Resources may change in future events.
Main reward
When the scale reaches 100%, Black Market gives you your well-earned order. 
Main reward: two tiers
This time, the dealers had two types of special cargo in store. But supplies are limited — everyone should hurry.

When the exclusive period ends, Black Market will begin issuing the standard version. The same tactical and technical characteristics, but without visual frills. A standard, reliable tool. Its quantity is also limited.

Even if the fastest stalkers have already taken all the limited cargo, the event does not end there.
Smugglers will continue to receive resources. You can continue to fill the progress bar and receive interim rewards. This is an excellent way to exchange excess resources for useful consumables.
The most passionate collectors will have the opportunity to receive a Steppe Juice charm in one of many colour options. The total number of variations reaches 1081. Even the most steadfast Rise fighters and zealous Covenant followers encounter situations where strength is not the only deciding factor. Some require refined taste and a scientific approach, others require unshakeable faith.

historical_patches.text:
Watch Patch Note overview with ENG subs
The sky in the Zone has never been known for its clarity, but lately, stalkers are saying that the clouds are gathering even more. The military is increasing its activity along the Perimeter. The sensors of the Research Institute 7 are off the charts, registering new activity. Diggers working on clearing the tunnels under Pervomaisky are bringing back more and more news. What should stalkers expect with the approaching spring? Only the Zone knows the answer to that.
Content

• 
Wild North;

Tempered Steel season
Spring weather
Frost has retreated, snow no longer crunches underfoot, and paths that were recently hidden by snow are visible again. However, the weather is slow to bring us joy. On the contrary, now thunder can rumble in the Zone, like the bursts of some kind of weapon.
You will see the following changes in the game:
• 
Removed winter effects, weather phenomena replaced by spring ones;
• 
Added wind impact on plants;
• 
Updated night visual effect: without NVG, minimal visibility is now maintained instead of complete darkness, but overall visibility remains limited.

Adjusted the brightness of NVG to suit spring nights.
Season rewards

Special case

Tempered Steel starter pack
Start tempering steel now with the starter pack! The following items are already waiting for you:
• 
10 Season Pass levels;
• 
7 days Premium;
• 
Two unique Scars paints for armour and weapons.
Wild North
Wild North is a place beyond the reach of any faction’s influence. A territory was long abandoned by stalkers. Murmur, mutants and anomalies reigned unchecked for years. Are you ready to return to this place?
Remember: even a trusted partner can lead you into a trap, and your cooling body won’t be able to tell anyone about it.
And yet, despite all the dangers of the Wild North, many stalkers are eager to reach the outskirts of the Uranus Mill, Red Forest with its Radar Station, and Stillwaters, which is no longer accessible through the familiar Burrows. After all, the Wild North holds not only valuable loot, but countless secrets. It doesn’t matter whether you’re searching for ways to make money or answers to the Zone’s mysteries. One thing is certain: the Wild North is the best place to test your luck.
What are these wild locations?
They are Red Forest, Uranus Mill, and Stillwaters. There are no allies here other than players from your squad and your subdivision.
How to get there?
Access to the Wild North locations unlocks after completing the northern storyline. Talk to your faction leader, who will send you to Curie at Drunken Geiger Bar. Curie will tell you more about the Wild North and give you a pass to Underground.
Underground is a location with disabled PvP, but it's still not safe. Anomalies await careless stalkers around every corner.
At the end of Underground, you’ll find three doors, each leading to one of the following locations: Red Forest, Uranus Mill, Stillwaters.
How to go back?
There are four ways to exit these locations:
• 
Die 💀 (Highly likely!)
• 
Clear Murmur Post event. This will spawn a Burrow that allows up to 5 players to pass through. 
• 
Use a jumping Burrow. It allows only 1 player to pass, then it moves to another location.
It also changes location every 2 minutes.
Only one jumping Burrow can be active on a location at a time.
• 
Find a hidden Burrow using SAC and SRD. These Burrows do not appear naturally and must be discovered using special devices. 
What’s new?
• 
Updated visuals of Red Forest and Uranus Mill locations.
• 
Drunken Geiger Bar now has everything you need for your expeditions, including traders, delivery contracts and contract provider.
• 
Clearing events now drops new, more valuable items that can be sold to the fence.
• 
Added 7 new artefacts, obtainable only in the Wild North.
• 
Added 2 new master rank variable zoom sights. They can be assembled from parts that drop with some chance from Murmur events and airdrops. 
Apogee optical sight 
Azimut optical sight
• 
Added 2 additional personal storage pages, unlocked through reputation levels at Drunken Geiger Bar.
• 
Murmur Materials paint is available for exchange at Drunken Geiger Bar.
• 
Added new (old) Anomalous Rift event. Use Noo-converter to obtain artefacts. 
• 
Noo-converter can be purchased at the merchant in Drunken Geiger Bar.
• 
You can now form cross-faction squads in the Wild North.
What has changed?
• 
Removed Burrows leading to Stillwaters from Forge-11.
• 
Significantly reduced the maximum player count at Stillwaters.
• 
Removed golden airdrops from Stillwaters. They now drop only at Red Forest and Uranus Mill.
•

Event Hub challenges
New challenges have been added to the Event Hub. By completing them, you can earn parts for Apogee and Azimut sights as well as Season Pass points.
Challenges are available until March 18, so head to the Wild North, explore and claim your rewards!

Stash rework
Stash mechanics have been reworked.
Interaction
You can interact with the updated stashes immediately after installation, and you can pick up and put down items without confirmation.
Stashes also got a new feature — access for the squad. All players in the squad can now interact with the stash.
You can grant access in the stash interface or via the map.
Stashes exist on a copy of the location only while their owner is there. If the owner dies or switches to another copy, squad members will no longer be able to find this stash.
Conceal
When interacting with objects inside the stash, its conceal begins, during which the stash becomes visually apparent to everyone on the location copy. The duration of conceal depends on the type and quality of the stash.
If, during conceal, the owner leaves the stash radius or dies, any player can take part of its contents, but only once, after which the stash cannot be found.
Durability
Amount of loot dropped depends on the durability parameter. When a player interacts with someone else's stash, they can take certain items from it.
Access to each individual cell/item/quantity is granted with a certain probability, i.e. if durability = 30%, then the probability of occurrence for each individual cell will be 70%. If there are several items in a cell, only a certain number will drop. That is, if there are 100 items in a cell, 70 out of 100 items will drop with 30% durability, while the rest will remain in the stash.
Try to hide your stash securely from prying eyes!
The impact of infections, types of stashes and their durability
Stashes exist in the world for a limited amount of time, determined by their durability, which gradually decreases. Durability depends on the quality of the stash. The stronger the stash is, the longer it will be able to remain on the location.
There are also two types of stashes:
• 
Standard;
• 
Shielded.
The difference is that in infected areas, the strength of standard stashes decreases much faster, with the maximum level of infection having an impact. Their number is irrelevant. When the durability value drops to zero, the stash will disappear along with all its contents.
Special shielded stashes have been created for art hunters. They are protected from the effects of infection and can store artefacts. Infection through a shielded stash always deals 1 point of damage per minute.
Balance changes
Consumables
Changes to protective, output and healing consumables
Implemented the first part of consumable adjustments: first-aid kits, stimulators, bandages, and infection-output items. Additional changes to all consumables are planned for the future.
We aimed to make first-aid kits and stimulators (STRIKE and STOMP) more balanced in terms of player usability. We also addressed the issue where military first-aid kits had effectively become the only viable healing option despite being low-tier. 
First-aid kits now share a unified preset: they provide light bleeding removal, moderate healing, and regeneration, but no longer remove radiation or bioinfection. They restore less health in a short period of time but last longer, resulting in greater overall healing in the long run. Stimulators, on the other hand, restore more health in a short period of time but are less effective than first-aid kits over extended periods.
Overall, stimulators remain largely unchanged and continue to serve as more PvP-oriented medical items. They no longer apply debuffs such as intoxication or poisoning, but their effectiveness has been reduced.
The removal of infection output from first-aid kits was necessary to eliminate artefact builds that could bypass counter-artefacts by relying solely on first-aid kits. This change also increases the value of dedicated infection-output consumables.
All infection-output consumables now function similarly to bandages but with an output effect. They activate over 3 seconds and remove a larger amount of infection at once. For convenience, these items now cleanse two types of infection simultaneously. Panacea, as the most advanced version, removes all types of infection at once.
All infection-output consumables, except bandages, now apply a poisoning effect to prevent frequent use.
Medicine that provided infection resistance has been removed. Over time, they proved to be an unnecessary consumable type, diverting attention from protective artefacts and combo armour options. All such medicine has been replaced with corresponding infection-output consumables.

Due to the removing infection consumables changes and the removal of protective medicines, the characteristics of anti-infection artefacts have been enhanced.
They were previously used exclusively for infected areas, rather than for basic builds, so now, starting with a certain rarity of the artefact, they are more comfortable for the infected areas.
Mirror and Eye of the Storm received a significant boost to their defensive stats, but also incresced vitality debuff. The compensation function is available for these artefacts. It can be activated via the context menu.

Weapons and plates
Plates used to affect damage to both the body and head as much as—or even more than—the weapon’s multiplier. Now, the difference between head and body damage is primarily determined by the base head damage multiplier, which has been raised from 1.25 to 1.4. At the same time, the effectiveness of plates, like most other consumables, has been reduced.
The Ceramic Plate has lost its speed penalty and now provides 10% more damage absorption. At the same time, its effective durability has been lowered, meaning it will absorb less damage in total.
The Ceramic Plate becomes less effective as a character’s effective health increases. Overall, it still provides slightly more combat benefit than the Composite Plate and reduces the strength of effects such as stopping power and bleeding when the character takes body damage.

historical_patches.text:
Where the Zone’s tides clash with the ocean’s force!
Content
• 
Operation Sea of Exclusion;
• 
Faction quests;
• 
New artefacts;
• 
Ship Aesthete case;
• 
Balance changes;
• 
Other.
Operation Sea of Exclusion
You can start the new Operation Sea of Exclusion under Session battles → Operations tab. The Operation will always be available.
Operations are a session-based mode for three players. You can learn more about the mode here.
Sea of Exclusion Event
Along with the launch of the new Operation comes an event dedicated to it. You can find in the Event Hub.
Note: during the Sea of Exclusion event, you don’t need to complete Phil’s assignment in the Bar to start this Operation. Any player can launch it, provided they choose to play using ready-made gear templates. To play with your own gear, you will need to complete Phil’s assignment. The challenges in the Event Hub will last from March 11 to March 18. You can find more details about the rewards below.
 | 
Complete the Sea of Exclusion Operation
 | 
Core Inhibitor ×100
 | 
Complete the Sea of Exclusion Operation at Clearance level 5 or higher
 | 
Core Inhibitor ×100

In the Sea of Exclusion Operation, you will need to infiltrate the Murmur territory, refuel the bombers, clear the way with a hydraulic crane, and disable the cruiser’s guns in the Battleship mission.
All these objectives must be carried out under the cruiser’s heavy fire, so staying in open areas for too long is not recommended!
In one of the objectives, you will need to stabilize the pressure. Please review the instructions below.
After you neutralize the threat from the cruiser’s large-calibre guns, you will need to storm the ship and install decoders on it.
Once control over the cruiser’s generators is established, you will face the boss — Tech.
He will attack you with swarms of drones and gravitational charges.
If something like that showed up during the Attack on Perimeter, the Perimeter would be in serious trouble…
Class template
To allow players to take part in Operations without having their own high rank equipment, or to try a different class within the mode, a template system has been introduced.
There are three class templates available — one for each class:
• 
Assault;
• 
Support;
• 
Operative.
Each template uses Veteran rank equipment upgraded to level 10.
Please note that templates are only available up to Operation Clearance 9. Additionally, if even one member of a squad is using a gear template, the squad will not be able to play Operations above Clearance level 9.
When playing with a template gear, the completion reward is reduced, but the weekly reward remains unchanged.
Gear templates can also be used to complete special goals and challenges.
You can select a class template from the dropdown list on the Operations screen in the Session Battles tab.
Please note: switching back to your own gear does not happen automatically after restarting the game or completing an Operation.
Special goals and rewards
 | 
Complete the Sea of Exclusion Operation on Clearance level 6 or higher
 | 
Sea of Exclusion background
 | 
Complete the Sea of Exclusion Operation at Clearance level 9 or higher
 | 
Sea of Exclusion pattern, Core Inhibitor ×500
 | 
Complete the Sea of Exclusion Operation at Clearance level 15 or higher
 | 
Sea of Exclusion sticker, Quasi-Destructor
 | 
Complete the Grade 9 Electrician achievement
 | 
Season points ×1 000, Sea of Exclusion vinyl record
Temporary reward increase
During the Sea of Exclusion event, guaranteed rewards for completing Sea of Exclusion Operation will be increased by 25%.
The guaranteed reward for completing the Focus Operation will be increased by 10%.
Rewards for completing the Big Clean Up Operation remain unchanged.
New achievements available in Sea of Exclusion Operation
 | 
Humanist
 | 
Kill Tech at Clearance 15 or higher and complete the Sea of Exclusion Operation.
 | 
Blind Luck 
 | 
During the Battleship stage of Sea of Exclusion Operation, hit the target without using Radar at Clearance level 9 or higher.
 | 
Under Pressure
 | 
During the Pressure Control stage of Sea of Exclusion Operation, keep all controllers in the green state at Clearance level 9 or higher.
 | 
Grade 9 Electrician
 | 
During the battle with Tech in the Sea of Exclusion Operation, do not disable the Tesla Protocol ability even once at Clearance level 9 or higher.
New faction quests
For players who have completed the Operations Breach quest and belong to the north factions, a continuation of the story connected to the mysterious Areas has been added. Each storyline is unique to its faction and reveals their perspective on the technologies hidden within the depths of subspace.
These quests partially reveal the aftermath of the Pole operation on the Mainland, concluding its storyline while hinting at future events.

As a special reward for completing the quest, you will receive a Penetration Stattuete.
This installation came about on its own when one scientist, a fan of naval engineering, got into an argument with his colleague, a tank enthusiast. After a particularly skillful throw by the admirer of land armour, this rather intricate piece of decor appeared. ZIVCAS fighters will gladly provide it to you… If you manage to complete your task, of course.
While progressing through the new quests, you will visit the Sea of Exclusion locations and prepare for completing the Operation.
Please note: the new quests are permanent, just like the Breach quest.
Improvements to Operations mode
Updated interface:
• 
Recommended equipment display. Each Clearance level now indicates the recommended equipment rank for completing it.
1-5 Clearance: Stalker level gear
6-8 Clearance: Veteran level gear
9+ Clearance: Master level gear
• 
Information about rewards for the Breach quest has been added to the Operations interface. We strongly recommend that you complete the tutorial to better understand how to complete Operations and what led to them.
• 
Updated pop-up notification that appears when voting to restart a stage.
• 
Messenger now voices key Operation events, helping you navigate the situation faster and enhancing the overall gameplay experience.
New side interactive objects mechanic
Objects now appear in locations that you can interact with to trigger various effects.
Objects listed in the table can only be interacted with once. Restarting the stage restores them.

When their durability is fully destroyed, the pipe bursts and releases a column of steam for several seconds, damaging anyone inside it.
 |

Added a new mechanic for decor variability when replaying the Operation
The Operation environment is no longer static. When replaying it, decorations change: some objects disappear while others appear, creating the effect of a living environment. Currently, this mechanic works only in the Sea of Exclusion Operation, but it will be added to other Operations in the future.
Changes to modifiers
Weekly modifiers are now assigned separately to each Operation and are displayed on their cards. Modifier sets are not unique, meaning the same ones can appear in multiple Operations.
As before, each Operation can have 0 to 3 modifiers, depending on the Clearance level.
Fixes and improvements
• 
Squad members are now moved to a safe zone when launching an Operation from the Hideout.
• 
Disabled wind sounds in all Operations except Storm’s boss arena.
•

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [08.04.2026]
historical_patches.text:
The Zone is turning itself Inside Out once again. Old paths become inaccessible, but entirely new paths come into view…
Content:
• 
Inside Out Percolation;
• 
Inside Out Percolation Packs;
• 
Melted cosmetics;
• 
Melted aesthete case;
• 
Hideout decorations;
• 
Proximity voice chat;
• 
Merging Home and Middle Locations;
• 
1000 level style;
• 
Economic Balance Adjustments for Wild North Locations;
• 
Other changes and fixes.
Inside Out Percolation
Inside Out has once again entered the CEZ, releasing the Inside Out zones into the outside world, and with them — Phantom fighters and mutants. Distortion shatters reality into pieces, and it becomes completely unclear who is shooting you: your friend, who you saw earlier, or his phantom silhouette?
Inside Out Percolation is a medium-scale time limited PvPvE event. Possible rewards include: Inside Out artefacts, Inside Out Gift case containing themed items for your hideout, consumables, season cases, and blueprints for the Inverter pistol.
The event is open until May 6.
Areas of Inside Out
In the northern locations: Forge-11, Serpentine, Mines, Institute, Barrier, Inflow and Temple Swamps — Inside Out areas have formed. There you can encounter phantom mutants, Phantoms Camps and Bases, unique artefacts, and the Transmuter event.
Defeating mutants rewards you with Onyx and items required to reduce distortion. Clearing camps grants Onyx, Glass, and a chance to obtain a Phantom Key.
Onyx — a resource used to activate the Centrifuge;
Glass (Tempered / Clear / Dim) — a resource that you can sell to the Fence;
Phantom Key — an item used to open safes in the Inside Out.
Distortion
Distortion is a unique infection of Inside Out that accumulates:
• 
By being in areas of the Inside Out;
• 
When taking damage from NPCs and mutants.
The higher the distortion level, the greater the damage caused by the infection. If the distortion is not reduced in time, it will result in death.
To reduce accumulated distortion, use Memoria Fruits or special consumables.
Memoria grows in Inside Out areas.
Special consumables can be obtained by defeating mutants and opening Inside Out safes.
However, distortion also has its benefits. The more distortion you accumulate, the more Onyx you receive.
At North safe zones, you can purchase an Alteration Concentrator from the Merchant, which increases your distortion level.
Inside Out safes
By clearing the Phantoms Bases and Phantoms Camps, you have a chance to obtain a Phantom Key. It lasts for 20 minutes and is used to open Inside Out safes.
The safes may contain Onyx, Memoria Fruits, and special consumables.
The contents of a safe disappear 5 minutes after it is opened.
Transmuter
Transmuter is an event that appears across all Inside Out areas.
At the event location, three Centrifuges can be found. They are activated using Onyx. After activation, a Centrifuge begins spinning for a certain period of time.
The spinning process has multiple levels: the higher the level, the better the rewards. However, higher levels require more Onyx and take longer to complete a full cycle.
 | 
Cycle levels
 | 
Onyx required
 | 
Cycle time
 | 
First cycle
 | 
1 000
 | 
30 seconds
 | 
Second cycle
 | 
2 000
 | 
+ 15 seconds
 | 
Third cycle
 | 
3 000
 | 
+ 20 seconds
 | 
Fourth cycle
 | 
4 000
 | 
+ 25 seconds
 | 
Fifth cycle
 | 
6 000
 | 
+ 30 seconds
In total, the full cycle requires 16 000 Onyx and 120 seconds.
All three Centrifuges can be activated at the same time.
As with regular installations, once the cycle is complete, the Centrifuge can be opened by any player in your squad, or by a random player if you have strayed too far.
The main currency of the event is Burnt Onyx. You can obtain it by processing regular Onyx in a Centrifuge. However, the output will be 10 times smaller.
The first cycles of the Centrifuge's operation allow Glass to be extracted.
From the third spin cycle, you can get Inside Out artefacts from the Centrifuge.
• 
The highest rarity of artefacts that can be obtained from Transmuter events is Special for home locations and Rare for middle locations. At Forge-11, there is a chance to obtain Exceptional and Legendary artefacts.
From the fifth spin cycle of the Centrifuge at Forge-11, there is a chance of obtaining the blueprints for the Inverter pistol.
You need 100 blueprints to build an Inverter pistol. You can exchange them for a pistol at the season Exchanger.
You can sell extra parts to the Fence.
Inside Out artefacts
Inside Out artefacts can be found not only using Centrifuges, but also in the open world — in the Inside Out areas after eruption.
Maximum rarity of artefacts in the open world matches the maximum possible rarity at that location, except for Forge-11 — Inside Out artefact rarity there have been raised to Legendary.
Inside Out artefacts are:
• 
Tiny key:
• 
Bubblegum;
• 
Egg;
• 
Bismuth;
• 
Dark Viburnum;
• 
Retina;
• 
Inside Out Rose;
• 
Raisin;
• 
Crystal of Inside Out;
• 
Tallow;
• 
Wicked Hedgehog.
A new Inside Out artefact has been discovered in the Zone — Wicked Hedgehog.
We will provide further details later regarding the fate of Rubik, another artefact from Inside Out, and how to obtain it.
Initial quest
The scientist Tae Minjoon has set up base at the factions’ headquarters, where he is engaged in studying the physical phenomena of the Zone. He will help you delve into the world of Inside Out, explain what Inside Out is, and assist you in studying this anomalous phenomenon.
You can complete the quest until the event ends.
Season Pass themed challenges
A new Inside Out Percolation tab has appeared in the open-world tasks section, containing the following tasks:
• 
Clearing out Phantom Camps;
• 
Clearing out Phantom Bases;
• 
Successful activation of the Centrifuge to maximum level.
Tasks in this category are always available, so there is no need to replace them.
Inside Out Percolation event shop
When you use Onyx to activate the Centrifuge, you receive Burnt Onyx — the currency used to purchase items from the event shop.
You can find it in the Events Hub, under the Inside Out Percolation tab.
Inside Out Percolation challenges
You can earn even more rewards by completing the event challenges.
You can find them in the Events Hub, under the Inside Out Percolation tab.
Inside Out Gift case
If, however, you prefer safer paths and risk isn’t your thing — you can obtain artefacts from Inside Out another way… In the twists! The Black hideout Baron on his leather sofa, surrounded by flasks containing various rare artefacts? Hold my whisky!
Aside from prestige and boosts, the particularly lucky may come across parts of the Inverter. Go for it!
Inside Out Percolation packs
For the most reckless adventurers, ready to face the other side, a pack has been prepared that might come in handy on the journey. Pack includes:
• 
20 000 Burnt Onyx;
• 
5 Season levels;
• 
3 days Premium;
• 
15 Overdrives.
The pack is available for purchase 15 times. Please note that the maximum discount applies to the first and second purchases. The discount then gradually decreases, with no discount applied to purchases 11 through 15.
Melted pack
For opportunists, we’ve prepared a starter pack to supply you with essential gear for the early days.
The set includes:
• 
50 Overdrives;
• 
3 days of Premium;
• 
10 Strategic Reserve crates;
• 
Ducky paint set;
• 
ArcTech Bot charm.
The pack can be purchased twice.
Melted cosmetics
Melted cosmetics is now available in shop. Strong and resistant to the cold, Jotun shows you its deadly arsenal. Watch your hands until they’re frozen to the gun.
Melted Aesthete case
Bad weather is no excuse for not keeping up with the latest trends! Battle duck is leading a bunch of real thugs. Lead the raid by equipping your feisty duck — with its distinctive colour, available in a whole host of variations — with a stylish weapon! And a collection of new paints will help make it just that.
Hideout decorations
New decorations have been added for the most cautious recluses, which you can place in your punk lair. For those with a particularly vivid imagination, there’s a chance to stage unreal battles between combat ducks and a souped-up ArcTech Bot!
Profile designs
And for those who love to stand out and dazzle enemies with a last-flash spectacle, we’ve prepared sets for customizing your death card. Fierce Battle features an animated green flash sticker, while Tracks shows off a brightly highlighted gradient of a heavy tank tread!
Proximity voice chat
A new Location voice chat option called has appeared in the game settings.
Proximity chat allows you to communicate with nearby players who are not in your squad. Welcome travelers! Demoralise your enemies or show off your eloquence to the full!
Merging Home and Middle Locations
Faction home locations are merged with middle locations — Institute and Serpentine are merged with Mines, whilst Barrier and Temple Swamp are merged with Inflow. Although the areas around the faction bases are no longer separate locations, they have kept their names on the map. Operations updates and fixes
Ranked mode Season Zero start
Key ideas and how rating works
Operation success points — points earned for a single Operation run. These are calculated based on completion time, time modifier (one, two, or three stars), and the clearance level achieved. Players who complete higher clearance levels will earn more points, even with slower completion times.
Operation success record — the highest number of success points a player has achieved in a specific Operation. This record updates if a new run has more points. Initial value: 0.
Operation rating points — the sum of all Operation success records across Operations included in the current ranked season. This total determines the player’s position on the leaderboard.
Calculation example: in Season Zero, three Operations are included: The Big Clean Up, Focus, and Sea of Exclusion.
Let’s say your best scores are:
• 
The Big Clean Up — 4000 points;
• 
Focus — 5000 points;
• 
Sea of Exclusion — 3000 points.
Your total Operation rating points would be: 4000 + 5000 + 3000 = 12 000. This is the value displayed on the leaderboard.
Leaderboard
Rankings are based on total Operation rating points. Multiple players can share the same position — in this case, the next player takes the position adjusted for occupied slots. For example, if three players share first place, the next player will be ranked fourth. Top-tier placements include the top 0.5% of all participants.
Reset and rotation

historical_patches.title: Subdivision Battles, Wild North and Session modes: answers to your questions
historical_patches.text:
Clan Content
What happened to the “Industrial Zone” map after OTS?
After testing, we concluded that the map's concept is solid, but we still have serious work ahead on routes to objectives and building placement. Also, we're currently facing LD and LA team workload.
Are there plans to introduce new maps or rework old ones?
Recently, we made small adjustments to Coniferous that fixed a number of unpleasant gameplay situations.
Right now, significant reworks are underway for the Malya Berdovka map. We want to reduce the influence of sniper rifles on this map, create more opportunities to flush out some difficult positions, and make the map more symmetrical in terms of side capabilities. We'd really like to see the updated Berdovka this summer, but I can't specify an exact timeline yet.
The situation with Lowland is more complicated. We concluded a long time ago that the map is “cursed” by its very design, and it would be easier to build a new map than to fix the current one. The periodic minor changes that come out are more about making it less toxic than actually addressing its core issues, and we understand that clearly. Most likely, in the future, it will be replaced in the map pool by the same Industrial Zone or a completely rebuilt Lowland.
Wind Rose for 3 points is an even more “cursed” map than Lowland. There are no plans for it at the moment.
What about further clan development: subdivision levels 4 and 5, clan tasks, clan activities?
We can't promise anything for now. We need to rebuild the entire clan system at a conceptual level before we can start producing clan content. Substantial changes are unlikely before autumn.
Is there a plan to allow players from different factions to join the same Subdivision?
Yes, it's planned. Most likely, in the future, we'll either decouple clans from factions or allow clans to decouple themselves upon meeting certain conditions.
Relocating bases from Radial North to Wild North: how many bases are planned for Wild North, and will any bases remain on Radial North?
Initially, we planned to move only 2 bases to Wild North, but in the end, we'll be moving all 4.
Are any alliances between Subdivisions or shared bases planned?
We'd like to see clan alliances on Wild North. Possibly, we'll also see shared base usage. We've thought about joint base captures, but for now, we see more problems than benefits from that.
When Subdivision Battles were updated, it was mentioned that penalties for missing tournaments would be added later — are there plans to add them soon, and why haven't they been introduced yet?
We don't want to introduce a penalty because the problem lies in the rating calculation system, not in clans' right to skip capture days.
We'll see the revised rating calculation system in the May or July season, if we don't make the deadline.
Separate functionality — squad management for a caller.
Unfortunately, not a priority.
Will there be anything new for husks in the assortment? In high-tier subdivisions, players already have nowhere to spend them except on rerolls/unseals.
Not in the near future. In the distant future, there will be cosmetics. No new weapons are planned.
Will there be bases oriented toward low clan ratings (E–C tier)?
No, this is not planned.
There are issues with rating distribution on regions like EU and NA. We don't have enough clans to form A/B brackets, so in the end, all clans just fall at the feet of S-tier clans because we end up in the same bracket. Is there any way to spread out lower-tier clans so we have a chance to compete among ourselves?
This is a problem of low region “population.” I can barely imagine how to help with that under the current system. Well, maybe by reducing the maximum number of participants in Subdivision Battles to 25, as we did in the Asian region. Under the current system, it's impossible to separate clans by tiers on low-population servers.
Why are the points on Berdovka so poorly designed in terms of room layout? When I play on F/C, instead of normal PvP, I'm just playing tag with a speed player who runs away from me all over the building. And now, after the release of shotgun branches, players just cram four into a room and hold it with KS-23s in hand. Will anything change in the map design or this point?
We're aware of the issue with this point. It will be rebuilt as part of the overall Berdovka rework we mentioned above.
When will we be able to view tabs after Subdivision Battles end?
Someday… We don't have time for that right now.
Will limits on items that can be purchased for husks be removed or changed?
Right now, we don't see a need to change or remove the limits.
Is it possible to add a special ammo type for the KS-23 that deals extra damage to structures?
That's how the “Barricade” ammo was originally intended, but for some reason, we didn't implement it. Better to check with the balance team.
Is it possible to add additional clan interfaces directly in-game? We'd really like to see systems like viewing member lists and their attendance, tab history from Subdivision Battles, player effectiveness over time, and tracking who signed up for a battle.
We plan to move clans to the ESC menu in the future, finally migrating away from the PDA, but we can't promise a bunch of GUIs just for QoL. Some comfort improvements will definitely happen. If players can compile a thread/document with clear requests on what and why they want to see, that would significantly increase the chances of certain features appearing in the game.
Wild North
Distances between spots seem too small. During PvP, you'll inevitably hit someone, and mutants/NPCs deal extremely high damage.
We've already made small changes in this direction. We'll continue monitoring the situation after Inside Out ends. If the changes prove insufficient, we'll continue working in this direction.
Are alternative entry methods to Wild North planned, besides the underground passage?
There are no such plans.
Are solo/duo/trio squads planned for Stillwaters?
When we discussed reducing squads to 3, we considered keeping 5-player squads for Red Forest and Uranis Mill while reducing to 3 for Stillwaters.
The funny thing is, according to statistics, you're already much more likely to encounter solo/duo/trio squads at Stillwaters than a full-size squad. Meanwhile, Red Forest and Uranis Mill do have a high chance of spawning 4–5 player squads.
Is anything planned about the endless fights for respect at spawn points in Red Forest and Uranus Mill? Feels like it's easier and safer to just run through Stillwater.
Don't fight for respect. Bring a speed-focused build for your loadout swap + use the 20-second invulnerability. That's plenty of time to leave the anteroom and reach cover.
Packages to Stillwaters: we have 2 normal points where you need to deliver super-heavy cargo, but there's a position behind one of the buildings at the water treatment complex: delivering a package there is often very problematic. Any thoughts on this?
It's a perfectly normal package. I've carried it myself and have no complaints. Find your routes.
One-shot trampolines in northern Red Forest and Uranus Mill: why are they needed?
The Zone doesn't have to be comfortable, and anomalies shouldn't be harmless. Watch your step!
Session Modes
Problem with camping opponents: if one team is stronger than the other, players on one team start getting camped at spawn, preventing them from exiting — the game effectively ends right there. Is there any plan to fix this?
We're aware of this issue. There are several ideas on how to solve it, one of which is to create multiple different exits from the base to complicate its control.
Outdated maps: given the release of the shotgun class, a significant portion of small maps has become dominated by shotgun players. SMGs are still somewhat playable, but most assault rifles are struggling. Are there plans to rework current maps or add the ability to restrict specific classes on current maps?
After discussing map-related questions with the community, we compiled a list of issues for all maps, and we'll try to solve them by refining and improving the maps.
Are there plans to introduce new Session modes different from “Point Capture”?
Yes, they're planned. In the near future, we'll try to release TDM on small maps. Other modes are also in the plans, but without dates.
When a player deals 99% damage and someone else steals the kill — the player loses healing and ammo replenishment. This suggests an “Assist as Kill” mechanic — is its appearance in Session modes possible?
We'll most likely implement splitting healing and ammo replenishment among kill participants. The “Assist as Kill” mechanic still needs more thought.
Seasonal KD for Session modes: meta changes, times move on, a player might perform differently from Season to Season, but their average KD over years of play doesn't budge.
Seasonal KD itself has been discussed, but we're more inclined toward KD over the last N games to show a player's success not in a specific season, but over recent matches. While keeping the global KD.
Spartak: when are daily tasks and assortment updates, new armour for tokens, planned?
We'd really like to tweak the consumables assortment. Armour ideas have been floating around, but it's not in the plans yet. Dailies are not under discussion.
When is the weapon update for AR/DM — gun updates, new attachments?
We had plans for that; currently, we're occupied with other issues. Someday.
Progression up to level 350 feels excessively stretched, requiring disproportionately large time investments (on the level of “farming for descendants”). Is there a plan to revise the XP curve?
Such progression was originally designed so that few players would own these guns and they would be hard to obtain. Revising the points curve itself is not planned, but we want to add more meaning to winning a match so that the number of points earned increases if the team wins. Possibly, we'll consider temporary boosts to leveling for resources.
Add 3v3/5v5 format maps, along with a ranked system.
You're describing duel-format tournaments right now, not Session modes. Currently, you can assemble squads in such numbers for duels and play. Expanding that to Session modes wouldn't work very well, especially with a rating system.
Bring back scheduled map rotation; it encouraged players to adapt their loadouts to different maps.
It also caused discontent among players who were forced to play on a specific map they didn't like, so we decided to abandon that approach.
Will there be any changes regarding Battle Packs for session levels and their contents?
The Battle Pack assortment has indeed become outdated, and we'll try to update it in the near future. We'll also revisit rewards for top placements in Session modes.

historical_patches.title: Test Server launch [04.05.26]
historical_patches.text:
OTS launch — Assault on the Reichstag
In this article, we’ll explain what OTS is, how to test the Assault on the Reichstag event, and where to report any issues you encounter.
What is OTS?
OTS stands for Open Test Server. It gives access to early versions of major updates. Your role is to share feedback and help us identify and fix issues before final release.
Please note that equipment from the main server will not be synchronised on this OTS — don’t be surprised if your gear or even your main character is missing.
Progress does not transfer between servers, and everything you do with items on OTS stays on OTS.
Test Participants
Access to OTS is granted randomly to all players except newcomers.
How do I know if I’ve been invited?
If you’re using the launcher, a separate server will appear for download: “STALCRAFT OTS”.
If you’re playing via Steam, check in-game mail. You should receive a message titled “OTS invitation” from “System”, sent to your most recently active character.
If there’s no such message, you don’t have access to testing.
Schedule
OTS starts on 4 May 2026 at \ and runs until 5 May 2026, \.
Please note: this is a test server. It may be stopped or restarted at any time to apply changes.
What are we looking for?
Right now, we’re interested in your feedback on Assault on the Reichstag — how it feels to play, how the pacing works, and whether the balance holds up.
We’re counting on your input, and you can share it through the in-game survey available on OTS and on our official Discord server in a feedback discussion \.
We also ask for a bit of understanding when it comes to rough edges — we’ll be actively monitoring and supporting the server throughout the test.
How do I access OTS?
OTS will be available to players in RU and EU regions. Steam login remains supported.
If you’re using the launcher and have access, the server will automatically appear in your download list.
To join via Steam, you’ll need to opt into the available beta version in settings.
Important! On Steam, the beta is visible to everyone — even players who were not selected for testing.
Please make sure you’ve received the in-game invitation before downloading.
Otherwise, you may download the client but won’t be able to participate.
To avoid this, we recommend using EXBO Launcher to access the test server, even if you usually play via Steam.
Detailed instructions are available here.
How do I join Assault on the Reichstag on OTS?
Log in to any character, press ESC, open the “Assault on the Reichstag” tab, and click “Join Game”.
I found a bug, how can I report it?
Any issues discovered during testing can be reported to our Support: 
https://support.exbo.net/en
For your convenience, you can also refer to the guides:
• 
Creating and filing a ticket
• 
Bug report of the game mechanics
• 
Bug report of the game world map
• 
Bug report of another kind of bug
• 
Bug report of the game quest
Final Notes
We’re counting on your feedback and would really appreciate your participation in testing, as well as completing the in-game survey on OTS.

Among the thunder of tank shells and the whistle of bullets, fearless soldiers charge into one of the fiercest battles in history — the Assault on the Reichstag!
