Assault on the Reichstag season event
Berlin is crumbling under the thunder of artillery, while smoke rises above the burning Reichstag. In the edge of the final battles, you are about to enter a relentless fight. Try yourself in the role of a Red Army soldier or a Wehrmacht trooper: capture positions, wear down the enemy, call in reinforcements, and bring heavy artillery down on their heads.
How to play?
To participate in the event: Open the ESC menu, select Assault on the Reichstag from the top panel, and click Join game.
The event will be available from May 6 to June 3.
At the start of each match, you will be randomly assigned to one of two sides: attacking Red Army or defending Wehrmacht. Regardless of your side, you can choose from 4 classes:
• 
Assaulter
• 
Scout
• 
Engineer
• 
Machine Gunner
Each class comes with a base loadout: weapons, ammo, medical supplies, gadgets, and tactical support. Both sides have identical sets of gadgets and air support, except for the Scout class.
Gameplay
The assault consists of four stages:
• 
Capture 1st sector — point A
• 
Capture 2nd sector — points B, C
• 
Capture 3d sector — points D, E
• 
Capture the Reichstag — point F
The Red Army’s objective is to capture all points using a limited number of team respawns. The Wehrmacht’s objective is to stop them and deplete their respawns to zero.
Defenders can recapture points unless the entire sector has been taken. Once a sector is fully captured, defenders have 30 seconds to retreat before the next sector opens.
Infantry isn’t the only threat — heavy vehicles are present on the battlefield.
Ally vehicles can be repaired, but enemy tanks are extremely dangerous — better stay away from them. Use anti-tank weapons scattered across the map and don’t forget to call in tactical support.
Some environmental objects, such as windows and walls, can be destroyed.
Gadgets
Each class has unique abilities called Gadgets:
Medkit — an Assaulter class gadget. When deployed, it grants health regeneration to all players within a certain radius;
Sandbags — an Engineer class gadget that allows you to construct small but highly effective defensive structures;
Ammo Crate — a Machine Gunner class gadget is used to replenish consumables such as ammo and medicine;
Rally Point and Trip Wire Mine — Scout class gadgets. Rally Point creates a new spawn location for your squad, but keep in mind that respawns are limited. Trip Wire Mine is used to defend against advancing enemies.
Rally Point is available only to Red Army Scouts;
Trip Wire Mine is available only to Wehrmacht Scouts.
Tactical support
Each class has access to tactical support. To call it in, you need to accumulate enough tactical support points, equip the flare gun \, enter the required combination, and select a target area for the strike.

Class progression
Each class starts with a basic loadout that can be upgraded using Class XP and Free XP. As you progress, you will also unlock equipment from the enemy side.
Class XP — used to level up the class you played. The amount earned depends on your contribution to victory while playing that class.
Free XP — a currency earned at the end of each match. The amount depends directly on your total score in that match.
In addition to weapons, Free XP can also be used to upgrade character stats such as speed, durability, and stamina, as well as multipliers for Class XP, Free XP, Silver, and rubles earned per match.
XP multipliers from levelling multiple classes stack, so don’t limit yourself to upgrading just one class.

In addition to levelling up classes, free XP can be spent on purchasing personal crates.
Crates contain consumables (spare parts, tools, batteries, and etc.), paints, commemorative gear with modules, Hideout items, and, most importantly, equipment parts, including the Master-rank sniper rifle PzB 38!
Following weapons can be obtained using parts and a number of barter recourses:

You can also find motifs for the FN F2000 TACTICAL and AA-12 in these crates.
All items in the crates, including weapon parts, are temporarily bound. Once the event has ended on June 3, items can be transferred to other players or sold.
Silver Shop
Silver is an incredibly valuable currency that you receive at the end of a match. The amount of Silver you receive depends on your contribution to the victory during the battle.
With a Silver, you can purchase the boxes and their contents separately as individual items. You can also treat yourself with the Scars of War Hideout style here.
Assault on the Reichstag is an event based on session battles. So, in addition to everything listed above, you’ll also gain Session Battle XP and Battle Tokens for Spartak. However, the results of this event do not affect your session battle statistics in any way.
Hideout style
• 
The main room of the Hideout was updated, and large windows facing the outside were added.
• 
A new cosmetic system called Hideout Style is now available in the game, which changes the visual style, sound effects, and adds unique events.
• 
The first Scars of War thematic style was added, bound to the Assault on the Reichstag event.
The Scars of War style includes:
• 
Visual changes: burned-out tanks and an abandoned battlefield outside the window, ash in the air, and gloomy weather.
• 
Sound effects: the distant sound of battle in the background.
• 
Random events: recurrent artillery shelling, walls shaking, dust, and the sound of warning sirens.
•

• 
Manual start of events: You can start events within your Hideout manually by clicking the button on the central screen.
How to get it?
Scars of War can be obtained by earning Silver in the Assault on the Reichstag game mode or from the Aesthete’s Tank Case.
Scars of War obtained for Silver style is bound, while ones obtained from cases are tradeable.
How to use it?
First, you need to obtain the Hideout style, and then select it in the Laptop's interface.
New artefacts
New artefacts appear in the Zone: Link and Flicker. While scientists are still busy studying and collecting data, daring stalkers are already putting the Zone’s latest gifts to the test.
You can find them in the open world after eruptions, available until June 3.
Want to upgrade your build? Wait for the eruption and grab detectors while the Zone is generous with gifts.
Signal economy
Tangled signal
A new signal type has been added — Tangled signal, available for searching starting from the North.
Tangled signal creates several markers at once when detected.
Only at one of the Tangled signal points can appear either a Signal Dungeon or a bag with a tracker as a reward.

•

• 
Added Anomalous Dust as a possible reward from signals on North;
• 
Added data blocks as a possible reward from Signal Dungeons.
Relay Stations
• 
Added a new major barter item — Relay Stations. A Relay Station has a small chance to drop from signals, granting trackers.
Relay Stations work by analogy to Data Blocks, allowing you to transform them in 20 trackers of corresponding type.
An example of Relay Station
Stashes and Faction Cases changes
• 
Adjusted the contents and drop rates of items in stashes at the following locations: Serpentine, Black Detour, Mines, Institute, Forge-11, Barrier, Reflection, Inflow, Temple Swamp, Labyrinth, Lyubech-3, Stillwaters, Uranus Mill, and Red Forest.
• 
Adjusted stash loot value to better match the location difficulty.
• 
Improved faction crate contents — updated the item pool, their quantity, and drop rates.
• 
The average value of faction crates has been increased.
Act Tickets shop update
• 
All items that were sold for Act Tickets and located in the Gear tab are now available in the separate Act Tickets shop tab. Act Tickets items have also been removed from the Other tab.
• 
The Act Tickets shop can now only be accessed through the season pass window, by pressing the Act Tickets button in the top‑right corner, in the currency section.
Frontline Pack
In any battle, you can obtain trophies that keep the memory of your heroic deeds. This bundle includes Assault on the Reichstag event cases, from which you can obtain various Hideout decoration items, weapon blueprints from the event, and consumables.
Aesthete tank case
Some things reveal more about a soldier than his weapon ever could.
Tank cosmetics
Ever dreamed of getting your own tank? We’ve got something even better — Tanker! With him, the hangar of steel hunters is just a stone’s throw away… if you get what we mean.
Profile design
Did you feel the atmosphere of the intense assault? Transform your profile with two themed designs inspired by heavy machinery and the relentless assault on the Reichstag.
Personality
Terentiy sends his regards! The first personality has been added to the game — a new character customization element with its own unique traits.
Terentiy has his own voice — a unique set of phrases in the quick‑command wheel, plus a short story about his life, which he will gladly tell… if he can recall it.
Back to the Inside Out styles and motifs
The base price of the Back to the Inside Out season’s styles and motifs has been adjusted. They are now available for sale in a transferable version, and a discount has been added to their purchase until the end of the season.
Operations
Following the discovery of a critical vulnerability that allowed players to complete Operation Focus by unfair means, it has been removed from the current Operations ranking season. Changes to the Operation itself will be introduced in future updates.
We would like to thank the player who reported this issue to support team — they have received an in-game reward.
If you discover any bugs in the game mechanics or modes, please contact our support team.
Other Operations changes
• 
Fixed an issue where it was not possible to view player statistics from the friends list if they were not among the top players
• 
Fixed an issue where a negative clearance was incorrectly displayed in the player statistics window
• 
Fixed an issue where it was not possible to view the statistics for the top 250 players

Account security update
A new security feature for your account — Security Code.
This is an extra layer of security that will help protect your property even if a hacker gains access to your account.
You can enable the security feature in the settings in the Security tab.
There are two types of security to choose: Passcode and Authenticator Code.
• 
Passcode — a static 6-digit sequence 
• 
Code from the authenticator app
The code is requested in two situations, depending on the settings:
• 
When you enter the game from the character selection menu, if the “Require code on login” option has been enabled in the game settings.
• 
The first action that could harm the player character if a hacker gains access to it.
Actions that may harm your character if accessed by a scammer include:
• 
trading with other players;
• 
interacting with the auction;
• 
using in-game mail;
• 
selling items to the season vendor;
• 
any actions involving artefacts and other valuable items;
• 
any actions involving subdivision;
• 
attempting to leave a faction;
• 
trading operations with the gear merchant.
You only need to enter the security code once per gaming session.
Please note: once you disable this setting, the protection will remain active for a further 14 days.
To change the code type, you need to completely disable the current option.
Other changes and fixes
• 
Reduced player count requirements for all session-based maps on global servers.
The changes are region-based and may vary depending on the server.
For example, to start Prison you need:
RU: 12 players
EU: 8 players
NA, SEA, NEA: 6 players
• 
For NA, SEA, NEA regions: temporarily removed no shotguns Moria House version from the session map pool.
• 
Added a new screen mode: “Borderless Window” or compatibility mode. In this mode, Windows optimisations for full-screen mode are disabled. This may help with compatibility issues with HDR monitors or with “screen tearing”.
• 
Increased priority for the mini-map radar sound when players appear nearby. It shouldn’t be lost in the mix of other sounds anymore.
• 
Most weapon LODs have been updated — the models rendered at low levels of detail and from a distance.
• 
Added a separate setting to adjust the volume of the record player.
• 
Added new sound setting — anomaly alerts.
• 
The setting can be found in the sound settings tab.
• 
The closer the player is to the anomaly, the higher the pitch of the sound produced.
• 
If this setting is disabled, the player will not hear an audio notification when near an anomaly.
• 
Added the ability to toggle the setting using “;” hotkey.
• 
You can find the hotkey setting in the sound settings tab, next to the sound notification setting.
• 
The setting can be found in the Sound settings tab.
• 
Fixed an issue where the size of the smoke grenade cloud would change when adjusting the graphics settings.
• 
Fixed the “Primary mouse button” toggle in Windows settings (option for left-handed users).

Sources of Tickets
Season Pass is still the main source of income. Removed the element of chance in the form of Caskets. Players will now receive 2000 Tickets per season for completing 400 levels whilst holding an active Season Pass. Consequently, you can earn 8000 Tickets for the entire Act. However, this Act will also feature various activities where you can earn extra Tickets.
Activities will be divided into two types:
• 
For anyone interested, with simpler gameplay but fewer Tickets. They take place in autumn and spring.
• 
For those who aren't looking for the easy way out, with plenty of Tickets. They take place in winter and summer.
The first event of this kind is already planned for this autumn!
Exchange of parts for legendary gear
You can now trade parts of legendary gear that appeared in the same Act. You can now exchange legendary gear pieces obtained in the same Act. To do so, right-click the piece and select Transofrm. 
For example:
• 
Parts of the armour Albatross Heavy Assault Armored Exoskeleton suit and parts of the Gauss rifle can be swapped for one another.
• 
Parts of the Chitin backpack and parts of the ZIVCAS M2-C armour suit are replaceable.
In other words, you can swap one item for another from the same Act in which the gear first appeared in the Ticket Shop.
Ticket shop
In Act III, we will return master items in exchange for Act I Tickets, and we will also keep the offers from Act II.
In addition, new items will be added to the shop’s range during the Act.
Consequently, the range of products available at the Ticket shop will not change, but will simply be expanded to include new items.
Changes in prices of Ticket shop
In Act III, a new pricing policy for master gear will be applied using Tickets:
• 
Containers will not change in price and will cost 1500;
• 
Melee weapons — 1000;
• 
Sights — 500.
Selling gear for a third of its cost
Added the ability to sell master gear to the Fence for Tickets at a third of its full price.
An item can only be returned within the Act in which it was purchased.
New legendary pistol
The latest addition to the Act III Ticket shop is the legendary CR-72.
It can be obtained the same way as other legendary gear for Act Tickets, using 6/7/8 parts along with barter and rubles.
Attention!
The current Act Tickets system will not change significantly throughout the Act. However, new offers with Master rank gear may still be added to Act Ticket shop.
Changes that do not affect the total amount of Tickets received per season, store prices, or the overall game economy (such as redistributing the amount of Act Tickets across Season Pass levels) are also possible.
Act Tickets policy may change between Acts, including changes to prices, total amount, and distribution of Tickets, as Tickets are an economic entity specific to a particular Act and do not carry over between them.

Any gear part from previous seasons can now be purchased A part price is now 200 Act Tickets
The gear parts container now holds parts from previous seasons Price: 100 → 150 Tickets
Season gear obtaining changes
Previously it was possible to obtain 4 gear parts: from Special to Legendary quality. Now, crafting a season gear requires 5 Red parts instead of 4 different.
Some of the parts will be compensated:

1 Red part -> 2 Red parts;
• 
1 Golden part -> 3 Red parts
• 
Purple and blue parts will not fall under compensation. It is possible to sell the parts to the Fence NPC within a month.
Season Pass rewards changes
Special Case Token is now obtained at level 460 of the Season Pass, instead of 200 as it was previously.
Same amount of Act Tickets can be received at 100, 200, 300, and 400 levels accordingly. At the same time, a fixed amount of Act Tickets is obtained in the paid Season Pass version.

Revitalization of The Swamps
NPCs at Ataman's HQ and the boathouse have finally come to life — they got their own unique animations. Stalkers no longer stand around like statues — they look around, shift their weight, chat with one another, and go about their daily routines. The Zone feels more alive now because movement is life.
And this is only the beginning. Over time, we'll add high-quality animations to other locations as well, making NPCs throughout the Zone feel truly alive.
Guide update
The in-game Guide was fully reworked. Let's take a closer look at what's changed.
Updated visuals
You can find the new Guide in the upper-right corner of the ESC menu.
Information about game mechanics has been consolidated under the Instructions section, while items have been moved to the Codex tab.
This makes finding the information faster and more convenient.
Information Search
Besides browsing categories, you can now use the search bar to quickly find relevant information.
An automatic recommendation system for related articles has also been added, helping you explore topics in detail.
Articles are recommended based on the number of matching tags. For example, if you explore about progression and open an article on weapon upgrade, the system will suggest other articles tagged with “Character progression”. This allows you to seamlessly navigate to the Researcher article and learn more about artifact builds.
Items can now be examined directly in the Guide: view them from all angles and access almost all available information without opening external windows.
Terms
If you come across an unfamiliar characteristic or term in the Guide, you can hover over it and get a brief explanation.
And if you would like to learn more, just left-click to go to the page with full information.
In the item's characteristics list, you can hover over unfamiliar terms to get a short definition from the Guide or head straight to the corresponding article.
3D-faces
2D faces are a vestige of the past that no longer fit our current vision for the game's visual. It's time to move on and open the new chapter of STALCRAFT: X visuals.
First iteration
All skins have received unique 3D models, giving characters more individuality.
As part of the first iteration, lip-sync has also been implemented — now NPC dialogue lines are accompanied by synchronized speech animation, making interaction with the world even more lively.
Now skins differ not only by its textures, but by its silhouette as well.
Unfortunately, in progress of development some skins have undergone changes. For example, the Gift Snatcher has changed his appearance — from mutant his became in balaclava.
Try to find other changes like this!
Further plans
It's just first iteration, and then there are several more stages of development:
• 
Lip-sync for NPC's replicas in open world;
• 
Characters emotions (playable and NPC);
• 
Possibility to wear balaclavas on all skins (not soon);
• 
Voluminous models of accessories — about that in details below;
• 
And other upgrades that are so early talking about.
Unfortunately, due to the inability to remove visors and helmets, 3D accessory support on skins is temporarily unavailable.
For example, the Corporat skin will currently appear as a character wearing a balaclava without glasses.
As soon as it becomes possible to remove the suits' helmets, we will immediately start working on a 3D accessory system for skins.
Write your thoughts, and we will monitor the feedback and make changes as needed.

Heating rounds effectiveness against Combat armour was comparable to SBP rounds against Combo armour (while being significantly inferior against Combo and Scientist armour), and it additionally applied burning to the target.

Session battles changes
Duels
• 
The presets for the gear for duels was update. 
• 
In duel maps list was added Inferno and Hospital.
• 
Most equipment presets now use armor-piercing ammunition, except for the issued shotguns.
Session Battles
• 
Removed the Hospital Deathmatch, Wormhole, and Pripyat Streets maps, along with their variants. 
• 
Session Battles for the Stalker and Veteran ranks are now played on the Colosseum and Collapse maps, rotating every 30 minutes.
• 
Changed team spawn points on the Moria House map.
• 
Removed the capture point on the Hospital, Moria House, Inferno, and Glass maps — victory now requires reaching a fixed kill count. Map rotation has been added for these locations: Hospital and Inferno rotate every 10 minutes, while Moria House and Glass rotate every 15 minutes (the kill limit required for victory is not final and may be adjusted in the future).
• 
Added map rotation for GOST-17 Deathmatch and Glass Deathmatch — now they replace each other every 10 minutes.
• 
Added access to the personal storage inside the mobile camp in Subdivision Battles.
• 
All variants of the Flamethrower and Frostthrower no longer automatically replenish their magazines on kill in Session Battles.
In-game shop update
Pack chain
Do you want to get closer to the season's top rewards faster? The chain of special bundles includes Season pass levels, Overdrives, Tactical Stockpile crates, and the Control paint — everything you need for a strong start. 
Styles
True superiority starts before the first shot is fired. The Tactical superiority style set is designed for those who prefer their gear to look just as dangerous as its owner. If you favour strict tactics over flashy appearance, this set is sure to find a place in your arsenal.
Tank and Melted cosmetics, along with Ship motifs, will be available for purchase until the end of summer.
Other changes and fixes
• 
Changed the chunk loading mechanism. It is no longer possible for an enemy to shoot at you while being outside your loaded chunks. Now the list of chunks that can be visible from your current position is determined by that position and does not depend on your previous movement across the map.
• 
Updated AUG A3 model.
• 
Updated Houndmaster, Trapper, Hunter’s Cloak and Orion Jumpsuit models.
• 
The Drossel's resource box for Arsen can now only be purchased with rubles.
• 
Added reputation limit per day, which can be obtained by donating one type of resource. The limit is approximately 1000 reputation, but each resource has its own quantitative limit.
• 
Arsen also now accepts advanced and standard spare parts and tools on a permanent basis.
• 
Raincoat was deleted from barter. Now its position in the barter is taken by the Cloak-Tent.
• 
Fixed missing texture on F2000.
• 
Removed zeroes from the ZIVCAS M2-C exoskeleton.
• 
All styles for the Desert Eagle are now also available for the Big Bill.
• 
In the death screen, you can now view the name of the equipment without the style/motif.
• 
The weapon no longer increases in height to 3 slots when installing 45-round magazines and the ACOG sight.
• 
Adjusted the spawn of quest сaches in the factional North.
• 
Adjusted the Morse code for tangled signals: you can now distinguish the dungeon signal from others.
• 
Your own pack can now be added to the trash independently of other packs.
• 
All artefact build stats are now applied only after the build is fully equipped.
• 
The Trampoline anomaly now activates the laceration reaction again.
• 
Now, after collecting anomalous crystals or pulp, a collection mark remains in their place for a while – a plant without pulp or branches/stumps without crystals.
• 
Reduced the weight of the Core Inhibitor item from 10g to 1g.
• 
Fixed multiple translation inconsistency bugs across all languages.
• 
Corrected several minor localization bugs in all languages.

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [17.06.2026]
historical_patches.text:
Lots of small details change the appearance of the Exclusion Zone, sometimes beyond recognition. Some things you will see a little later, but most of the changes you will see right here and right now.
Content
● Hot week
● Updated lighting
● South locations changes
● Voiceover update
● Wild North adjustments
● Subdivision Battles changes
● The Mushroom Epic
● Chat rework
● Season Pack #1
● Other
Hot week
A hot week is ahead which brings the following:
● Increased prices of some mutant parts by x2.
● Increased the spawn rate of mutants, pulp, grass, and crystals by 20% in the Labyrinth, Wild North, and faction North zones.
● Reduced announcment board daily quests reset time to 6 hours.
● Reduced time between North outpost activations.
Updated lighting
New lighting has been added to the Zone, significantly changing the visual feel of locations: adding depth, a different atmosphere, and making light look more dynamic.
This is an optional graphical feature. It can be enabled or disabled in graphics settings in Light sources.
At the moment, the updated lighting is enabled on the following locations:
● South Zone;
● Wild North;
● All Safe Zones;
● Main story dungeons.
Game performance and plans
The new lighting system significantly impacts performance and may noticeably reduce FPS, especially on weaker PCs. If you experience drops, simply disable the option.
The new lighting will not yet appear on other Zone locations. Why?
We are currently collecting performance data, defining target metrics, and shaping a general approach to optimizing the system across locations. We are also taking your feedback on the visual quality into account.
In the future, we plan to gradually roll out the new lighting to other locations in upcoming updates, based on the above.
South locations changes
Visual and gameplay changes have been made to the following locations:
● Swamps;
● Kolos Agrocomplex;
● Black Willows;
● Scrapyard.
Mechanics updates
● Adjusted the location and strength of infections;
● Ghouls and Skitters can now be encountered in these locations;
● Changed location of open world events;
● Recalculated reward economy for clearing-out events;
● Added Supply Point events and a gold event with NPCs;
● Partially added animations for events.
South dungeons changes
Beast Lair
● Changed the dungeon entrance locations at Kolos Agrocomplex and Black Willows;
● Added visual style for the Inside Out;
● Partially modified the level design;
● Removed the intermediate location required to access the dungeon;
● Changed the encountered enemies before the Beast;
● Added a short boss fight with the Beast.
Clash
● Updated the map to reflect visual changes of the Pervomaysky Factory;
● Recalculated the NPC balance inside the dungeon.
Nightmare 2
● Removed the stealth run episode from the dungeon.
● Removed the stealth segment from the dungeon.
Voice-over update
● Added English voice-over for the South storyline. Please note that it is currently in development and will be improved in the future.
● Added English voice-over for announcer.
● Added a separate voice-over language setting.
Wild North adjustments
● Reduced player pursuit distance by 10 metres in all events.
● Changed the number of Murmur Antenna at location: 4 -> 3.
● Increased the time before new Murmur Antennas appear at the location.
● Reduced the maximum number of Ghoul Den events in the swamps of Uranus Mill.
● Increased time until new Ghoul Den events appear in the swamps of Uranus Mill.
Murmur Camps and Squads
● Reduced the maximum number of events in the Wild North locations.
● Increased the respawn time for new Murmur Squad and Murmur Camp.
● Increased respawn time for the Stare and Gaze Murmur NPCs.
● Significantly reduced damage from drone explosions.
● Significantly reduced the slowdown effect caused by TVs landing on players.
Subdivision Battles changes
● Reduced maximum number of participants in Subdivision Battles for EU and NA regions to 25 players. The maximum number of players in subdivision remained uncanged (max 35 players).
● Respawn invisibility no longer applies to players in Session battles.
● Player stats in Glass Deatmatch now match those in GOST-17 Deathmatch.
● Reduced the number of kills required to win in Team Battles from 100 to 75.
The Mushroom Epic
Seems like Terentiy remembered the next part of his chronicle. He will get in touch with you as soon as you find yourself… somewhere. If he will remember your face at all...
Chat rework
● The default channel is now the radius chat (60 metres), and the location chat has been moved to the second tab.
● In the location chat, messages from all factions are now visible in safe zones. In the South Zone, messages from players of the native faction (Stalkers/Bandits) are visible. In the North Zone, Lyubech-3 and the Wild North, only messages from your own faction are visible.
● Messages sent via the radius chat now appear above players.
● Updated chat nickname colours. The names of allies and enemies in the chat are now distinguishable.
Season Pack #1
The first pack of the season has arrived in the shop – with this, you can brave the radiation zones and gallop right through them! It’s true, but only once…
Other changes and fixes
● Players on your in-game blacklist will no longer appear when you search for a game in Operations.
● Added lipsync for players whilst using voice chat.
● To gain instant access to loot from a defeated enemy, you must now deal at least 30% of the damage — damage from anomalies, mutants and external sources is no longer counted. Furthermore, the list of loot applicants now includes those who dealt damage to a target whilst it was critically wounded.
● Expanded the functionality of security codes for duelling and character deletion.
● The required currency is now displayed in collection tasks.
● In safe zones, messages from any faction are visible. In the South Zone, you can see messages from your original faction (Stalkers/Bandits). In the North Zone, Lyubech-3 and the Wild North, you can only see messages from your own faction.
● It is now not possible to mark an enemy located within the area affected by smoke or gas grenades, or behind them.
● Updated the model of the Fleece protective suit.
● Added display of damage reduction based on distance for explosives.
● Airdrop now kills players inside it once collision is enabled.

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [24.06.2026]
historical_patches.text:
Contents
• 
Spartak’s Calibers
• 
SSPP contracts
• 
Changing the start of the game
• 
Event pack
Spartak’s Calibers
From June 24 to July 1, during the Spartak's Skirmish event, a temporary Spartak’s Calibers session mode will run.
We invite you to test the balance changes to the ammunition types that have been assigned to the specialisation sets: Armor-piercing, Explosive, Expanding, witch high Stopping power, etc. This will enable us to test the changes and collect the necessary data.
Session mode is played using pre-set equipment: armour and weapons are issued.
SSPP contracts
SSPP is seeking volunteers to carry out combat missions on a contract basis.
Contracts are issued daily from June 24 to August 19. For successfully completing their tasks, volunteers are entitled a cash bounty, a special currency, and the chance to receive tips on the locations of SSPP stashes.
There’s no time to waste – get started right now!
This event is available to all players who have completed the South storyline and joined the North faction.
How to get contracts
• 
A representative of the SSPP, Major Kaganovich, is located at each of the northern faction bases, as well as at Drunken Geiger Bar. He offers contracts of varying difficulty involving clearing up events in the open world and eliminating mutants.
• 
Only one contract can be active at a time. The new one will become available once the current one has been completed or has failed.
• 
One free contract of each difficulty level is available every day. Additional contracts can be obtained for rubles.
• 
You are allowed one attempt to complete the task. If you die, the contract is failed, but you can attempt it again for the same fee.
• 
The reward is sent to your mail immediately after you complete the task.
• 
The letter contains Receipts and the chance to receive a Lead.
Receipts are the event’s currency, which can be spent in the Event Hub shop.
Leads
There are four difficulty levels available for contracts in total, including the Wild North missions. The higher the level, the more dangerous it is, but the greater the chance of getting a Lead.
Lead is encrypted data that indicates the location of a SSPP stash.
To decipher them, you’ll need to consult a mechanic.
Leads are not bound, so they can be sold.
There are several types of Leads:
 | 
Basic Lead
 | 
Valuable Lead
 | 
Secret Lead
 | 
Operatiopnal Lead for Lyubech-3
 | 
Intelligence Lead for the Radar
 | 
Intelligence Lead for Uranus Mill
 | 
Intelligence Lead for Stillwaters
SSPP Stockpiles
SSPP Stockpiles are stashes left across the North. They contain various rewards: Receipts, consumables, craft items, barter resources and loot for selling.
• 
Stockpile waypoints appear on a map after you decipher the lead.
• 
Stash can only be opened by those who have deciphered the relevant Lead.
• 
You can decipher several Leads at the same time, but each stash is only available for 30 minutes from the moment it appears.
Challenges
Complete the event challenges to earn even more Receipts and Season Pass points.
Event shop
Receipts can be spent in the event shop on a variety of consumables and a Special Case token.
Limits on the purchase of Anomalous Serum are updated daily.
Changing the start of the game
We spent several months testing the new tutorial — the results were excellent. Therefore, we are updating the starting part of the game for all players.
What has changed:
ChNPP
• 
The storyline has been updated to reflect the latest events in the world of STALZONE.
• 
Location has been completely redesigned.
• 
Added two new CGI cutscenes.
Swamps tutorial
This part has already been tested by a bunch of players — it’s now available to everyone in the final version.
• 
Changed Linden's storyline.
• 
Added the option to skip this section.
• 
Visually updated the tutorial dungeon.
New Swamps quests
Two new characters, Onion and Stump, have been added in place of Linden.
Several story quests have been added prior to the encounter with the Ataman or Saint.
Added some short side quests and tutorial missions to help you understand the game’s core mechanics.
Event pack
Contract work rarely gets by without additional supplies. For volunteers willing to take on the most challenging tasks, the SSPP has put together a special pack containing useful resources and a supply of Receipts.
Pack includes:
• 
10 Season Pass Levels;
• 
10 000 Receipts;
• 
10 Overdrives;
• 
5 Strategic Reserves.
It can be purchased 10 times. Discount applies only to the first and second purchase.
Other
• 
Adjusted respawn boundaries on the Moria House map.
• 
Fixed incorrect behavior of the burning, bleeding, and stopping power status effects.

Changes to the Subdisivion Battles ranking system
The formation of pairs in brackets
When the pairs are drawn in the first stage, the 8 teams will be divided into 2 groups: top 4 in the rankings and bottom 4 in the rankings. The pairings for the first stage are drawn at random on a best-vs-worst basis.
Protection against repeat encounters
From the second and third rounds onwards, the system will automatically avoid pairing teams that have already faced each other in this tournament. You won’t play the same opponent twice in a single bracket.
Changes to the rating calculation
Instead of a linear formula based on the difference in ratings, we are introducing a comprehensive approach based on the Theoretical (TWR) and Factual (FWR) win rates.
Theoretical Win Rate (TWR): The system calculates the mathematical probability of your victory based on your current rating and your opponent’s rating, taking into account the elasticity of the curve resulting from rating volatility across different divisions (the stronger the division, the lower the volatility).
Factual Win Rate (FWR): If you have played a specific opponent five or more times in Tournaments, the system takes into account your actual wins and losses against each other over the last 10 matches. The system does not take into account matches played outside of ranking seasons or in other modes.
Expected Win Rate (EWR): The system calculates the arithmetic mean of the expected values (TWR) and the actual historical data (FWR) to produce a fair value for the rating gained and lost.
Deactivating the boost system
The multiplier (1.25, 1.5, 1.75) applied to the rating earned for a 3-0 victory has been disabled.
The kill-death ratio in Session Battles is now calculated based on the last 50 games, with the earliest match having the least impact on it and the most recent match having the greatest.

Triumphs & Faction Race
The game’s birthday is in a couple of days, which means it’s time to celebrate this significant event! Two time-limited events are kicking off in the game at once, where you can earn valuable rewards for completing simple tasks, and for the most dedicated players, we’ve prepared a special achievement and a profile theme!
Triumphs and Faction Race events will take place from July 8 to August 5.
What are Triumphs?
Triumphs are a series of simple challenges that players complete over the course of a year — starting from the completion of the previous Triumphs, that is, from August 13, 2025, to the present day. To collect all 10 Pops' coins, you need to:
• 
complete 1 compulsory challenge;
• 
complete 5 simple challenges of your choice;
• 
complete 4 complex challenges of your choice.
For completing any 10 challenges, you’ll receive the Trailblazer Statue, and for completing 30 out of 36 Triumphs, you’ll receive a commemorative achievement with the title “Bro... what have I become?” and a profile background:
Faction Race event
To take part in the‘Faction Race event, you simply need to complete 3 Triumphs and be a member of a nothern faction.
Basically, the event involves players from the four northern factions competing against one another based on the number of Triumphs they have achieved. Every faction has a chance of winning, as a faction’s points depend in a specific way on the number of Triumphs achieved by its members and on the overall balance of the factions. The calculation is based on the following formula: ∑ number of wins for each player / (number of active players × 10) × 100%. Therefore, this levels the playing field between the largest and the smallest factions.
All players who take part in the event are guaranteed to receive an extra Pops' coin, as well as a commemorative Faction Race sticker.
Members of the winning faction will receive the unique Triumphator motif for Albatross Heavy Assault Armored Exoskeleton and ZIVCAS M2-C:
Triumphs 2026 shop range

•

And there’s also the unique Trailblazer motif: it can be used on the Albatross Heavy Assault Armored Exoskeleton and the ZIVCAS M2-C Armoured Suit, and it’s also compatible with Nord Group Guardian, Nord-22 Group Guardian style and the Herdsman styles!

Once the event has ended, on August 5, you will be able to spend the coins you have collected or those you have received via a promo code. Once the event ends, you will be able to claim a reward for completing 30 Triumphs, but you will not be able to claim coins for completing the first 10 Triumphs.
Years of Service promo code
Pops hasn’t forgotten his loyal players: the earlier you registered your account, the more Pops' coins you’ll receive: one year of registration equals one coin! Pops has also made sure to take care of players who want to level up a new character, so the promo code can be redeemed an unlimited number of times on a single account.

Promo code is valid until 02.09.2026
Subticks
We’ve updated how player input is processed. Shots, clicks, and UI button presses are now handled within the same frame, which should make gunfights feel more responsive and consistent.
What’s new:
• 
Removed random shot delay
Previously, each shot could be affected by a random delay of up to 50 ms due to tickrate dependency. This issue has been fixed: shots are now processed instantly, without any added delay.
• 
More accurate hit registration
In the past, a target’s hitboxes at the moment of firing didn’t always match what players saw on screen. This could cause shots to register based on the target’s future position. Hitbox alignment is now more precise, resulting in more reliable hit registration.
• 
Rate of fire now works as intended
Previously, in situations where players fired at the same time, the advantage could go to whoever connected to the server earlier rather than the weapon with the higher rate of fire. Now, under equal conditions, weapons with higher fire rates correctly have the advantage.
If both players have the same rate of fire, priority is given to the one who started shooting first even if both shots occur within the same tick.
• 
Camera sway during aiming has been refined and now feels smoother.
Golden tickets
Friends!
It’s a tradition to give gifts on a birthday. And over the years, we’ve built our own tradition: on July 10, STALZONE’s birthday, we thank the top 50 supporters of the project and reward them with Golden Tickets.
Previously, Golden Tickets consisted of two parts: an in-game reward and collectible items delivered to players in real life.
We understand how valuable such gifts can be. They are not just items, but a reminder of your involvement and support for the project.
Unfortunately, these past years, sending physical gifts outside of Russia has become significantly more difficult. International logistics remain unstable: restrictions, customs procedures, and delivery regulations vary from country to country. This is why we still haven’t been able to deliver collectible sets from previous years to all Global players.
We don’t want to make promises that we cannot guarantee we’ll fulfill. That’s why, starting this year, we are changing the reward format for Global players: if we are unable to deliver the collectible set to the provided address, you will receive a unique in-game reward instead.
Please note: if you play on the Global region but currently live in Russia or CIS countries where delivery is available, you will still be able to receive the physical gift.
How to receive your reward
The Golden Ticket will be sent to your in-game mail on July 10.
After receiving it, visit Viv NPC. He will give you the first part of the reward and provide information about the questionnaire.
The questionnaire for receiving the second part of the reward will become available on the website stalzone.com. You must complete it by June 1, 2027.
• 
If delivery to the provided address is possible, you will receive the collectible gift set instead of the in-game reward.
• 
If we are unable to deliver to the provided address, the in-game reward will be sent to your in-game mail.
We understand that an in-game gift cannot fully replace a physical collectible set, but we want to preserve the value of the reward and make it truly special.
About the 10th and 11th Year Rewards
We would also like to address the situation with the rewards for the 10th and 11th anniversaries. Since these gifts were already promised, we will continue looking for ways to deliver them.
However, we want to be transparent: even if we manage to arrange delivery, there is still a possibility that some packages may not reach their recipients due to restrictions in certain countries.
If sending the physical gift for the 10th or 11th anniversary turns out to be impossible, we will provide compensation in the form of the 12th anniversary in-game reward.
We sincerely hope that in the future we will once again be able to delight Global players with physical gifts. However, right now, it is more important for us to choose a format where every winner is guaranteed to receive their reward instead of waiting for a package whose delivery depends on external circumstances.
Thank you for supporting STALZONE. We will continue working to develop the game, bring you new content, and find new ways to show our appreciation to the community.
Important: Beware of scammers!
• 
We will only contact you from delivery@exbo.ru or via the phone number provided in the questionnaire.
• 
Never share your account details with anyone.
• 
All expenses, including delivery costs, are fully covered by EXBO.
• 
If you have any doubts, contact Technical Support https://support.exbo.net/en.
• 
Gift transfers are only possible within the same account. If the ticket was sent to the wrong character, Technical Support will perform a one-time transfer.
*Transfers to third-party accounts are not available.
You can give Viv the Golden Ticket for the 12th anniversary and complete the questionnaire until June 1, 2027, 21:00 (UTC).
Rewards
By giving the Golden Ticket to Viv, you will receive:
• 
Premium 180 days — 2 pcs.

All items are bound.
As for the second part, If we are unable to deliver the physical prize, the in-game reward will be sent to your in-game mail. This year, Global players will receive unique items: special Hideout decoration and a melee weapon.
Rat in a Wheel — a personal pet for your Hideout. It can perform 4 actions: eat, sleep, run in a wheel and… one more secret state.

These rewards will be sent to you via in-game mail after your questionnaire has been reviewed.
Thank you!
Thank you for supporting our game. We will continue doing our best to bring you new content and improvements.

A special feature is the integrated round counter, which allows you to always know how many rounds you have left without having to take your eyes off the action. historical_patches.title: STALZONE - 12 Years in the Zone!
historical_patches.text:
Today, our shared, cozy, and still slightly crooked Chernobyl Zone turns 12.
12 years, damn.
Over this time, the game has changed its name twice and survived seven distinct development stages. Each stage felt completely different and raised its own generation of players, each with their own memes, legends, grudges, stories, and curses aimed at the balance and economy.
Honestly, every year here is different from the previous. One minute we’re getting an earthquake over the latest season update, then shotguns suddenly become OP, then out of nowhere we get an unexpectedly good patch - and right after that, there’s a brand-new reason for everyone to start shaking again. And there's something beautiful about that. This soup never stops boiling or cools down, just like that legendary perpetual soup in Bangkok.
We actually have a lot in common with that soup. For years, we’ve been adding new ingredients on top without cleaning the pot or throwing out the old contents. On one hand, this undeniably gave the game a unique, one-of-a-kind flavor. On the other hand, for most of its existence, development has been a creative chaos without a single direction, vision, or plan.
Many veteran players often say the game itself doesn't know what it wants to be. And the main catch is that what STALZONE might want to become simply doesn't exist in game dev. Any attempt to limit it into the familiar categories of an extraction shooter, MMO shooter, or MMORPG risks losing that very identity that was born from countless trial and error, fixing mistakes, solving old problems, and creating new ones.
Maybe it’s not even a bad thing that we still can’t give a definitive answer to what this game wants to be. It’s like asking a person: "Who are you?" Every year, the answer will be different.
The game is shaped by both external and internal factors: frustrations and wishes of the players, the growing experience of veteran devs, fresh ideas from the new ones, tech upgrades, and opportunities for mechanics we never even considered before.
But as fun as it is to work in creative chaos, the painful realization that we can't keep living like this has been building up for a long time. We needed a clear development plan and vision for at least a year or two ahead.
After a long preparation and a transition period, this summer EXBO has finally transformed from an organizational structure resembling a market bazaar to a more meaningful division into dedicated workstreams. Now, separate teams are responsible for different areas of the game, staffed with specialists from all the key development disciplines, so they can properly guide their part of the game from idea to execution.
No more running around the office with your hand out, begging for time and resources and crowding in line, but rather calmly doing your job and taking responsibility for it.
There will still be lines, of course, we’re far from full team autonomy, and some dev departments still function as internal services supporting multiple workstreams, remaining a bottleneck in places. But now it’s at least not a chaotic crowd around a single campfire, but a more organized system where it’s clear who is responsible for what, where the bottlenecks are, and what needs to be scaled up next.
We’ve already buzzed your ears with this on the streams: onboarding, core, live-service, endgame, and monetization are now developed by partially autonomous teams. They can move the game forward more evenly, without elbowing each other fighting over resources. Sure, there are still bottlenecks and not all dev departments are organized into streams yet, but that will be sorted out over time.
Our main goal now is to eliminate bottlenecks, increase autonomy, and improve long-term planning for at least a year ahead so it doesn't crumble under spontaneous decisions and ambitions.
So yeah, after 12 years in game dev, we’ve finally arrived at these groundbreaking solutions. Took us long enough - but hey, the important thing is we got there. Now wish us a happy birthday!
By the end of this year, you will definitely feel the changes. Updates will become more meaningful, and we’re going to focus on the game's pain points that everyone is already sick and tired of. 
We want the Zone to keep changing, keep evolving, and leaving no one indifferent.
Thank you to everyone who stays with us. Everyone writing posts. Everyone just playing. Everyone watching streams and our office videos. To everyone who genuinely wants to see the game get better and patiently keeps sharing their feedback with us developers, again and again, even when we don’t get it the first time.
Happy birthday to all of us!
With love,
ZIV

● Barter tree update
● Advanced case
● Other changes and fixes
Photo mode
Photo mode has been added to the game. By default, you can access it by pressing the F4 key.
Camera settings available:
● Zoom from 1.00× to 8.00×
● 360° Roll
● Movement speed setting from 1.00× to 0.00×
● Grid
● 12 styled camera presets (VHS, Lo-Fi, Bodycam, Damaged Bodycam, Found Footage, Cheap Digital Camera, Disposable Film, STALRUNNER 2049, vaporwave, Noir, Sepia, CCTV) + 1 standard preset
When photo mode is activated, the player's weapon is holstered, and all HUD elements, on-screen indicators for infection, suppression, critical injury, and cold, as well as the first-person view of the player's hands and body, are hidden.
In photo mode, you can optionally draw your weapon from its holster. In this case, the character is displayed in first-person view again, and zooming is disabled.
You can also hide the photo mode interface by pressing the F1 key or disable it in the general HUD display settings.
In screenshots taken in photo mode, the photo mode interface and the rule-of-thirds grid are not displayed — there is no need to hide them manually before taking a photo.
This is the first iteration of the photo mode. Based on your feedback, we'll continue to improve it by adding new settings and presets and expanding its functionality. Share your thoughts — every opinion matters to us!
Smooth camera
Smooth camera (previously known as the cinematic camera) has been redesigned.
There is now a separate “Smooth camera” section in the game settings where you can adjust the responsiveness and the intensity of mouse movement smoothing at the start and end of a turn.
For those who prefer the old logic, there is an option to revert to the previous version. However, in this case, the new smoothing settings are no longer available.
Other
● Removed the old feature that hid the hands using the Ctrl+F1 shortcut due to the addition of a full-featured photo mode.
● Key bindings for screenshots, hiding the HUD, and the smooth camera have been moved to the controls section.
● A new Photo mode section has appeared in the control settings, where you can assign all the keys used in this mode. When photo mode is active, these keys are given higher priority, and all other actions assigned to them are temporarily ignored.
Barter tree update
Added K2 and K2C1 to barter tree.
Advanced case
Good news for those waiting for updates to the Advanced Case, here they are!
You can check out the updated contents below:
• 
ZIVCAS Sisyphus-6
• 
FN Five-seveN
Other changes and fixes
● Added the ability to convert FAMAS G2 and Glock 18X parts.
● Related records can once again be found in the home territories of the Northern factions.
● Fixed incorrect sounds for bolts with particles.
● When refreshing cards in the Personal Shop, offers with the same item will no longer appear.

historical_patches.title: Module and Quasi-Destructors rework
historical_patches.text:
Not too long ago we announced a rework of the Module mechanics, we promised to come back with details, so here they are.
Just to remind you how it will work 
• Removal only in safe zones. In order to take a module off a gun and put it on a different one, you need to be inside a safezone. The process works similarly to attachments: quick, free and without any unnecessary fuss. 
• Tradable modules. In order to sell a module you own, you need to use a Quasi-Destructor. Use it on a detached module in order to unbind it. This will let you list it on the auction.
How will Quasi-Destructors change? Because of the change in their mechanics, the range of applications for this item will narrow. In order to keep them valuable, we will make them harder to obtain: • We will raise the Quasi-Destructor price in the shop for season currency. 
• We will reduce the Quasi-Destructor price in the shop for Stalcoins. 
• The drop rate for Quasi-Destructors in operations will be reduced.
When will this happen? The new module mechancs and updated Quasi-Destructors will be released on 22.07.2026.

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [22.07.2026]
historical_patches.text:
Contents
• 
New mode: Coliseum
• 
Operations adjustments
• 
Session Battles changes
• 
Guide
• 
Balance adjustments
• 
Other changes and fixes
New mode: Coliseum 
Coliseum — new team-based PvP mode featuring 4 teams of 3 players each. Your objective is to capture batteries, charge installations and eliminate enemy squads using your class’s unique abilities.
In this mode, there are three classes (based on the Operations concept). The class is assigned automatically depending on the equipped armour:
• 
Assault — combat armour;
• 
Operative — combo armour;
• 
Support — scientist armour.
Each class has a passive ability and a set of active abilities that depend on the specialization selected before the match.
Before the match starts, equip armour of the desired class and choose one of two available specializations. Each specialization includes 3 unique active abilities. This choice cannot be changed during the match, and passive abilities remain fixed for each class.
To win, your team must earn the highest number of points across four rounds. Points are awarded for capturing the battery, charging the installation, getting kills, and eliminating enemy squads. Be careful: a full squad wipe will deduct a part of your team’s accumulated points.
How to start playing?
Select the Coliseum mode in Session Battles. To access this mode, you need Bar level 3.
The Coliseum mode has replaced Subdivision Battles, so access to Clan Wars is now available through the Subdivision section.
After selecting your class and specialization, you can choose from two game modes:
• 
Free play
• 
Fair fight
Free play — is a match played with your own gear.
Fair fight — is a preset loadout mode designed to let players try the mode on equal gear.

Choose the mode you’re interested in and press the Play button to start matchmaking.
Please note: Ranked mode will be launched later. We will announce its release additionally.
How to play?
At the start of the match, four teams spawn in different parts of the map.
• 
Rift activation. The process takes 20 seconds. The team that initiates the capture immediately receives 500 points.
• 
Battery Delivery. When the timer ends, a battery appears from the rift. Pick it up and deliver it to the installation. 
Note: a player carrying the battery cannot shoot or use abilities that require interaction with equipment.
• 
Protection of the installation. The charging process lasts 2 minutes. During this time, prevent enemies from taking control. The squad holding the installation at the end of the process receives the full score.
Interaction with the environment
Special charges are scattered across the map. They can be picked up and thrown at enemies or shot to trigger them remotely. Any action performed while holding a weapon will simply throw the charge without activating it.
Med Barrel
Blast Barrel
Smoke Barrel
Gravity Barrel
Speed Barrel
Destructible objects are also placed throughout the map, creating additional space for maneuvering. A sledgehammer is the most effective tool for destroying walls and ceilings, while standard windows can be broken with a knife strike or a shot.
Updated first-aid kit
In Coliseum mode, healing mechanics have been changed: first-aid kits now feature a full-use animation, different from the standard game behavior.
A first-aid kit can be used when your HP is below 100%. Once it reaches 100%, it stops automatically.
Match Rewards 
At the end of the match you receive session battle rewards: Spartak reputation, combat tokens, and placement rewards. Regardless of the match outcome, the durability of equipment and artifacts in your loadout will be reduced.
Quest Ten Breadcrumbs
Phil asks you to help investigate a strange signal that appeared on Forge-11. He believes it may be the key to another Area, but it remains unknown what discoveries this investigation will lead to. 
The quest becomes available after gaining access to the Wild North and completing the following quests: In the Nameless Deep for Rise, Point of No Return for Mercenaries, Vodovorot for Frontier, and Leviathan for Covenant. 
Coliseum сhallenges
Season Pass missions will become available with the start of the ranked season — this ensures a fair calculation of rewards for their completion.
All players who actively played in the Coliseum before the start of the ranked season will receive compensatory Season Pass points.
Operations adjustments
General changes
• 
Fixed numerous minor environment issues that disrupted the logic of completing Operations.
• 
Changed the mechanics of Quasi-Destructors. The item is now used to unbound a module so it can be sold at auction.
• 
Quasi-destructors are no longer needed to remove modules.
• 
Clearance level no longer increases if the Operation timer requirement is not met. Previously, it increased when completing an Operation at a higher clearance level even if the timer ran out.
• 
Added a brief incoming damage reduction effect after recovering from a critical wound.
• 
Fixed incorrect class icon display in the squad interface.
• 
Removed the Medical Locker collision.
The Big Clean Up 
• 
When restarting the stage in the Photon Generator Power Supply objective, the initial enemy waves will now respawn.
Focus
• 
Fixed incorrect work of Provocation ability during Laser Incision stage.
• 
Expanded the safe zone in Anomaly Escort and Storm stages.
Sea of Exclusion
• 
Decoration and symbol randomization now occurs every session (previously once per week).
• 
Fixed incorrect Provocation ability behaviour during Battleship, Assault on the Cruiser and Tech stages.
• 
Expanded the safe zone in Tech stage.
• 
Added a delay before Murmur Puppeteer summons drones for the first time.
Session Battles changes
Vampirism and reload on kill rework
Killing enemies no longer affects health restoration or weapon reload. These characteristics now depend on your share of damage dealt to the target.
Only damage dealt within the last 3 seconds counts. Players must contribute at least 20% of the damage to be included in the calculation. This mechanic is disabled on Collapse and Transit maps.
Kill credit in stats
If a player deals more than 75% of a target’s total health as damage within the last 3 seconds, but another player finishes the target, it will count as an “assist equal to a kill.” In this case, the player receives +1 kill in their stats and number of points equal to the base kill score multiplied by their damage percentage.
Example: if a player deals 87% damage and the base kill reward is 100 points, they will receive 87 points labeled ““assist equal to a kill,” along with the defeated player’s icon.
Invulnerability changes
After respawning, a player is invulnerable only while inside their spawn region. This invulnerability has no timer and lasts until the first action that cancels it.
Invulnerability is removed when:
• 
firing a weapon;
• 
throwing a grenade;
• 
dealing damage to another player (including melee);
• 
leaving the spawn region.
Once removed, invulnerability does not return upon re-entering the spawn region. It is granted again only after the next respawn.
Guide
Items comparison
You can now compare items directly in the Guide.
To do this, add the items you need to the comparison from the Codex by pressing E.
After that, click the corresponding button in the top-right corner of the interface. The number on it shows how many items you’ve added to the comparison.
Table features:
• 
The table takes the equipment modification level into account
• 
The table accounts for attachments that can be equipped on weapons
• 
You can customize which stats are displayed in the table, or enable the “Differences only“ filter. In this mode, the table hides stats that have identical values across all selected items.
Create your own top lists by rearranging items within the table.

Added pictures to some popular articles.

historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [29.07.2026]
historical_patches.text:
Contents
• 
Coliseum adjustments
• 
Modules changes
• 
Other changes and fixes
Coliseum adjustments
NA, NEA, SEA 
To resolve matchmaking issues and prevent matches from failing to start due to a low player count in the NA, NEA, and SEA regions, we have implemented the following changes:
• 
disabled the option to start Free Play mode;
• 
increased rewards for playing in the Fair Fight mode.
General changes
• 
Increased penalty for completely wiping out a squad from 10% to 15% of command points.
• 
Reduced throw force in antigravity fields.
• 
Antigravity barrels now also accelerate flying bullets by 50% (similar to the Tank's ability grenades).
• 
Reduced damage dealt by explosive barrels from 310 to 250.
• 
Reduced blast radius of explosive barrels from 3 to 1 meter. The total radius and minimum damage have not changed.
• 
Added new mode statistics: overall and current K/D ratio, games played, wins, kills, deaths, rifts captured, batteries deployed, installations charged, enemies detected, combat points, support points, objective points, and player respawns.
• 
Fixed an issue that allowed players to bring grenades into a match.
• 
Toggleable items are now reset to their default state at the end of the round.
• 
Disabled the ability to open the inventory in the mode.
Tank
• 
Reduced the Self-Destruc ability's full-damage radius from 5 to 3 meters.
• 
Reduced the Stimulator's speed bonus from 50% to 40%.
• 
The recharge time for the Stimulator has been increased from 25 to 35 seconds.
• 
The item's animation no longer plays when the High Gravity Aura ability is activated.
Phantom
• 
Interaction with the Installation and the revival marker is prohibited while the player is in another dimension.
• 
Updated visual effect for a cluster grenade explosion.
• 
Stasis anomaly now kills a player who is under the effect of the Escape to the Inside Out ability.
Specialist
• 
The number of Tranquilizer rounds has been reduced from three to two.
• 
The recharge time has been increased from 8 to 10 seconds.
• 
A hit from the Tranquilizer now also marks the enemy with a scanner for 1 second.
• 
Reduced damage from Psionic Mine from 200 to 125.
• 
The mine's blast radius has been increased from 3 to 4 meters.
• 
The maximum number of mines that can be deployed at one time has been reduced from three to two.
Matchmaking
• 
On the NA, SEA, and NEA servers, players and groups of up to three people now share a common queue. The separate queue for groups of three players has been disabled.
• 
When a player joins a queue, they and their party members are automatically removed from other matchmaking queues and the preliminary Operations search.
• 
The display of the estimated match wait time has been updated.
• 
Fixed a bug that caused players who had not declined to confirm a match to be blocked from searching.
• 
If a player declines a match that has been found, only the player who declined it will now receive a penalty.
• 
Once the confirmation period has ended, only players who have not confirmed their participation will be penalized.
• 
Fixed an issue where gear could remain locked after a canceled match.
Interface
• 
Updated the team color schemes:
allies are now always displayed in blue color;
enemies are assigned one of four distinct colors.
• 
The new color scheme is used in the HUD, match confirmation window, statistics, closed lobby, and battle results.
• 
Added new team icons to the match confirmation window.
Fixes
• 
Fixed being able to teleport inside walls and other level geometry using a teleport grenade.
• 
Fixed battery duplication.
• 
Fixed the behavior of temporary items and active abilities when receiving a battery or a respawn marker.
• 
Interacting with batteries, stations, respawn markers, and canisters now correctly interrupts the animation of the currently used item.
• 
Items obtained from barrels are now correctly considered to be tied to their location.
• 
Fixed the display of information about modules, attachments, and artifacts in player profiles.
Sound and localization
• 
The English voiceover is linked to the speaker volume setting.
• 
Added Spanish and Korean versions of the mode guide.
Modules changes
• 
Modules are now automatically removed from a weapon when it is sold, deleted, or used in a barter.
• 
Weapon modules can now be rearranged by dragging and dropping them directly in the inventory, without opening the upgrade window. This feature is available only in safe zones with a personal storage access.
Other changes and fixes
• 
Fixed an issue where weapons were not being painted correctly with one-color paints, which occurred after the previous update.
• 
Fixed an issue where Arsenal's available inventory was displayed incorrectly during the first 5 hours after midnight.
• 
Gladiator motif is now also compatible with the Albatross Heavy Assault Exoarmor.
• 
Fixed multiple naming inconsistency bugs.
• 
Fixed multiple translation inconsistency bugs.
• 
Fixed the translation of several characters and legacy items.

Start of the Coliseum rankings
The ranking has begun, so gather your best gear and prove who the true master is here by claiming what rightfully belongs to you. Get ready for battle, and good luck in the arena!
Rating system
The Coliseum's ranking season will run from August 12 to 26 — exactly two weeks.
To access Ranked Mode on RU and EU regions, you must have Level 7 of North faction reputation.
To access Ranked Mode on NA, SEA, and NEA regions, you must have Level 3 of North faction reputation.
The first time you enter ranked mode, you'll need to complete a 20-game calibration period. No rewards are awarded for matches played during calibration. Based on the results, a ranking will be determined and the corresponding league will be assigned.
Each league has a fixed rating threshold that must be reached. Raise your ranking to move up to higher leagues, and don't stop there!
You can only lose the league you've reached by losing games. If you decide to stop at your current rank and stop participating in ranked matches, you’ll keep your rank — it won’t drop over time.
Horizon stands apart — it's the top league of the Coliseum. A limited number of players with the highest rankings at the end of the season will qualify for it.
Rating availability
The rankings will be available during limited time windows due to low online traffic in the regions. This solution will help you find matches more reliably and quickly.
Ranked mode will be available during the following time periods:
• 
EU (UTC+1): 14:00–22:00
• 
NA (UTC−4): 18:00–20:00, 22:00-02:00
•

We’ll keep an eye on your feedback and will adjust the ranked availability windows if needed. The current schedule was designed to avoid overlapping with Subdivision Battles.

Patch Notes [02.09.2026]
historical_patches.text:
Watch video overview of the Patch Notes:
Stalkers are talking about something that cannot be perceived or understood. People are abandoning their gear, leaving their routes, and swearing they felt someone else’s presence.
More and more experienced stalkers are turning back to superstitions.

Contents

Season: tulpa!
Autumn weather
Autumn has reached the Zone: leaves are slowly falling, painting familiar landscapes in rusty tones.
• 
The vegetation palette has been updated to match the autumn season.

Updated the visuals for weather effects. During some of them, falling leaves can be observed.

• 
tulpa! customization pack.
And the main Season Pass reward — Capper.
The new sniper rifle features a unique charge mechanic that lets you choose between firing instantly or dealing maximum damage.
• 
Pressing the fire button immediately shoots with low damage, comparable to a veteran M40A5 using SBP ammo.
• 
Holding the fire button begins charging the shot. A full charge takes 0.5 seconds and increases damage to nearly Gauss Rifle levels. While charging, movement speed is reduced by 50%.
• 
You can fire at any point during the charge, but the longer you hold the button, the higher the damage. Most of the damage increase occurs in the final moments before the charge is complete.
• 
At full charge, the shot gains an additional property: armor plate penetration.
• 
After reaching full charge, the weapon can remain charged for an additional 3 seconds. If you don’t fire within that time, the charge is lost.
Special case
Added a new Season Special case, featuring a unique reward — K15 machine gun.

K15;

• 
Elbrus SRD;
• 
CRAW-6 Container;

HK417;

Season Pass menu change
Updated the main rewards interaction menu. You can now switch between key rewards using the cards in the top-right corner.
Visual changes:
• 
Level progress and Season Pass buttons moved to the season description block;
• 
The Go to my level and Claim rewards buttons moved to the bottom control panel.
Economy adjustments for the Operations mode
For a long time, the high profitability of the Operations mode limited our ability to increase rewards for open-world activities.
The current Operations economy allows players to earn extremely high guaranteed income without significant risks or costs. This disrupts the reward structure logic we aim for across the game and is unfair to players engaging in riskier, more resource-intensive activities. Therefore, it was decided to reduce this mode’s profitability in favor of increasing open-world rewards.
Economic changes will be implemented in two iterations:
First iteration — reducing Operations mode profitability on September 2, 2026. 
Second iteration — increasing profitability in permanent open-world events, planned for late September/early October.
• 
Fixed money reward reduced by 70%.
• 
Reduced the amount of advanced parts, tools, and currency in the potential reward pool.
• 
The probability of receiving Advanced Tools in rewards is reduced, and the probability of receiving Advanced Parts is increased.
Tasks display
• 
Receiving a side quest no longer replaces the active main quest. The main quest retains the highest priority and continues to be displayed at the top of the interface.
• 
During eruptions, Find cover quest always has the highest priority and temporarily overrides the display of other quests.
• 
Objectives for the main and side quests can now be displayed simultaneously. You can also manually hide or pin them.
• 
Open world events that can be used to complete an active quest are now marked with a special indicator.
Subdivision Battles
The next ranked season will begin on September 17 and run until October 10.
Guide updates
• 
Tables can now be used in articles.
• 
Fixed several issues related to item display in the Codex.
• 
Added the following items to the Codex: Cryomancer, SIX12 Trailblazers of the North, and Ivan-1 style.
• 
Expanded and translated articles on signals, events, additional effects, and other game mechanics.
Coliseum season tasks changes
• 
Successful installation capture, Activate the rift, Intercept the generator, Eliminate the enemy squad tasks now count as a single task.
• 
Eliminate the enemy squad task now requires eliminating 3 enemy squads instead of 1.
• 
Activate the rift task now requires activating 3 rifts instead of 2.
• 
Intercept the generator task now requires 4 interceptions instead of 3.
Player profile change
Profile music
You can now add tracks from records to your profile.
• 
A new Music section is now available in the profile customisation window.
• 
Just like on the card's page, you can find all the records available in the game there and learn how to obtain them.
• 
For a track in your profile, you can select any segment that is at least 1 second long.
• 
By default, the track plays when you enter your profile. Once you press Pause, this status is retained when you access any profile.
Display of the player's current gear in the profile
Now, all equipped items on a character are displayed in the profile next to the Statistics window. You can hide items from other players using a special button.
In-game shop update
Pack chain
To help you get started quickly, a series of packs awaits you, containing Season Pass levels, Overdrives, Fishie Crates, and Night Stalks paint for armor and weapons.
Styles
“I've seen a lot in my life, but something staring at me from the darkness...” — some strangers around the campfire.
There are many rumors about unexplained phenomena occurring in the Zone. Some people blame it on the antics of stalkers, while others believe in a different, more terrifying and frightening force. historical_patches.title: Patch Notes [09.09.2026]
historical_patches.text:
Content
• 
Electrostorm event fixes
• 
Typhoon Scout Supplies
• 
Other changes and fixes
Electrostorm event fixes
• 
Reduced the maximum number of players per Forge-11 instance.
• 
During Electrostorm, 3 Lightning Rods are now active simultaneously.
• 
Destroy mutants during Electrostorm task now requires 300 mutant kills instead of 500.
• 
Due to the reduced player limit per Forge-11 instance, the number of artifacts spawned after eruptions is reduced by 28%.
• 
Adjusted the drop rates of Snares and Mug spawned after eruptions. They now have the same drop chance as Larva, Black Hole, and Timber.
• 
Reduced the chances of artifacts rarity generated by Lightning Rods due to the addition of a third Lightning Rod, while increasing the overall number of artifacts they generate.
• 
Reduced the chances of the following artifacts spawn while generated by Lightning Rod: Dumbbell, Amberite, Frame, Bracelet, Steel Hedgehog, Scrubber, Snake Eye, Polyhedron, Gum, Helium, Transformer, Mirror, Spiral, Shard, Atom, Prism, Sun, Radiator, Viburnum Branch.
• 
Fixed an issue where Internal could drop from ZIVCAS Raid event.
• 
Fixed an issue where Zombie, ZIVCAS, and Mutant events would not spawn in some Forge-11 instances. 
Typhoon Scout Supplies
Typhoon scouts are used to taking on missions of any difficulty, but the Zone presents challenges that no foreign unit can truly prepare for. Harsh conditions and relentless anomalous activity force these elite operatives to constantly adapt just to stay alive.
To support their missions and make adapting to the Zone a little easier, we've added the Typhoon Scout Supply pack. It contains everything needed to overcome the hardships of survival, and now you can stock up on these supplies as well.
Other changes and fixes
• 
Burrow in the center of Forge-11 now leads to your faction's base.
• 
Fixed an issue where the icons for possible rewards were displayed incorrectly in the event tooltip.
• 
Added display of Season Pass progress points.
• 
Fixed an issue where the timer element in the Lightning Rod and Chronorift event interfaces was sticking to the center of the screen.
• 
Fixed Electrostorm event challenges description.
• 
Fixed an issue where most paints could not be applied to the Capper.

Moved the antenna on the Aeolus style from the left to the right side;

Fixed an issue where using the Burrow leading to the Arsenal Workshop counted toward the progress of the Leave Forge-11 through Burrow challenge.
• 
Fixed the incorrect positioning of the attachments on the foregrip of the Sandy Lock style.
